izzyondroid:acab.naiveha.upnpkino.name: UPnP Kino by naiveHA
izzyondroid:acab.naiveha.upnpkino.summary: Uncomplicatedly simple: stream video/audio from your phone to UPnP/DLNA players
izzyondroid:acab.naiveha.upnpkino.description:
UPnP Kino by naiveHA
 Uncomplicatedly simple : stream your media library (video and audio) directly from your Android device to any UPnP/DLNA compatible player.
 Features
 Wide Format Support : Stream video ( mp4 , mkv , mov , webm ) and audio ( mp3 , m4a , aac , flac , wav , opus ).
 Large File Support : Unlike other legacy apps, UPnP Kino handles files larger than 2GB (perfect for high-quality H264 encodes).
 Background Streaming : Keeps the media server running even when the screen is off or you're using other apps.
 Modern Backend : Built on Eclipse Jetty 12 for reliable performance.
 Privacy Focused : No tracking, no unnecessary permissions.
 Compatibility
 Device Requirements : Android 10 (API 29) or higher.
 Tested Players : VLC : Extensively tested on Desktop and Mobile.
 eezUPnP : Confirmed working.
 Kodi : Confirmed working. In certain cases, you might need to start Kodi first , then start UPnP Kino.
 Permissions Explained
 Local Network : Required to find and connect to players on your WiFi.
 Media Access : Needed to read the files you choose to share. On Android 14+, you can grant access to specific files only.
 Notifications : Used to show server status and provide quick-stop controls.
 Wake Lock : Prevents the stream from dropping if the phone enters deep sleep.
 ☕ Support the Project
 If you find this app useful, consider supporting development! BTC Address : 1HwgShr1TniuBxNQwy2xAhpQaNuZhtw6sh

izzyondroid:com.ap.transmission.btc.name: Transmission BTC
izzyondroid:com.ap.transmission.btc.description:
Transmission is a powerful yet extremely lightweight and fast BitTorrent client. It has the features you want from a BitTorrent client: encryption, a web interface, peer exchange, magnet links, DHT, µTP, UPnP and NAT-PMP port forwarding, webseed support, tracker editing, global and per-torrent speed limits, and more.
 This application is a port of the Transmission daemon for Android with a few enhancements and additions. The daemon is running in background as an Android service. To communicate with the daemon you may either use the built-in WEB interface or any Transmission remote of choice.
 For more information on the Transmission client please refer to the official site of the Transmission Project .
 Features of the app: 
 Manage downloads directly from the application.
 Multiple watch/download directories.
 Support for HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy.
 WiFi/Ethernet mode to save on mobile data.
 Allowed WiFi SSIDs - if configured, the service is running only if connected to the specified networks.
 Keep CPU/WiFi awake to complete all downloads before the device goes to sleep.
 Sequential download allows playing media files while downloading.
 Open .torrent files or torrent/magnet URLs and stream the selected files to a media player.
 Builtin UPnP MediaServer. Download media files to a phone/tablet/TV-box and watch on a TV or another UPnP compatible media player connected to the same network.
 M3U playlists for all torrents/folders containing audio/video files. To get the playlist URL - long click on the play icon.
 Alternative web interface - Transmission Web Control

izzyondroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.name: PassVault
izzyondroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.summary: A secure, lightweight, and 100% offline password manager.
izzyondroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.description:
PassVault is a secure, lightweight, and 100% offline password manager for Android.
 PassVault is a lightweight password manager that allows users to securely store credentials on their device. All data is stored locally and sensitive information is encrypted using the Android Keystore system. The application does not require internet permissions. User data never leaves the device.
 FEATURES:
 Secure Authentication: Access your vault using a PIN or Biometric (fingerprint) login.
 Encrypted Storage: All passwords are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and stored securely in a local Room database.
 100% Offline-First: The app is fully functional without an internet connection.
 Password Generation: Create strong, random passwords directly within the app.
 Password Strength Scoring: Visual feedback on password security.
 Backups: Import or Export encrypted/unencrypted data
 Automatic Backups: Automatically backup your database with configurable retention and copies per backup.
 Custom Backup Location: Choose where to save your backups using Storage Access Framework.
 Third-Party Import: Seamlessly import existing vault from Bitwarden and KeePass.
 Supports JSON, CSV, and KDBX files.
 Custom Categories: Create and manage your own entry categories.
 Filter/Search Entries
 Block Screenshots: Prevent screen capture for enhanced security.

izzyondroid:com.jucktion.healthlog.summary: Log medical tests like Blood Pressure/Sugar/Cholesterol/RFT
izzyondroid:com.jucktion.healthlog.description:
Keep track of your medical test records to monitor your progress and become healthier.
 The project is currently in a beta testing phase. Used it for multiple users and works well enough for daily use, but if you encounter any bugs please report them. I'll try my best to fix them.
 Features: 
 Allows health test reading data storage for multiple users
 Blood Pressure, Blood Sugar/Glucose, Cholesterol, Renal Function Test, Notes can be saved
 Acceptable range for Blood Glucose (Sugar) reading configurable via slider in settings
 Graph view of last 30 readings (for now)
 No Ads and Tracking (Has no Internet permission)
 Limited dependencies for reduced binary size. Currently under 8MB
 Tested on Android 6 and up (although only a few devices)
 Can enable data file backup on every entry to prevent data loss
 Free and Open Source

 Data is not encrypted on storage. Local SQLite database stores data in json format
 Currently in beta testing state. (Report bugs and UI/UX issues)
 Some acceptable ranges for some test aren't configurable yet
 Some (old)keyboards cannot create newline on notes

izzyondroid:me.bmax.apatch.name: APatch
izzyondroid:me.bmax.apatch.summary: The patching of Android kernel and Android system
izzyondroid:me.bmax.apatch.description:
The patching of Android kernel and Android system.
 A new kernel-based root solution for Android devices.
 APM: Support for modules similar to Magisk.
 KPM: Support for modules that allow you to inject any code into the kernel (Requires kernel function inline-hook and syscall-table-hook enabled).
 APatch relies on KernelPatch.
 The APatch UI and the APModule source code have been derived and modified from KernelSU.
 Only supports the ARM64 architecture.
 Only supports Android kernel versions 3.18 - 6.1
 Support for Samsung devices with security protection: Planned Kernel configs:
 CONFIG_KALLSYMS=y and CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL=y 
 CONFIG_KALLSYMS=y and CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL=n : Initial support
 The SuperKey has higher privileges than root access. Weak or compromised keys can lead to unauthorized control of your device. It is critical to use robust keys and safeguard them from exposure to maintain the security of your device.

Maskan (مسكن) — Private multi-provider AI chat for Android.
Bring your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, Together AI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including local models (Ollama, LM Studio).

• Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) — no subscriptions, no proxy server
• Image input — send photos to vision-capable models (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini)
• Voice input — speech-to-text in Arabic, English, and Thai
• Voice narration — hear AI responses read aloud
• Export conversations as plain text or markdown
• Search conversations by title and message content
• Stop generation — cancel AI responses mid-stream
• 3 languages — English, Arabic, Thai
• All API keys encrypted on device
• Conversation history stored locally only
• 12 system prompt presets
• Dialect-aware Arabic translation (MSA, Levantine, Egyptian, Gulf, Maghrebi)
• English↔Thai translation presets
• Classical Arabic literary helper
• Folder organization with custom pastel colors
• Full Arabic UI with RTL layout
• No Google Play Services dependency
• No analytics, no trackers, no telemetry
• FOSS — GPL-3.0

fdroid:com.jksalcedo.librefind.summary: Discover and replace proprietary apps with FOSS alternatives
fdroid:com.jksalcedo.librefind.description:
LibreFind is a free and lightweight Android app that scans your installed packages locally and queries our database to identify proprietary software and find FOSS alternatives.

• Scan installed apps to detect proprietary software
• Get FOSS alternative recommendations

fdroid:com.quad9.aegis.name: Quad9 Connect
fdroid:com.quad9.aegis.summary: Android application for Quad9 recursive DNS cybersecurity and privacy services
fdroid:com.quad9.aegis.description:
Quad9 Connect is an Android and ChromeOS app that sends your DNS queries to Quad9's secure, private, open recursive DNS service .
Quad9 Connect adds additional functionality and features compared to using Android's Private DNS feature to utilize encrypted DNS or configured Quad9 in Chrome on ChromeOS.
The application creates a split VPN tunnel with Android API "VpnService" to configure an alternate DNS server on Android and ChromeOS.
## Features
- DNS over TLS or DNS over UDP
- DNS Query Log
- Trusted Networks
- Blocked Query Notifications
- Local Domains
- Excluded Applications
fdroid:com.quad9.aegis.category: Connectivity, DNS & Hosts, Internet, Security, System

fdroid:com.svenjacobs.app.leon.name: Léon – The URL Cleaner
fdroid:com.svenjacobs.app.leon.summary: Removes tracking & other redundant parameters from web links for sharing
fdroid:com.svenjacobs.app.leon.description:
Léon - The URL Cleaner removes tracking and other obsolete parameters from a URL before sharing. Its usage is simple, integrating into Android's standard sharing mechanism.
Léon runs on Android 7.0 and later, is open source and does not contain any tracking or advertising frameworks. Léon does not collect any data about you. Léon works offline; resolving short links is optional, off by default and only ever contacts the service that created the short link.
The benefits of removing tracking parameters are:
* Protects your and the recipient's privacy
* Improves readability of links
* Saves characters (in Tweets for example)

fdroid:de.schliweb.moveapiece.name: MoveAPiece: Offline Chess
fdroid:de.schliweb.moveapiece.summary: Offline chess vs Stockfish or Maia, opening trainer, Pegasus & Chessnut boards
fdroid:de.schliweb.moveapiece.description:
Open it and play. MoveAPiece is an offline chess app that starts straight into a game against the Stockfish chess engine. No account, no ads, no internet connection, no settings screen. One "New Game" dialog covers every choice there is (opponent, colour, strength, opening), and the app remembers it for next time.
PLAY CHESS AGAINST THE COMPUTER
• Stockfish, the well-known open-source chess engine, at an adjustable playing strength from Elo 1320 to 3190, from beginner to master level
• Maia, a human-like chess AI: it plays the moves a player of a chosen rating (800 to 2400) would typically play, with natural thinking pauses. An opponent that feels like a club player, not a calculator
• Two players on one phone or tablet
• Chess960 (Fischer Random): every game starts from one of the 960 starting positions, picked at random, against Stockfish, Maia or a friend, on the screen or on an electronic board
LEARN CHESS OPENINGS
• Opening trainer with 20 well-known lines, among them Ruy Lopez, Sicilian Najdorf, Italian Game, Queen's Gambit, Caro-Kann and King's Indian. The app plays the book side and accepts only the correct reply
• Step-through opening library to review every line move by move
• Optional move hints while you learn
SOLVE TACTICS PUZZLES
• About 4,600 puzzles from real games, from the free Lichess puzzle database
• Picked to match your level: your puzzle rating adjusts after every puzzle, and you can make them easier or harder
• A hint or the whole solution when you are stuck
• Practise the mistakes of your own games: after the analysis, each one comes back as a puzzle
IMPROVE YOUR GAME
• Hint button, optional live evaluation, blunder warning after a bad move
• Post-game analysis that grades every move
• Undo, redo, flip the board, tap any move in the move list to jump there
• PGN import and export to study or share your games
ELECTRONIC CHESS BOARDS
Own a DGT Pegasus or a Chessnut Air, Air+, Pro or Go? Connect it over Bluetooth and play on the real board instead of the screen. Your moves are picked up from the pieces, the opponent's replies light up on the board's LEDs, and the app detects the board type on its own. The screen stays usable at the same time, for hints, evaluation and the move list.
OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
• Works completely offline, nothing leaves your device
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases
• Maia's neural network is bundled and runs on the device
• Free and open source (GPLv3)
Also there: move, capture and check sounds; portrait and landscape; phone and tablet layouts; English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Dutch.

fdroid:io.github.ds17f.andropolis.description:
Build and run a city. Zone land for homes, shops and industry, connect it with roads,
rail and power, balance the budget, and keep your citizens happy — while fires, floods,
tornadoes and the occasional monster try to spoil your plans.
 Andropolis is an open-source Android port of Micropolis , the GPL release of the
original SimCity city simulator by Will Wright. It uses the MicropolisCore engine: the
original simulation code, in C++, unchanged.
 Features 
 The full classic simulation: zones, traffic, pollution, crime, land value, budget, evaluation
 The 8 original scenarios (Dullsville, San Francisco, Hamburg, Bern, Tokyo, Detroit, Boston, Rio) and 23 sample cities
 New maps with terrain choices: trees, lakes, rivers, islands
 Touch controls: drag roads and power lines, place buildings with a preview, per-build undo
 Overlays, graphs, messages, the citizens' opinion poll and the annual report
 Optional background play: the city keeps going while the app is closed, at a pace you choose, and notifies you when something happens
 Saves are plain files you can copy and share

Continuous care

Proven Outcomes
After program completion, 73% of Meru participants show clinically significant improvement, and 59% are in remission from symptoms of depression or anxiety. This exceeds the 12-week outcomes of traditional approaches to mental health care.

◆◆◆ Local music, ready when you are
1. Play MP3, FLAC, WAV, M4A, AAC, APE, AIFF, DSF, DFF and more, from everyday listening to lossless collections.
2. Import files and folders, transfer over Wi-Fi or extract audio from videos.
3. Browse by song, artist, album or genre. Make playlists and save favorites.

◆◆◆ Connect your collection
1. Access Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, pCloud, MEGA, Baidu Netdisk, Aliyun Drive, 115, 123 and Guangya cloud drives.

4. Enable pre-downloading to keep completed downloads in your local music folder as you listen.
◆◆◆ Your personal music server
1. Explore Navidrome and compatible Subsonic services in a dedicated server mode.
2. Rediscover recent plays, favorites, playlists, random picks and recent additions.
3. Browse and search songs, artists and albums. View album details, artist biographies and similar artists when supplied by the server.
4. Download songs, then switch to classic mode to enjoy them offline.
◆◆◆ Give your music lasting value
1. Find song information with audio fingerprint recognition.
2. Edit titles, artists, albums, artwork and lyrics to keep your collection organized.
3. Embed metadata in supported audio files so your work stays with your music across devices and players.
4. Recognition results and writable tags depend on the song and file format.

1. Adjust a 10-band EQ and preamp gain to suit your taste.
2. Try Bass Boost, Vocal, Rock, Jazz and other presets, or save your own settings.
3. Analyze local audio spectra and check format, file size, average bitrate and sample rate.
4. Save or share an analysis card. A spectrum helps reveal audio characteristics but cannot, on its own, prove a recording is truly lossless.

1. Choose vinyl, cassette and other player styles.
2. Enjoy artwork-inspired backgrounds, mini lyrics and audio information.
3. Use shuffle, sequential playback, repeat-one, queue management and a sleep timer.

1. Remote connections, EQ adjustments and some other features require Premium. See the app for details.
2. Choose a monthly or annual subscription, or a personal or Family Sharing lifetime purchase.
3. Free trial eligibility, duration and subsequent pricing, when offered, are shown at purchase.

Wakemusic is a player and library manager; it does not supply music. Use audio you have permission to access. Third-party access, memberships, transfer limits and features depend on each provider.

apple-macos:1474804662.name: JustStream PRO
apple-macos:1474804662.description:
JustStream PRO is an essentially useful app that can mirror Mac display to TV, mirror Mac to Chromecast, mirror Mac to Apple TV, and so on. JustStream PRO allows you to effortlessly stream your video content on Mac to TV and enjoy it on a big screen without any need for cables or additional hardware.
JustStream PRO possibilities at a glance:
**Mirror Mac screen with audio on TV, Chromecast & AppleTV**
With JustStream PRO you are able to mirror Mac or MacBook screen to Smart TV, Apple TV or Chromecast devices. JustStream PRO works with such popular brand and service names as Samsung, Roku, LG, Sony, Panasonic and a huge number of other DLNA-certified devices. 
Thanks to the full native M1 support on Apple Silicon Macs video conversion is much lighter on the CPU. 
**Benefits of mirroring Mac to TV with JustStream PRO: **
* Allows mirroring any of the monitors connected to the computer.
* Lets you adjust the video to fit the TV screen.
* Allows capturing the movements of the mouse cursor.
* Allows capturing the mouse clicks.
* Lets you choose the output quality: Auto / Full HD (1080p) / HD (720p).
**A huge variety of video formats is supported**
With JustStream PRO you can stream pretty much any media file type, including such popular ones as AVI, FLV, MP4, MKV, MKV, MOV, AVI, WMV, MP3, WAV. A really appealing feature of JustStream PRO is a real-time transcoding of a streamed content. What it means is that even if the video format is not supported by the receiving TV, JustStream will convert it as it is streaming without affecting the quality of the output.
**Stream with subtitles**
JustStream PRO offers an advanced support for both embedded and external subtitles, whichever your video comes with. When streaming to Chromecast or Chromecast Ultra you can change the subtitle font, size and color.
**Stream playlists**
You can create custom playlists for streaming non-stop. This is rather useful when you have many short audio or video files that you want to be played on a large TV screen for entertainment or other purposes.
**Supports external and embedded audio**
Whichever type of sound your video is using, JustStream PRO will effortlessly stream it from Mac to TV.
**Pause/Resume at your convenience**
With JustStream PRO your streaming session is entirely controlled by you. Pause or resume the playback whenever needed.
**JustStream PRO is there for you**
The app will be hanging out in the menu bar waiting for you to need it and will jump to action as soon as you do.

fedora-packages:gfs-porson-fonts/gfs-por.description: In England, during the 1790’s, Cambridge University Press decided to procure a new set of Greek types. The university’s great scholar of Classics, Richard Porson was asked to produce a typeface based on his handsome handwriting and Richard Austin was commissioned to cut the types. The type was completed in 1808, after the untimely death of Porson the previous year. Its success was immediate and since then the classical editions in Great Britain and the U.S.A. use it, almost invariably. In 1913, Monotype released the typeface with some corrections, notably replacing the upright capitals suggested by Porson with inclined ones. In Greece the typeface was used under the name Pelasgika type. GFS Porson is based on the Monotype version, though using upright capitals, as in the original.

D365 F&O Show Table Browser is a lightweight and efficient productivity tool designed specifically for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations developers, technical consultants, and system administrators.
It allows you to instantly generate and navigate directly to the SysTableBrowser page for any table, target environment, and company code directly from your browser toolbar, eliminating repetitive manual URL construction.
Key Features:

firefox-addons:2785747.name: Google Translate Assistant
firefox-addons:2785747.summary: Webpage translation; Selected word translation; Online translation; Screenshot translation; Translation pronunciation
firefox-addons:2785747.description:
Google Translate
Google Translate Assistant is a professional translation extension that perfectly fixes the full-page translation problem of Google Chrome. It also supports word translation during web browsing, providing a convenient translation portal.
Google Translate will no longer provide services to mainland China at the end of September 2022. Users in China will not be able to use the browser web translation function normally. We fixed the Google Translate problem as soon as possible. Compared with Baidu Translation, Youdao Translation, Huoshan Translation, etc., Google Translate Assistant provides stronger translation functions: ① Full page translation, ② Word translation, ③ Text translation, ④ Screenshot translation, ⑤ Translate pronunciation
Google Translate Assistant supports Chrome-based browsers, as well as edge and Firefox browsers. The translator assists users in quickly reading foreign documents and improves the translation browsing experience.
★Full page translation
Right-click on a blank space on the web page and select "Translate the entire page into Chinese (Simplified)" to complete the full-text translation. It is applicable to all Google-based browsers. It also provides automatic full-page translation function to remember your full-page translation habits.
★Dictionary translation
When you encounter unfamiliar foreign language vocabulary while browsing, select it with your mouse for one-click translation, and the translation results will appear near the mouse. If you turn on the "Quick Word Translation" button, the mouse selection will immediately translate for you.
★Text translation
At the entrance of the extension, enter the text you want to translate and you will get the translation result immediately. It supports translation between hundreds of languages, supports automatic detection of the language you entered, and keeps the translation history for you, which can be retrieved at any time.
★Screenshot translation
When you encounter text that cannot be selected, take a screenshot of the area that needs to be translated and it can be translated into the language you want.
★Translate pronunciation
Provide pronunciation function for your translation results to break through pronunciation barriers.
★Shortcut keys
The extension provides shortcut keys for each translation function
Activate the extension (open the ‘Online Translation’ panel)：Alt+H
Screenshot translation：Alt+G
Webpage translation: Alt+T
Fast translation: Alt+R
★The online translation panel can be displayed in an independent window
The online translation window can appear as an independent window and be moved to any place on the screen to perform translation work for you.
If this extension helped you solve your problem, please leave a 5-star review to help more people discover this extension! More translation functions are under continuous development. If you need any functions, please tell us in the comment area.

firefox-addons:3060925.name: Password Reveal Blocker
firefox-addons:3060925.summary: Prevents passwords from being displayed in plain text on web pages, blocks “eye” reveal buttons, restores password fields that are changed to text, remains compatible with password managers, and supports centrally managed enterprise deployments.
firefox-addons:3060925.description:
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev est une extension de sécurité conçue pour renforcer la protection des mots de passe affichés dans les pages web.
Elle empêche lePassword Reveal Blocker - GoToDev is a security extension designed to strengthen the protection of passwords displayed on web pages.
It prevents “Show password” features or buttons represented by an eye icon from revealing the contents of password fields in plain text. When a protected field is changed from password to text, the extension detects the change and automatically restores the protected password mode.
Protection also relies on identifying common password-field markers, such as autocomplete="current-password", autocomplete="new-password", and other attributes commonly associated with password fields. An integrity-check mechanism regularly verifies that previously identified password fields remain protected.
The extension is designed to work alongside major password managers. It does not block their autofill mechanisms and does not access password values in order to provide its protection.
Password-protected administrator access is available for managing the extension settings. Protection can be temporarily suspended for 30 seconds, 1 minute, 2 minutes, or 5 minutes before being automatically re-enabled.
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev also includes an enterprise mode designed for organizations and IT departments. Settings can be centrally managed using Firefox Enterprise mechanisms, the Windows Registry, Group Policy (GPO), or deployment scripts.
In managed environments, IT administrators can define a shared administrator password, control whether temporary suspension is allowed, and combine the extension with Firefox policies that enforce installation and prevent users from disabling or removing it.
The extension operates entirely locally within Firefox. No passwords, browsing history, form contents, personal data, usage statistics, or telemetry are sent to GoToDev or any third-party service.
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev is intended as an additional defense-in-depth security measure alongside password managers and browser security policies. It does not claim to provide absolute protection against users with elevated system privileges or unrestricted access to debugging tools.s fonctions « Afficher le mot de passe » ou les boutons représentés par une icône en forme d’œil de révéler en clair le contenu d’un champ de mot de passe. Lorsqu’un champ protégé est transformé de password vers text, l’extension détecte la modification et restaure automatiquement le mode protégé.
La protection repose également sur l’identification de marqueurs caractéristiques des champs de mot de passe, tels que autocomplete="current-password", autocomplete="new-password" ou les attributs couramment associés aux mots de passe. Un mécanisme de contrôle d’intégrité vérifie régulièrement que les champs déjà identifiés restent protégés.
L’extension a été conçue pour fonctionner en complément des principaux gestionnaires de mots de passe. Elle ne bloque pas leur mécanisme de remplissage automatique et n’accède pas à la valeur des mots de passe pour assurer sa fonction.
Un accès administrateur protégé par mot de passe permet d’accéder aux paramètres de l’extension. La protection peut être suspendue temporairement pendant 30 secondes, 1 minute, 2 minutes ou 5 minutes avant sa réactivation automatique.
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev dispose également d’un mode entreprise destiné aux organisations et aux services informatiques. Les paramètres peuvent être administrés centralement à l’aide des mécanismes Firefox Enterprise, du registre Windows, de stratégies GPO ou de scripts de déploiement.
En environnement administré, la DSI peut notamment définir un mot de passe administrateur commun, contrôler les possibilités de suspension temporaire et associer l’extension aux politiques Firefox permettant de forcer son installation et d’empêcher sa désactivation ou sa suppression.
L’extension fonctionne entièrement localement dans Firefox. Aucun mot de passe, historique de navigation, contenu de formulaire, donnée personnelle, statistique d’utilisation ou télémétrie n’est envoyé à GoToDev ou à un service tiers.
Password Reveal Blocker - GoToDev constitue une mesure de défense en profondeur complémentaire à un gestionnaire de mots de passe et aux politiques de sécurité du navigateur. Elle ne prétend pas constituer à elle seule une protection absolue contre un utilisateur disposant de privilèges système élevés ou d’outils de débogage non restreints.

bluejetty:00090762:ios.description:
A Bible game where every story helps your world grow.
Set sail with Godly Kids! Explore Bible islands, discover stories, unlock Bible characters, and welcome them home to a community you help build.
Created for Christian families raising Godly kids, this adventure brings Bible reading, imaginative play, books, audio adventures, and ministry videos together in one place.
EXPLORE THE BIBLE BY SEA
Climb aboard your ship and sail to Bible story islands. Begin your journey on Beginnings Island and discover adventures that introduce children to the people and stories of Scripture.
READ STORIES. UNLOCK CHARACTERS.
Reading becomes part of the adventure. Discover Bible stories, unlock characters, and bring them aboard your ship for the journey home.
BUILD A HOME TOGETHER
Create a welcoming world for your growing community. Build, garden, fish, and spend time with the Bible characters who call your island home. Discover the joy of helping others and working toward something together.
A COMMUNITY WITH PERSONALITY
Tap characters for short conversations that bring your island to life. Little moments, shared experiences, and friendly encouragement help turn a collection of characters into a community.
KEEP THE ADVENTURE GOING
Explore a collection of Christian books, Bible stories, and original audio adventures. Discover The Lost Letter, Mick in Heaven, Bible Stories, Christian Level 1, and more faith-filled fun.
WATCH MINISTRY VIDEOS FOR KIDS
Join founder Micheal Bouchard and his parrot companion for lively ministry videos that help children explore faith and connect Bible teaching with everyday life.
SCREEN TIME WITH PURPOSE
Three years in the making, Godly Kids was created to help children learn about the Bible and explore what kindness, generosity, and community can look like through play.
Read a story. Welcome a friend. Build something beautiful together.
Your Bible adventure starts here.
AN ADVENTURE IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Choose your app language during setup or in Settings. New options include Indonesian, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, Arabic, Swahili, and Traditional Chinese. Additional reading languages are available in the book reader. Music and video audio remain in their original language.
Some content and features require a subscription. Available plans and pricing are shown in the app.
Privacy Policy: https://www.godlykids.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.godlykids.com/end-user-license-agreement

 In the future, after the attacks of dark forces. The Earth has suffered enormous damage. The last line of defense had fallen. Those attacks caused the environment on ea
bluejetty:00029377:ios.description:
Defense Legend 5: Build a defense - TD strategy to protect the peace.
 In the future, after the attacks of dark forces. The Earth has suffered enormous damage. The last line of defense had fallen. Those attacks caused the environment on earth to change no longer suitable for human habitation.
 A project to migrate to other habitable planets is underway with tower defense strategy. Legions are fully equipped with resources and equipment to rebuild new lives. 
 Wake up on a spaceship in the middle of a new planet with suitable living conditions. Your mission is to rebuild your new life. One day, you realize that legions of bizarre monsters appear one after another, hunting and destroying all living things in their route. 
 As a commander, it is your responsibility to command and strategize defense against enemies to protect humans from the attacks of space monsters. Attack or defense? One small decision can drastically impact the direction of an entire campaign.
 The game is fascinated by the compelling storyline throughout the Defense Legend game series. The core nature of the tower defense game remains unchanged. At each level, the complexity rises, forcing you to adapt your tactics and skills to use the equipment. It is exciting and attractive to lovers of the tower defense game genre. 
 FEATURES:
- Command the legion against the invasion of monsters in the TD games 
- Build turrets, and upgrade weapons to increase strength and combat ability.
- Upgrade your spaceship to build an invincible fleet.
- A place to demonstrate the tactics, strategies, and skills of a talented commander
- Fight against monsters on all terrains from the air, forests, and deserts… to icy places, because of this, tactics and strategies must be extremely flexible to suit the challenges presented by tower defense games.
 INSTRUCTION:
- Choose the appropriate commander and turret for each terrain.
- Put weapons in convenient positions to defend easily.
- Collect resources, and upgrade weapons to increase the legion's strength.
- Destroy all enemies, and protect the headquarters.
Download Defense Legend 5: Survivor TD now and come up with strategic moves for TD.
Join the community: 
-Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/605531618854195

bluejetty:00062815:ios.summary:
BOOST YOUR BRAINPOWER WITH EVERY FOLD & PUNCH.

bluejetty:00062815:ios.description:
BOOST YOUR BRAINPOWER WITH EVERY FOLD & PUNCH.
Sharpen your spatial reasoning, short-term memory, and logic skills — one puzzle at a time. Unfoldit is the original brain training game of paper folding and hole punching, inspired by real cognitive assessments and enjoyed by thousands around the world.
BRILLIANT VISUAL PUZZLES THAT WORK YOUR MIND.
• Visualize folds and mentally unfold them to predict hole punches across 1,885+ handcrafted levels
• Start easy and progress through expert-level puzzles with precision
• Learn as you go — hints and step-by-step unfolding animations guide you
• Strengthen focus, memory, and cognitive flexibility with each puzzle
BASED ON REAL COGNITIVE SCIENCE.
• Modeled after spatial reasoning and visual memory tests used in academia, research, and admissions
• Gameplay designed to challenge and enhance short-term memory and attention
• Used by students, professionals, and puzzle lovers alike
TAP IT, UNFOLD IT, WIN IT.
• Short levels are perfect for those in-between moments throughout your day
• Play hundreds of free levels — no ads, no distractions
BUILT FOR PLAY — AND FOR PROGRESS.
• Track your stats for each level — accuracy, speed, and precision
• Personalize your experience with light/dark mode and gameplay settings
• Play offline anytime — on flights, subways, or in short breaks
INTEGRATED WITH YOUR LIFE.
• Sync progress and stats automatically with iCloud across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Set optional daily reminders for encouragement to build a brain-training habit
• Share level links with friends to challenge them to solve what you’ve mastered
• Use Handoff to continue levels between devices for seamless gameplay
• Use Siri Shortcuts to jump back into your next level instantly
AWARD-WINNING & FEATURE-RICH.
Unfoldit was a finalist in the 2019 Georgia Tech InVenture Prize invention competition.
It's been refined for thoughtful minds, clever thinkers, and everyday geniuses.
UNFOLD YOUR MIND. START TRAINING TODAY.
Download Unfoldit now and join a global community of players improving their minds one fold at a time.

bluejetty:00043199:ios.summary: Gérez votre argent à tout moment avec MVola, une plateforme conçue pour apporter simplicité, sécurité et contrôle à vos finances. Qu'il s'agisse d'envoyer de l'argent, de payer des factures ou de suivre votre historique financier, MVola ren
bluejetty:00043199:ios.description:
Gérez votre argent à tout moment avec MVola, une plateforme conçue pour apporter simplicité, sécurité et contrôle à vos finances. Qu'il s'agisse d'envoyer de l'argent, de payer des factures ou de suivre votre historique financier, MVola rend les transactions quotidiennes plus faciles et plus accessibles. 
Caractéristiques principales : 
 - Transfert d'argent instantané : Envoyez ou recevez de l’argent en quelques clics. 
 - Paiement de factures : Payez vos factures de services publics, frais scolaires, et autres paiements depuis une seule application. 
 - Paiement avec QR code : Effectuez des achats en magasin simplement en scannant des QR codes. Profitez de paiements sécurisés et sans contact chez les commerçants partenaires. 
- Recharge de crédit et forfaits simplifiés : Achetez du crédit ou des forfaits de données, de voix et de SMS pour vous-même ou vos proches directement depuis l'application. 
- Sécurité et facilité d’utilisation : 
o Vérification biométrique : Profitez d’une authentification rapide et sécurisée (par empreinte digitale/reconnaissance faciale). Vos données biométriques sont stockées uniquement sur votre appareil et ne sont jamais transmises à MVola ou à des tiers.
o Authentification sécurisée par code PIN 
-Services de crédit MVola : L'application MVola offre des services de crédit pratiques pour répondre à vos besoins financiers à court terme à un taux de 9 %. 
 Comment faire une demande ? 
1. Vérifiez votre éligibilité à une demande de crédit : Vous devez être âgé de 18 ans ou plus et disposer d’un compte MVola actif et vérifié.
2. Ouvrez l'application MVola : Naviguez jusqu'à la section MVola Crédit.
3. Choisissez le montant et le motif du crédit. 
4. Sélectionnez un motif du Crédit : Chaque utilisateur devra sélectionner le motif du crédit parmi les options proposées par l'application. 
5. Acceptez les termes et conditions d’utilisation : Accédez aux détails en cliquant sur le lien qui redirige vers les conditions générales d’utilisation de MVola, lisez et acceptez les conditions pour finaliser la demande.
6. Processus de remboursement : Les remboursements sont dus à la date d’échéance présentée au moment de l'acceptation du Crédit. MVola envoie des rappels automatiques pour vous aider à effectuer les remboursements en temps voulu. Tous les coûts sont transparents dès le départ, sans frais cachés, ni frais supplémentaires pendant la durée du crédit. 
- Service d’Epargne : Épargnez et gagnez de l'argent : 
• Gagnez 4 % d'intérêts par an, versés trimestriellement.
 • Aucun dépôt initial n'est requis. 
 • Processus de souscription facile - commencez à gagner tout de suite. 
Permissions requises : 
 - Accès à la localisation approximative : Utilisé pour localiser les agents, les succursales et les commerçants à proximité qui acceptent les paiements MVola.
 - Accès à la caméra : Nécessaire pour scanner les codes QR lors des achats ou paiements des commerçants. 
 - Accès aux contacts : Permet uniquement de faciliter les transferts vers des contacts enregistrés et n’est jamais utilisé à d’autres fins. 
- Accès au stockage : Autorise l'application à stocker les reçus après chaque transaction sur votre téléphone.
 - Push Notification : Permet de recevoir des alertes concernant des activités importantes sur votre compte, telles que des offres promotionnelles, afin que vous soyez toujours informé. 
 Confidentialité et sécurité des données : MVola ne recueille que les données nécessaires à la fourniture de ses services, en adhérant à des réglementations strictes en matière de protection des données. Toutes les transmissions de données, entre l’application et les systèmes de MVola, sont cryptées et stockées en toute sécurité.
Pour toute assistance ou question, veuillez contacter l'équipe d'assistance de MVola au +261 34 00 008 07.

bluejetty:00019519:ios.description:

Join over 100 million people building healthier habits with StepsApp. Track your daily activity, stay consistent with streaks, and now compete with friends through leaderboards, group challenges, and social features that make walking surprisingly addictive.
FEATURES
• Automatic step tracking
• Daily goals and streaks
• Challenges with friends, family, and coworkers
• Leaderboards and groups
• Workout tracking with Heart Rate Zones and Insights
• Apple Health integration
• Apple Watch support
• Activity trends, records, and analytics
• Beautiful charts and animations
• Awards and achievements
• Home Screen widgets
• Lock Screen widgets
• Dark Mode and customizable app icons
• Social sharing
• Wheelchair support
• Export your data
• No extra hardware required
PRO FEATURES
• Advanced analytics & insights
• GPS workout tracking
• Premium customization
• Additional Streak Freezes
• Advanced goals
• Fully ad-free experience
* PRO features require an active paid subscription.
CONNECT YOUR DEVICES
StepsApp seamlessly syncs with popular health and fitness devices — on your wrist, finger, or phone.
• Apple Watch
• Garmin
• Oura
• Fitbit
• Whoop
• Polar
• Amazfit
• And many more
STAY MOTIVATED
StepsApp turns movement into a habit.
Set a daily goal. Build streaks. Join challenges. Climb the leaderboard. Whether you walk 2,000 steps or 20,000, StepsApp helps you stay consistent and actually enjoy the process.
Small daily wins add up fast.
TRACK EVERYTHING
Get a complete overview of your activity:
• Steps
• Distance
• Floors climbed
• Active calories
• Walking time
• Workouts and routes
• Heart rate data
• Weekly, monthly, and yearly trends
See your progress evolve over time with detailed insights, averages, and personal records.
CHALLENGES, GROUPS & LEADERBOARDS
Walking is better together.
Create groups with friends, family, coworkers, or your entire office. Compete in daily and weekly leaderboards, motivate each other, and stay accountable through shared challenges.
A little competition goes a long way.
APPLE WATCH & APPLE HEALTH
• Sync seamlessly with Apple Health
• Combine activity from iPhone and Apple Watch
• Track workouts with GPS on Apple Watch
• Secure health data storage
DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE
• Accessible with VoiceOver
• Wheelchair support
• Available in 20+ languages
• Clean, simple, and highly customizable interface
Download StepsApp and start building healthier habits one step at a time.
Privacy Policy:
https://steps.app/privacy

bluejetty:00095527:ios.name: Shadowborn
bluejetty:00095527:ios.summary:
Shadowborn is an arcade-style RPG designed for fast, gripping mobile gameplay. Dive into a rich world of whimsy and darkness letting you carve your path to victory, whether it's a quick battle or a longer, more immersive quest.
Experience
bluejetty:00095527:ios.description:
Shadowborn is an arcade-style RPG designed for fast, gripping mobile gameplay. Dive into a rich world of whimsy and darkness letting you carve your path to victory, whether it's a quick battle or a longer, more immersive quest.
Experience pure power fantasy with tight, short game loops that pack in excitement. Move seamlessly through vibrant landscapes, tackle fast-paced missions, and engage in combat that's responsive and satisfying. The game rewards your skill, allowing you to dodge attacks and time your take-downs to win against the odds. 
UNLEASH YOUR POWER
Step into a world of fantasy as a hero uniquely tailored to your style:
• Select from distinctive classes like the Warrior, Rogue, Sorcerer, Necromancer, Swashbuckler, and Valkyrie — each with a unique feel and powerful abilities.
• Experiment with a multi-class system allowing you blend abilities from different achetypes and create a truly unique warrior.
• Explore the different skill trees to unlock powerful synergies and legendary skills, making every playthrough unique.
SECRETS EVERYWHERE
The world is filled with hidden discoveries waiting to be found:
• Pull the legendary Sword in the Stone, unlock sliding bookcases, and walk the Path of Fire.
• Solve the Weeping Angel puzzle, discover what waits for you beyond the Looking Glass.
• Find the Veiled Temples, Pirate Caves, and the horrors of the Baron's Laboratory.
• Track your progress - the map shows how many secrets remain in each area.
DARK AND WHIMSICAL WORLD
Encounter a world of contrasts, where light and darkness dance:
• Explore haunted graveyards, abandoned churches, eerie swamps, mysterious lagoons, treacherous pirate caves, and ancient mines.
• Face the darkness: battle skeletal hordes, giant spiders, oozing slimes, fire elementals, spectral wraiths, and carnivorous plants.
• Confront epic bosses like the Brood Mother, Lich Lord, Pirate Captain, and the mysterious Baron von Darkwood.
• Discover serene moments with unicorns in sunlit glades and mermaids offering riddles by moonlit waterfalls.
ARCADE-INSPIRED COMBAT
Feel the thrill of smooth, responsive controls that adapt to your style:
• Choose between arcade and dual-stick control options for a flexible experience that feels great in your hands.
• Engage in satisfying, responsive combat that makes every fight feel impactful, like an arcade brawler in a fantasy world.
• Hire mercenaries to fight alongside you, raise the dead as a Necromancer, or ride into battle on horseback.
ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY
Your journey doesn't end at victory:
• Unlock heirlooms and a retirement system, encouraging fresh playthroughs and new challenges.
• Choose from many side quests: Solve mermaid riddles, explore the Sunken Citadel, and piece together the secrets of the mysterious Esmeralda
• Power up with new gear, refined strategies, and complete achievements
READY FOR ANY PLAYTIME
Quick missions that deliver big on action:
• 3-4 minute loops offer bite-sized, high-energy action perfect for mobile.
• Each mission drops you instantly into the heart of the action, keeping every session short and intense.
Embrace the whimsy and darkness of Shadowborn — an arcade RPG crafted for mobile players who crave fast-paced action in a world as enchanting as it is deadly. Download now and begin your journey!

bluejetty:00071687:ios.summary:
What is Futoshiki?

bluejetty:00071687:ios.description:
What is Futoshiki?
Futoshiki is a funny logic puzzle game from Japan. In this game you need to fill all cells with numbers. Some cells can be filled initially, the rest is filled by the player. The game is very similar to the game "Sudoku", but it has a difference. On the playing field, in addition to numbers, there may also be signs (more, less). The sign between two cells means that one number is greater than the other. A correctly filled square must satisfy the following three conditions:
1. The numbers in each line should not be repeated.
2. The numbers in each column should not be repeated.
3. If there are signs (arrows) on the field, then the condition must be met. (One number is smaller than the other).
Levels.
In the program you can choose 6 difficulty levels (4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 8x8 and 9x9). The larger the square, the more difficult it is to go through. If you play Futoshiki for the first time, we recommend that you start with a 4x4 square. At each level of complexity you will be offered 2000 unique game levels. The higher the number the more difficult. (Level 2000 is the most complex).
How to play?
To change the value of a cell - first select it, and then click on the numbers at the bottom of the screen to put a number in the cell. You can put several numbers in one cell at once, but the level is considered passed, when in each cell there is only one number. listings.name: The Futoshiki
listings.description:
What is Futoshiki?

Futoshiki is a funny logic puzzle game from Japan. In this game you need to fill all cells with numbers. Some cells can be filled initially, the rest is filled by the player. The game is very similar to the game "Sudoku", but it has a difference. On the playing field, in addition to numbers, there may also be signs (more, less). The sign between two cells means that one number is greater than the other. A correctly filled square must satisfy the following three conditions:
1. The numbers in each line should not be repeated.
2. The numbers in each column should not be repeated.
3. If there are signs (arrows) on the field, then the condition must be met. (One number is smaller than the other).

Levels.

In the program you can choose 6 difficulty levels (4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 8x8 and 9x9). The larger the square, the more difficult it is to go through. If you play Futoshiki for the first time, we recommend that you start with a 4x4 square. At each level of complexity you will be offered 2000 unique game levels. The higher the number the more difficult. (Level 2000 is the most complex).

How to play?

To change the value of a cell - first select it, and then click on the numbers at the bottom of the screen to put a number in the cell. You can put several numbers in one cell at once, but the level is considered passed, when in each cell there is only one number. If you want to remove a number from the cell, select it and click the corresponding number in the bottom of the screen.

bluejetty:00091334:ios.description:
Create stunning Stop Motion animations, videos, and animated GIFs with StopMotionCraft — the powerful animation maker designed for creators of all levels.
Whether you're making LEGO animations, clay animation, toy animations, or frame-by-frame storytelling, StopMotionCraft gives you the tools to bring your ideas to life and share them instantly on your favorite social platforms.
* Smart Capture — Hands-Free Animation:
Place your iPhone or iPad on a tripod or stable support, move a prop, and take your hands out of view. Smart Capture automatically takes the next frame once the scene is clear of hands and steady. Audio guidance keeps you informed, and Undo removes the latest frame.
* Flexible Creation Workflow:
 • Create a stop motion project from scratch by capturing photos frame-by-frame for maximum control over your animation.
 • Or import a video and convert it into a stop motion project in seconds for a faster and more convenient workflow.
* Work Anywhere:
Start a project on your iPhone and continue editing on your Mac. Your stop motion projects stay synced and ready wherever you work.
* Continuous Workflow:
With seamless real-time synchronization, your animation projects are always up-to-date across devices.
* Tailored Experience:
StopMotionCraft is optimized for every device, delivering a powerful and intuitive animation studio experience on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
* Green Screen Backgrounds:
Add custom backgrounds to your green screen slides and place your characters anywhere — from fantasy worlds to real locations.
* User-Friendly Animation Tools:
 • Intuitive interface designed for beginners and professional animators
 • Powerful filters and image processing tools to enhance your animation frames
 • Easily edit your timeline by moving, duplicating, or deleting frames
* Sound Effects and Audio:
 • Record audio clips directly in your stop motion videos
 • Import music and sounds from Apple Music
 • Add audio clips from your library to create richer animations
* Steady Shots:
 • Use voice commands to capture photos hands-free — just say “Action!”
 • Set an interval timer to automatically capture frames for smoother animation
* Effortless Frame-by-Frame Animation:
 • Onion skin overlays show your previous frame to guide the next shot
* Seamless Sharing:
Export your stop motion movies or animated GIFs and share them instantly on social media.
* 1-Week Free Trial
 • Enjoy full access to StopMotionCraft for one week completely free
 • Cancel anytime during the trial with no commitment

bluejetty:00068432:ios.description:
Are You Shopping for Diamonds?
1. 4Cs Interactive Tools: Use sliding scales to compare color, clarity and cut grades and to visualize carat weight.
2. Diamond Buying Tips: Learn how to buy diamonds with our 4Cs blog articles. Know the difference between laboratory-grown and natural diamonds, and discover diamond ring lore.
3. Save and Send GIA Reports: Name and save your GIA diamond and jewelry reports. Drop someone a hint by sending your list!
4. GIA Retailer Lookup: Find local retailers that offer GIA-graded diamonds or have GIA-trained staff.
Do You Sell Diamonds?
1. Point-of-Sale Tools: Use 4Cs sliding scales to help clients understand color, clarity and cut grades and to visualize carat weight.
2. 4Cs Blog Articles: Brush up on diamond knowledge such as fluorescence and diamond treatments. Romance clients with diamond lore and refer them to our blog for diamond buying tips.
3. Diamond and Jewelry Report Check: View, save and share GIA diamond and jewelry reports with ease across multiple devices. Name your reports to keep them organized.
4. Inscription Matching: Connect to a GIA Match iD instrument to match your diamond to its authorized GIA diamond report. Once matched, the report will appear on the GIA App and can be saved and sent.
5. GIA Resources: Boost your business with our services. Sign up for our Retailer Lookup to attract local clients looking for GIA-graded diamonds. Need to have a diamond graded? Open a lab account right in the app.

bluejetty:00024070:ios.description:
Find lost AirPods, case, headphones, earbuds and other devices in seconds. Find one lost AirPod or both! Find Fitbits, Apple Pencil, Apple Watch, other Bluetooth devices
- #1 Utilities app in the App Store!
- Featured 5 times on the App Store
- Over 100,000 earbuds, headphones, and other devices found!
OVER 7,500 5 STAR RATINGS!
5/5* "You need this. Lost my AirPods in a no service area, and this app put me right on top of it. Absolutely love it, paid for itself right out of the gate. Easy to use. If you have AirPods? Then you need this" - Bullfrog74
5/5* "This helped me locate my lost AirPods really quickly. It saved me a ton of money because I thought I was going to have to buy a new pair. I love that I can play a sound to find my AirPods quickly!" - SarahBB
We have tested many brands with Find My Headphones:
• AirPods, Beats, Bose, JBL, Jaybird
• Many other wireless devices. Works with any BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy 4.0) device such as speakers, tablets, phones, hearing aids, etc
*Device must be on and emitting Bluetooth to be found. The app can't find lost earbuds in the case, or a case itself - it requires a Bluetooth signal.*
We are so confident that this scanner will find your lost earbuds, that we offer a full refund for the cost of the app if your lost device isn't found. You have nothing to lose except your device!
BENEFITS
• Find your lost AirPods, Beats, Powerbeats, Bose, Jaybird, or other headphones in seconds - not days or hours
• Works even if you lost one AirPod, can find the one lost AirPod
• Don't spend hundreds of dollars replacing your lost headphones
• Play a sound to help find my AirPods fast
• Make find my AirPods fun, not stressful. Find My Headphones uses the Cold, Warm, Hot game to find your devices
• Use this device finder any time you or your friends lose your headphones
• Very easy to use. Anyone, any age, can navigate the app. Step by step instructions included
• Fantastic app support. Contact us if you need help
Downloading the app before losing your device is not required. Download now - every minute counts before your battery runs out!
Please contact support before posting a negative review or asking questions in a review. We cannot respond to questions posted in a review. Love our app? Please leave us a 5 star review!
Bluetooth Scanner Features
• Find any wireless headphones or other device broadcasting a Bluetooth signal
• Works indoors and outdoors
• Displays the last time your device was seen by our app
• Play a sound through lost headphones to locate them quickly
• Extremely user friendly and easy to use. Technical knowledge of your devices not required!
We are not affiliated with Apple, Beats, Bose, Fitbit, and other mentioned companies in any way. We only developed and tested our app with these devices.
This app offers a subscription program for users to have unlimited access to Bluetooth device finder services
Premium:
• Subscribed user has unlimited access to the device finder services
• User can subscribe one week (USD 5.99$) or one month (USD 9.99$) or lifetime (USD 29.99$) auto renewing subscriptions

bluejetty:00045537:ios.description:
Gateway Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Gateway Banking on the Go:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Gateway Banking on the Go app, you must be enrolled as a Gateway Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00031267:ios.name: Warframe
bluejetty:00031267:ios.summary:
Awaken as an unstoppable warrior and battle alongside your friends in this story-driven free-to-play online action game
Confront warring factions throughout a sprawling interplanetary system as you follow the guidance of the mysterious Lot
bluejetty:00031267:ios.description:
Awaken as an unstoppable warrior and battle alongside your friends in this story-driven free-to-play online action game
Confront warring factions throughout a sprawling interplanetary system as you follow the guidance of the mysterious Lotus and level up your Warframe, build an Arsenal of destructive firepower, and realize your true potential across massive open worlds in this thrilling, genre-defining third-person combat experience. Carry your progression through the expansive Origin System across platforms with Cross Platform Save.
BECOME A POWERFUL WARRIOR
Enter your Warframe: a bio-metal suit of untold power. Unleash its Abilities and wield a vast array of devastating weaponry to effortlessly annihilate hordes of enemies on sight. And when the slaughter is over, you can earn or instantly unlock 50+ different Warframes - each with a unique suite of powers - to re-experience the mayhem any way you want.
BATTLE ALONGSIDE FRIENDS
Form a Squad with your friends and earn valuable bonus Rewards when you complete Missions together via highly collaborative, co-op gameplay. Utilize your Warframe’s Abilities to heal allies, redirect enemy fire, and achieve your objectives. Stuck on a particular challenge? In-game matchmaking makes it easy to connect with friendly Tenno whenever you need an extra hand.
EXPLORE A MASSIVE SYSTEM
Deftly maneuver through ground-based Missions with your Warframe’s mesmerizing parkour skills or take to the stars and engage in massive ship-to-ship battles in your very own customizable spacecraft. Lose yourself within mysterious open-world landscapes and discover a system teeming with fascinating lifeforms - both friendly and hostile.
DISCOVER AN EPIC STORY
Marvel at the sweeping history of the Origin System as you experience Warframe’s massive cinematic narrative spanning 5 separate expansions and 30+ story-based Quests. Discover the power within and experience your first taste of invincibility with one of three original Warframes before you begin your journey, develop your skills and seek out the truth behind your awakening.
MASTER YOUR ARSENAL
Your starter Weapons are just the beginning. Craft hundreds of destructive armaments, plus vehicles, Companions and more. Level them up and experiment until you find the right combination of gear that suits your unique playstyle. Fashion your weaponry for a fearsome look to compliment your custom-designed loadout.
CUSTOMIZE ENDLESSLY
Entering the Origin System means joining legions of friendly Tenno, each with their own personalized Warframes, Weapons and gear. With a staggering number of Customization options available to enhance your Loadout, designing the perfect look for your Warframe makes for an endlessly rewarding challenge for you and your Squad.
IGRS: 18+

- Customer Center: +82-1644-0088 (Weekdays 09:00–18:00, KST)

Shopping is hard. Stitch Fix makes it easy. Let us do it for you with the #1 online personal styling service for women, men and kids.
HOW IT WORKS
• GET A FIX: Take our simple style quiz to share your size, style and budget + get matches with a (real, human!) Stylist. Let your Stylist do all the shopping and send a box with picks just for you. Keep what you love, send back the rest.
• YOUR OWN SHOP: Browse and buy Stylist-approved pieces instantly in your personalized Freestyle shop, no Fix required. Find just-for-you pieces to complete your looks and explore new brands. Or start a Fix with a favorite style from your shop!
• THEMED FIXES: Choose a theme from workwear to seasonal favorites and your Stylist will personalize your Fix.
You’ll get style picked just for you from your favorite brands like Madewell, Marine Layer, Birkenstock, New Balance, Free People, Travis Mathew, The North Face, Bonobos, Untuckit, Favorite Daughter and so many more—plus brands you’ll only find at Stitch Fix.
FREE SHIPPING + NO SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED
Shipping, returns and exchanges are always free (label included). Order Fix boxes on demand, or opt for regular deliveries, it’s up to you. 
VISION: See yourself in new, Stylist-approved outfits with our exclusive AI-powered style visualization tool
STYLIST CONNECT: Need on-demand style advice? Figuring out what to wear this weekend? Chat directly with a Stylist who’s standing by to answer all your questions.
ONLINE PERSONAL STYLING FOR EVERYONE
Women’s sizes 0-24W (XS-3X) including Plus, Petite and Maternity.
Men’s sizes XS-3XL, waists 28-48 and inseams 28-36 (including Big + Tall)
Kids sizes 2T-18
Shoes + accessories for women, men + kids
Plus, Family Accounts let you add multiple profiles. Save time and shop for everyone in your family!
YOUR BUDGET, YOUR STYLE
From statement pieces to everyday items, your Stylist shops exclusively within your chosen price range. Women’s and men’s items start around $28, kids’ at $10.

bluejetty:00154177:ios.summary:

Master five distinct classes: Paladin, Necromancer, Ranger, Barbarian, Mage. From raising skeletal armies to wielding holy shields, create d
bluejetty:00154177:ios.description:
• The Paladin Joins: Five Classes Unite to Judge the Abyss! Specialization Branches × Power Matrix:
Master five distinct classes: Paladin, Necromancer, Ranger, Barbarian, Mage. From raising skeletal armies to wielding holy shields, create diverse builds and forge a layered combat system unique to this dark world.
All-Class Synergy × Conquer the Abyss:
Synergize skills across all classes: execute with holy seals, summon undead hordes, outmaneuver foes, or strike with brutal melee hits. Charge together to crush the demon horde and dominate the abyss.
• Massive Collection: Break Limits with Star-Level Power!
Collectible System × Perk Progression:
Tiered Abyss Collectibles empower your journey, with Gold Collectibles granting exclusive perks. Leverage ancient remains and treasures to build your own path of progression.
Bond Resonance × Combat Breakthrough:
Complete sets of matching categories to activate exclusive Bonds. Star levels dictate buff potency, while collection depth unlocks bonus power—creating a multi-layered matrix for long-term growth.
• Team Up & Conquer: Wipe Foes, Raid the Abyss! 
Cross-Class Synergy × Full-Screen Clear: 
Cross-class synergy: AOE, armor break, heals. Chain skills, split roles, crush hell mode, double fun! 
Squad Up × Abyss Survival: 
HP sharing and damage reduction boost survival. Farm together and chase rewards as a squad. 
• Forge High Stats: Darkgold Enhanced Legendary Weapons! 
Unique Stats × Tailored Fit: 
Darkgold Forging Core: Random star affixes make gear unique. Targeted forging locks stats to craft your endgame gear! 
Auto-Grind × Resource Vault: 
Offline progress lets heroes gather resources from lower-tier dungeons, supporting steady crafting and progression. 
• Original Builds: Break Class Barriers! 
100s of Skills × 1000s of Combos: 
Build freely with gear and skill choices to shape your playstyle. Flexible setups redefine combat and forge your unique path. 
Flexible Builds × Evolving Combat: 
Adapt to any battle with tailored skill setups and shape the flow of battle! A mix of strategy and skill makes every fight unpredictable. 
• Random Maps: Explore the Eternal Abyss! 
Random Dungeons × New Challenges: 
Diverse procedural dungeons with random terrain and monsters ensure every run is a new, extreme challenge. Explore the unknown like never before. 
Unique Mechanics × Trigger Fortuitous Dungeons: 
Every Abyss Overlord has unique mechanics. Defeat them for a chance to trigger hidden "Fortuitous Dungeons" and earn Legendary sets and exclusive cosmetics. 
• Ongoing Growth: Fast Clears and Rewarding Loot! 
Screen Clearing × CD Reduction: Flashy skills enable fast clears, while low cooldowns keep combat flowing. 
Rewarding Drops × Gear Chase: Fight through waves, collect drops, and chase powerful gear effects as your strength grows over time.

bluejetty:00177732:ios.description:
Robota.ua is your №1 job search assistant. We have the biggest vacancy base in every region of Ukraine.
Here you may find:
- Comfortable search:
Enter a position, a company or any skill into our search bar, to receive a list of proper vacancies. You can also filter them using lots of parameters if necessary.
- Recommended vacancies.
We can form a personalized selection of the best vacancies, which suit your interests perfectly. Our artificial intelligence helps us with that by analyzing your search history, vacancy views and applies.
- Simple CV-builder.
Nobody likes to type a lot of text via phone. That is why we made a simple constructor, with some hints for you. Using it, you can easily build your resume, post it in our base and get some proposals from employers.
- Your job is nearby.
With our application, you can find vacancies located nearby and spend less time getting there. Just type your address, and we will show you the nearest options.
- Vacancies on the map.
You want to see where your possible future office will be located? Maybe you want to find a job in a specific district of your city. Look through the vacancies on the map then!
- One-click application.
If you have a CV in our base at robota.ua, or, maybe, your own CV-file, you don’t need to spend time to fill in forms. Apply for a job in one-click!
- Instant notifications.
Get the notification right after the employer looks through your resume, or when a new interesting vacancy appears on the site. You just need to allow our application to send you push-notifications.
- Chat with an employer.
Get vacancy propositions and other messages from employers into the chat, directly in the application.
And many-many other things.
Robota.ua works for you!

bluejetty:00016100:ios.description:
Welcome to the official app of the Bristol Motor Speedway, bringing fans closer to the action and enriching your event experience. Get all the info you need for race day and beyond, plus exclusive content, and personalized offers and experiences. This is the beginning of a whole new mobile experience to help you find what you love whether it’s event information, special access or offers and discounts. We’ll continue to add more features in future releases–stay tuned! Powered by Uphoria.
Features include:
• Event details and information
• The latest news, photos, and videos
• Personalized offers and content
• Exclusive experience and entertainment opportunities
• Live audio of the broadcast
• Take pictures at the events using Fan Cam. Choose from exclusive overlays, share your pictures with BMS, post to social media and save to your photos.
• Fan guides
• Event schedules
• Ticket information including ability to request tickets or links to purchase
• Browse and interact with BMS Twitter and Instagram feeds right in the app
• Venue maps and directions
• Submit comments to share a great experience or suggest improvements to BMS
• View our social rewards program in Digital Colosseum
• Much more to come in future releases!

Get all the info you need for race day and beyond, plus exclusive content, and personalized offers and experiences. This is the beginning of a whole new mobile experience to help you find what you love whether it’s event information, special access or offers and discounts. We’ll continue to add more features in future releases–stay tuned! Powered by Uphoria.

Features include:

• Event details and information
• The latest news, photos, and videos
• Personalized offers and content
• Exclusive experience and entertainment opportunities
• Live audio of the broadcast
• Take pictures at the events using Fan Cam. Choose from exclusive overlays, share your pictures with BMS, post to social media and save to your photos.
• Fan guides
• Event schedules
• Ticket information including ability to request tickets or links to purchase
• Browse and interact with BMS Twitter and Instagram feeds right in the app
• Venue maps and directions
• Submit comments to share a great experience or suggest improvements to BMS
• View our social rewards program in Digital Colosseum
• Much more to come in future releases!

bluejetty:00070021:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00070021:ios.description:
Do you see yourself as the manager of your own burger restaurant?
Take the step and keep your business afloat while you feed your hungry customers!
Start running a small burger shop and work hard to earn prestige and make your reputation grow. Improve every detail and turn your modest firm into a successful one! 
Deal with the needs of your clients and make the proper decisions to expand your business wisely. Expand the kitchen, hire more staff, unlock new recipes and supervise your warehouse. 
UNLOCK MULTIPLE SERVICES:
Unlock new spots and equipment in the different departments available and increase the number of clients that you can attend (fryers, shelves, reception counters, etc.). Invest your money and resources and adapt your strategy accordingly to get the best result.
INVEST IN R&D:
As a great manager with a good vision for development, you’ll also need to invest in the future. Do some research to increase your services, furniture, or staff performance. Every department is important, and your management should take all of them into account. The more developed your restaurant is, the higher the income you will generate! Take a look at every option available in the game to make your restaurant the best franchise out there.
KEEP YOUR RESTAURANT UP TO DATE:
Maintain a good reputation by offering new recipes for everyone. Run your restaurant wisely to keep your customers satisfied and make your staff work hard to create the most exquisite burger and impeccable service.
If you like management and idle games, you will enjoy Idle Burger Tycoon! A casual easy-to-play game where strategic decisions have to be taken to manage a hamburger firm with profitable results. Develop your tasty empire starting from a small and modest restaurant into the best cooking firm and sell the best burger in town!
Bon Appétit =)
Main Features:
- Casual and strategic gameplay for every player
- Dozens of objects and ingredients to be unlocked and upgraded
- Lots of characters and interactions
- Funny 3D graphics and great animations 
- Management of a successful business
- A small living world in miniature

Born in Singapore, Stranger Soccer is now open in 10+ cities around the world, with over 100,000 games run. It can be a real hassle: finding enough players, committing to a fixed schedule, and so forth. The acclaimed Stranger Soccer App makes it as easy as going to the gym or for a jog.

There are many other great features!
Follow people you enjoy playing with. Join games they'll be playing in, and invite one another to play.
With a Stranger Soccer Membership, enjoy guaranteed savings every month.
Get your first game FREE with promo code WELCOME.

Book your Thalys, Eurostar, TGV, ICE and IC train tickets on your smartphone.
Book your international train tickets to thousands of European destinations such as London, Paris, Amsterdam and Cologne easily via the SNCB International app. Y
bluejetty:00086796:ios.description:
Book your Thalys, Eurostar, TGV, ICE and IC train tickets on your smartphone.
Book your international train tickets to thousands of European destinations such as London, Paris, Amsterdam and Cologne easily via the SNCB International app. You can now travel with your mobile train tickets on your smartphone.
BOOK YOUR INTERNATIONAL TICKETS
- Book tickets for Thalys, Eurostar, TGV, ICE and IC trains.
- With your mobile train ticket, you can travel to thousands of European destinations such as London, Paris, Amsterdam and Cologne.
- Secure payment by credit card and with the Bancontact app.
YOUR MOBILE TICKET
- Get your mobile train tickets sent straight to your smartphone in barcode form.
- View or scan your mobile train tickets (no internet connection needed).
- Download a PDF version of your ticket via the "My tickets" tab if needed.
- Exchange your train tickets at our Contact Centre using the "click-to-call" function in the “My tickets” tab (open 7 days a week).
NEW FEATURES
- Brand-new look and design.
- More info on train stations.
- Link your MyTrain account to the app! You will always have the bookings that you made online, through the Contact Center and though the app at hand! 
- Always find the lowest fares in our fare calendar
- Consult the timetables of thousands of trains in Europe and get real-time info.
- Leave a review or give feedback about the app.

bluejetty:00021608:ios.summary: Blood Pressure Tracker is a blood pressure app that helps you track and monitor your blood pressure at your convenience. You can log your BP, pulse, weight, blood glucose, blood oxygen, and more. There is also a spot for notes, so you can a
bluejetty:00021608:ios.description:
Blood Pressure Tracker is a blood pressure app that helps you track and monitor your blood pressure at your convenience. You can log your BP, pulse, weight, blood glucose, blood oxygen, and more. There is also a spot for notes, so you can add whatever additional information you need, like how you are feeling that day that may have an effect on your blood pressure, like tired, stressed, anxious, etc.
The Blood Pressure App also allows you to track your medications. Search from a list of medications, add notes, and include your dosage. This allows you to keep your list of medications with you whether it is for yourself, a loved one or healthcare professional. You can export this list of medications through a report and send to anyone.
This blood pressure app has an unlimited history and will calculate your average for you as well. Keeping track of your blood pressure over a period of time is the best way to ensure good health. Each log will also display the date and time to ensure you know when exactly you took the measurement. Blood Pressure Tracker also syncs with Apple Health to log your blood pressure and pulse data directly to the Health app!
The app also allows you to view graphs and generate custom reports. The graphs allow you to spot trends and the PDF reports allow you to share your data with anyone. You can send via text, email and more. 
Blood Pressure App is your companion app to help you against hypertension! Using a blood pressure app tracker has been shown to be effective in managing blood pressure. Some features may require a paid subscription. 
We use the Standard EULA which can be found here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
