bluejetty:00177437:ios.summary: Find oil and gas locations across the United States with ease. Get turn-by-turn directions, AS WELL AS view well data, weather forecasts, drop pins to see location name, and share well info and location coordinates with OilTrails. The only
bluejetty:00177437:ios.description:
Find oil and gas locations across the United States with ease. Get turn-by-turn directions, AS WELL AS view well data, weather forecasts, drop pins to see location name, and share well info and location coordinates with OilTrails. The only app that combines all these features with a simple yet powerful interface.
*OilTrails requires a subscription, but new subscriptions come with a 1 month, no obligation, free trial.
Supported States:
Texas
Alabama
Alaska
California
Colorado
Kansas
Louisiana
New Mexico
North Dakota
Oklahoma
Pennsylvania
Utah
Wyoming
This multifunctional lease locator app makes getting to work in the oilfield a breeze. Simply enter the legal land description, name, or API number to view the surface location OR drop a pin on the map to view location and well info (if vertical). The location can be navigated to in-app, or opened in Apple or Google maps for turn by turn navigation. Change the origin location to see step-by-step directions to location from the nearest town, useful for putting together ERPs or providing visitors directions.
No cell service? No problem. As long as turn by turn navigation is started before service is lost, the directions will continue to function so you don't have to worry about being stranded halfway to location.
Enter a location and view well information such as the operating company, depth, drill date, current status, downhole fluid, formation, and more. Data varies depending on the region.
See the current, future AND past weather specific to the location entered. Wondering if the lease is too wet or has snow to be cleared? View the precipitation the location was forecasted to receive in the past three days. Scroll for 48 hrs of hourly forecasts, 7 daily forecasts, and previous forecasts.
Maps can be shown in a variety of ways including Topographical, 3D Satellite, 2D Satellite, Dark Roads, and Light Roads.
Drop a pin on the map to see the latitude and longitude of locations.
View history of past locations viewed and date they were looked up. Makes driving logs and reports a breeze by knowing where and when you were. iCloud support syncs history between compatible devices and creates a backup.
-Turn by turn GPS navigation in-app, or use Apple or Google Maps
-Enter downhole location to view well info such as the operating company, depth, drill date, current status, -downhole fluid
-View the current weather at location as well as hourly and daily forecast AND previous forecasts to see if the location has received rain/snow is the past three days
-See location in app and view with standard, hybrid, or satellite imagery
-Store history of previously viewed wells/locations
-Share location and well info via message
-Drop pins on the map to see that location's coordinates
-International support, find wells in the United States, Canada, and Australia
*Google Maps app must be installed separately to open up locations with it
*Available well information varies by region
*Previous weather is based on previous forecasts, not what the location actually received
*The available options to look up locations varies by region
Notice: Requires an in-app subscription to be purchased. 1 month free trial to new users. Subscriptions will auto renew until cancelled. With an active subscription or Access Pass you will receive all app features.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00154477:ios.description:
Thea matches you with a real skin expert who reviews your skin, builds your personalized plan, and answers your questions.
Start with a face scan and routine review. Your expert uses your results, concerns, goals, preferences, and budget to create recommendations designed specifically for you.
YOUR PERSONAL SKIN EXPERT
Get matched with a dedicated skin expert who can:
• Review your face scan and skincare routine
• Create a personalized skin report and treatment plan
• Recommend products matched to your needs
• Answer questions about ingredients, products, and routines
• Review photos and help track your progress
• Connect you with clinical care when appropriate
Message your expert anytime and receive a response in hours, not weeks.
A PLAN BUILT FOR YOUR SKIN
Your expert considers your skin analysis, current routine, concerns, goals, sensitivities, preferences, and budget.
Get practical guidance on what to keep, what to replace, what may be missing, and which changes are most likely to make a difference.
EXPERT PRODUCT RECOMMENDATIONS
Stop guessing which products are right for you.
Your expert can send personalized recommendations directly through Thea. Each recommendation includes product information and a match score based on your skin profile.
Like or dislike recommendations so your expert can continue improving your plan.
AI-POWERED SKIN & ROUTINE ANALYSIS
Thea’s technology gives your expert a clearer starting point.
Scan your face to receive personalized scores for hydration, blemishes, complexion, visible aging, and more. Add your current products to identify ingredient conflicts, missing steps, overuse, and routine gaps.
The AI supports your expert—it does not replace them.
PRESCRIPTION CARE WHEN NEEDED
Some concerns may need more than over-the-counter skincare.
When appropriate, your skin expert can connect you with an online clinical consultation for prescription-strength treatment. A licensed provider reviews your information and determines whether treatment or a prescription is appropriate.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Check in over time, update your expert, and see how your skin responds to your plan.
Your recommendations can evolve as your skin, routine, preferences, and goals change.
THEA BRINGS TOGETHER
• A real, matched skin expert
• Personalized skin reports and treatment plans
• Direct expert messaging
• AI-powered face and routine analysis
• Product recommendations and match scores
• Progress tracking
• Access to online clinical care when appropriate
Some skin expert, AI, and clinical care features require an additional purchase or subscription. Prescription care is subject to provider approval, eligibility, and availability in your location.
LEGAL
Thea does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Skin experts do not prescribe medication. Only a licensed healthcare professional can provide medical advice, diagnose a condition, or prescribe treatment.
Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before beginning a new skincare routine, using a new product, or making a medical decision.
Privacy Policy: https://www.hellothea.ai/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.hellothea.ai/terms

bluejetty:00147150:ios.name: PerfectServe Clinical Collab
bluejetty:00147150:ios.summary: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration is an enterprise cloud-based communications platform built specifically for healthcare. Our solution provides secure HIPAA compliant texting, an answering service, pager replacement, on-call schedules, a
bluejetty:00147150:ios.description:
PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration is an enterprise cloud-based communications platform built specifically for healthcare. Our solution provides secure HIPAA compliant texting, an answering service, pager replacement, on-call schedules, and clinical integration with the EMR all on one easy to use platform. 
Note: You must have an account enabled on PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration before you can use this application.
Main functions of our offering include:
• Communications: Our mobile applications allow for real-time texting and voice communication between clinicians. Multimedia messaging with photos, voice, and attachments are supported as are the ability to record and deliver voicemails when clinicians are busy with patients.
• Reliable Messaging: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration provides a persistent and reliable messaging layer that is able to deliver time sensitive messages to users on a multitude of delivery channels. PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration detects when a user’s device has data connectivity issues, and routes the message accordingly based on a user’s network conditions and availability.
• Directory Integration: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration is seamlessly deployed and managed through the organizations existing Microsoft Active Directory Infrastructure.
• Call Center Integration: The ability to send messages from the existing call center software and systems allows for rapid deployment with minimal disruption to existing call center workflow.
• On Call Scheduling: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration has the leading on-call scheduling platform, including escalations, shared schedules, round-robin load balancing based on provider load, and more. In addition, we are the only communications platform that provides real-time integration with Amion, QGenda, Tangiers, as well as home grown and legacy scheduling platforms.
• Phone System Integration: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration integrates with both SIP based and legacy (non SIP based) hospital phone platforms. We are the only communications provider that is able to support a transition strategy from legacy circuit switch PBX systems to the SIP domain. Make and receive calls on your iOS device using VoIP as an extension of the hospital phone platform.

listings.name: PerfectServe Clinical Collab
listings.description:
PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration is an enterprise cloud-based communications platform built specifically for healthcare.  Our solution provides secure HIPAA compliant texting, an answering service, pager replacement, on-call schedules, and clinical integration with the EMR all on one easy to use platform. 

Note: You must have an account enabled on PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration before you can use this application.

Main functions of our offering include:

• Communications: Our mobile applications allow for real-time texting and voice communication between clinicians.  Multimedia messaging with photos, voice, and attachments are supported as are the ability to record and deliver voicemails when clinicians are busy with patients.

• Reliable Messaging: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration provides a persistent and reliable messaging layer that is able to deliver time sensitive messages to users on a multitude of delivery channels.  PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration detects when a user’s device has data connectivity issues, and routes the message accordingly based on a user’s network conditions and availability.

• Directory Integration: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration is seamlessly deployed and managed through the organizations existing Microsoft Active Directory Infrastructure.

• Call Center Integration:  The ability to send messages from the existing call center software and systems allows for rapid deployment with minimal disruption to existing call center workflow.

• On Call Scheduling: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration has the leading on-call scheduling platform, including escalations, shared schedules, round-robin load balancing based on provider load, and more.  In addition, we are the only communications platform that provides real-time integration with Amion, QGenda, Tangiers, as well as home grown and legacy scheduling platforms.

• Phone System Integration: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration integrates with both SIP based and legacy (non SIP based) hospital phone platforms.  We are the only communications provider that is able to support a transition strategy from legacy circuit switch PBX systems to the SIP domain. Make and receive calls on your iOS device using VoIP as an extension of the hospital phone platform.

• Clinical Integration: PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration provides Patient Centric Messaging – the ability to track all messages against a patient and have two-way synchronization with the EMR.

• Nurse Mobility: Existing nurse call systems can be mobilized for nurses through integration with room alarms as well as patient assignments.

bluejetty:00187195:ios.description:
Square Point of Sale (POS) is the all-in-one payments processing app designed for any business. Whether you’re a retail, a restaurant, or a service business, you’ll have all the features you need to run your business at your fingertips. 
Select from multiple modes tailored to your industry to simplify business operations, to deliver exceptional customer experiences, and to boost your bottom line.
Take any payment
Accept payments in person, online, or over the phone. Let customers pay with all major credit cards, debit cards, cash, digital wallets, QR codes, payment links, Cash App Pay, Tap to Pay on iPhone, and gift cards.
Get started quickly
Whether you’re a new business or looking to switch your point of sale system, we make it fast and easy to get started. Receive recommendations for a POS solution that aligns with your business needs, ensuring you’re set from the start.
Choose your mode
Access multiple POS modes equipped with unique settings, features, and functionalities for different business needs.
•For all businesses: Set up instantly to start taking payments and manage your business. 
- Free point-of-sale system
- Real-time reports in Dashboard
- Inventory management
•For restaurants: Access management tools designed for full-service restaurants, quick-service restaurants, and bars. 
- Quick order entry
- Order-ready mobile text
- Course and seat management (iPad only)
- Preauthorized bar tabs (iPad only)
•For retail: Track inventory, customer orders, and sales effortlessly in-store or online.
- Advanced inventory tools
- Multichannel selling 
- Customer profiles
•For beauty: Simplify scheduling and appointments.
- 24/7 online booking
- No-show protection
- Automated reservation reminders
•For services: Manage appointments, send invoices, and accept payments effortlessly.
- Invoices and estimates
- Contracts
- Project management
Download the Square Point of Sale today and explore how Square can grow with you — from fostering customer relationships and managing staff to accessing advanced reporting and offering integrated banking solutions.

bluejetty:00142462:ios.description:
每天读点故事APP坚持“原生、奇崛、动人”的内容主张，注重”故事创作素材“的原生性、“情理之中意料之外“的戏剧性、“能触动人”的情绪关联性，内容主打女性悬疑惊悚、现实情感、浪漫言情、国风幻想、职业故事等类型化文学。
【短剧】
每天读点故事APP自2021年以来着重在短剧赛道发力，与多家头部影视公司合作并开辟短剧、微短剧多种体量合作模式，已成功授权独家签约作品《情难自控》、《悬溺》、《胭脂围城》、《匿名短信》、《初恋物语：爱在屋檐下》等数十部作品进行短剧开发，其中由《情难自控》改编快手短剧《前方高能》平台播放量超3亿次。
【电影】
平台凭借在现实、悬疑、幻想等类型内容方向的深耕，以及中短篇文学作品改编电影的天然优势和大量储备。和国内知名导演、制片以及电影公司积极建立合作，目前已成功授权《无畏布施》、《赛博神话：祸乱时期的爱情》、《行者》、《过冬》、《行镖》、《奇物志：日抛脸》、《超完美杀人案》、《大话西游之八十二难》等多部独家签约作品进行电影开发。
【出版】
读点APP已与多家出版文化公司和出版社达成合作，已成功授权《她从梦里来》《京城情报司》《影帝他总想对我图谋不轨》《宇宙留言》《羲河传》《神探太子妃》《凡人笔谈》《风水师报君知》《裁员专家》等数十部独家签约类型作品进行实体书出版，其中《愿所有的姑娘都能嫁给爱情》是由读点APP和出版方联合征文的获奖作品集结成书。
【网剧】
平台积极探索类型小说的影视化可能，与业内多家影视公司达成合作，已成功授权《徙鸟迷途》《前夫的前妻》《裁员专家》《世界末日的那一年》《拜见仙君大人》《影帝他总想对我图谋不轨》《神探太子妃》《天增顺》等数十部独家签约类型作品进行真人网剧改编。
【我们的团队】
我们正在重新定义网络文学。 自每天读点故事创立以来，我们已赢得了上千万读者的青睐。 团队成员始终怀揣着这样的愿景： 通过发现和创造好故事，丰富人们的内心世界，让生活更加美好。
我们以发现原生、奇崛、动人的故事作导向，我们相信，故事有改变世界的力量。
每天读点故事创始成员分别来自字节跳动、人人网等互联网公司，以及博集天卷、知音漫客等出版团队，具有多年资深行业经验。

listings.description:
每天读点故事APP坚持“原生、奇崛、动人”的内容主张，注重”故事创作素材“的原生性、“情理之中意料之外“的戏剧性、“能触动人”的情绪关联性，内容主打女性悬疑惊悚、现实情感、浪漫言情、国风幻想、职业故事等类型化文学。
【短剧】
每天读点故事APP自2021年以来着重在短剧赛道发力，与多家头部影视公司合作并开辟短剧、微短剧多种体量合作模式，已成功授权独家签约作品《情难自控》、《悬溺》、《胭脂围城》、《匿名短信》、《初恋物语：爱在屋檐下》等数十部作品进行短剧开发，其中由《情难自控》改编快手短剧《前方高能》平台播放量超3亿次。
【电影】
平台凭借在现实、悬疑、幻想等类型内容方向的深耕，以及中短篇文学作品改编电影的天然优势和大量储备。和国内知名导演、制片以及电影公司积极建立合作，目前已成功授权《无畏布施》、《赛博神话：祸乱时期的爱情》、《行者》、《过冬》、《行镖》、《奇物志：日抛脸》、《超完美杀人案》、《大话西游之八十二难》等多部独家签约作品进行电影开发。
【出版】
读点APP已与多家出版文化公司和出版社达成合作，已成功授权《她从梦里来》《京城情报司》《影帝他总想对我图谋不轨》《宇宙留言》《羲河传》《神探太子妃》《凡人笔谈》《风水师报君知》《裁员专家》等数十部独家签约类型作品进行实体书出版，其中《愿所有的姑娘都能嫁给爱情》是由读点APP和出版方联合征文的获奖作品集结成书。
【网剧】
平台积极探索类型小说的影视化可能，与业内多家影视公司达成合作，已成功授权《徙鸟迷途》《前夫的前妻》《裁员专家》《世界末日的那一年》《拜见仙君大人》《影帝他总想对我图谋不轨》《神探太子妃》《天增顺》等数十部独家签约类型作品进行真人网剧改编。

【我们的团队】
我们正在重新定义网络文学。 自每天读点故事创立以来，我们已赢得了上千万读者的青睐。 团队成员始终怀揣着这样的愿景： 通过发现和创造好故事，丰富人们的内心世界，让生活更加美好。
我们以发现原生、奇崛、动人的故事作导向，我们相信，故事有改变世界的力量。
每天读点故事创始成员分别来自字节跳动、人人网等互联网公司，以及博集天卷、知音漫客等出版团队，具有多年资深行业经验。

bluejetty:00033787:ios.description:

Planner app is almost like a paper planner on iPad, but is designed to be more flexible to use than papers.

bluejetty:00140344:ios.description:
Music & Video Finder: Booster is a versatile app for music, podcasts, videos, and song recognition. Listen to local audio files, access your Apple Music library, find videos on YouTube, and use the app in your car with CarPlay.
CarPlay:
- listen to local tracks and playlists.
- stream podcasts online or play downloaded episodes offline.
- access your Apple Music library and radio stations with an active subscription.
- view artwork and information about the current track.
- control the playback queue.
- add the current song to a playlist.
- select equalizer presets for local music.
Podcasts:
- browse popular podcasts.
- search by title or topic.
- add podcasts to favorites.
- browse episodes and detailed information.
- listen online.
- download episodes for offline listening.
- switch between episodes within a podcast.
Local music and audio files:
- import files from various sources.
- create and manage local playlists.
- play multiple audio formats.
- listen without an internet connection.
- use a 10-band equalizer and ready-made audio presets.
- boost the volume of supported audio files.
- convert audio to MP3 and other supported formats.
- automatically select the appropriate audio player.
Apple Music:
An active Apple Music subscription and service availability in your region are required.
- browse and play your personal music library.
- search the Apple Music catalog.
- browse songs, albums, artists, and playlists.
- create and update playlists.
- add songs to favorites.
- explore music recommendations.
- listen to radio stations and genre stations.
- save your favorite radio stations.
YouTube:
- search for music videos and other content.
- view video and channel information.
- browse related video recommendations.
- sign in to your account.
- create and update playlists.
- add videos to favorites.
- like and dislike videos.
- browse channels and manage subscriptions.
- use a video player with automatic and manual quality selection.
- access your search history.
Music recognition:
- quickly identify music playing around you.
- recognize songs using the microphone.
- open the identified song in Apple Music.
- find a matching video on YouTube.
- get additional links for the artist and song.
Tone generator:
- generate sound at a selected frequency.
- test audio equipment.
- check the supported frequency range.
- help adjust the equalizer for your audio equipment.
An internet connection is required for online services. The availability of individual features depends on your region, Apple Music subscription, and content sources.

Privacy policy: https://appsupport.store/privacy/

Of course, our app will also help you find the Newk’s Eatery location nearest you, wherever you may be.

bluejetty:00031253:ios.description:
A smile to be beautiful, you need to take good care of your teeth! Is being a dentist your dream job? Come to play at Angelia Cat Dentist's dental salon! Experience the work of a dentist, manage a dental salon to clean and care for little animals' teeth! Become an excellent dentist!
CLEAN TEETH
Tom Cat's teeth are so dirty! Food debris is stuck to her teeth: candies, vegetables...help her clean them up! Take out a magnifying glass and find the dirty debris on the teeth. Remove candies and vegetable debris to finish the cleaning! Don't forget to brush teeth thoroughly!
REMNOVE DECAYED TEETH
Tooth moths are coming for attack! Ginger Shiba's teeth have been attacked! Are you ready? Remove decayed teeth and beat the tooth moths! Observe carefully. Which tooth has cavity? Remove the decayed tooth, clean the cavity, kill the bacteria, and replace with a new tooth! Give it a try and see if you can successfully beat the tooth moths.
FIX TEETH
As a dentist, it's time for you to show your talents! Help the Becca Bunny to fix his teeth. Polish the chipped teeth. Fill in with dentures of the same shape as the chipped teeth. The teeth will be fixed soon! You are awesome! You are indeed an excellent dentist!
So what are you waiting for? Hurry up and care for their teeth! All you need is to download games, install and start playing, and in the future your child can choose one of the most needed professions in the world - the dentist.

bluejetty:00016096:ios.description:
Welcome to “Bricks Ball Crusher”! Bricks Ball Crusher is a classic brick game popular all over the world.
As one of the world's top brick games, Bricks Ball Crusher will provide you with infinite fun. The game contains tens of thousands of well-designed levels and over 200 skill blocks and skill balls for you to explore, as well as different challenge modes, such as "lifesaving mode". What are you waiting for? Try to use the powerful skill ball to aim at and shoot bricks, to experience the magical elimination world.
In the process of playing Bricks Ball Crusher, you can unlock various mysterious skill balls with levels upgrading, discover more hidden playing methods, and even participate in the design of your own unique level to enjoy creation with other global players. If you need a casual game to kill time and relieve pressure, come to Bricks Ball Crusher to eliminate troubles and create happiness!
Introduction to normal mode:
- The ball will fly in any direction you touch
- Find the best position and angle to hit each brick 
- Complete the mission by breaking bricks on the screen

bluejetty:00041280:ios.description:
Progress is the best body measurement tracking app for iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad.
Track the measurements and photos that matter. Stay motivated on your weight-loss journey.
You want to make a positive change, and you want to actually see it happening. Progress tracks your body measurements, weight, BMI, body fat, and progress photos in one place, so you can watch your real story unfold week by week. No judgement, no pressure, no aggressive fitness talk. Just a clear picture of how far you've come.
Since 2012, tens of thousands of people have reached their weight-loss goals with Progress, and you can too.
TRACK MORE THAN WEIGHT
The number on the scales isn't the only one that matters. Track waist, hips, chest, arms, thighs, body fat, BMI, and anything else that helps you see your progress. Build a fuller picture of your body, not just a single number.
PROGRESS PHOTOS
Before and after photos make small changes feel real. Take a photo whenever you like, compare any two side by side, and watch the story your body is telling. Photos stay private on your device.
BMI CALCULATOR & TRACKER
Calculate your BMI in seconds and watch how it changes over time. We'll show you where you sit, without the lecture.
BODY FAT TRACKING
Log body fat percentage and follow it as your body composition shifts. Useful when the scales aren't moving but you can feel things changing.
WEIGHT LOSS TRACKER
Whether you're losing, gaining, or maintaining, clean charts and gentle reminders help you stay focused on the journey, not just the destination.
GOALS THAT FIT YOUR LIFE
Set a weight goal, a measurement goal, or no goal at all. Progress works for every kind of journey, whatever you're working towards.
APPLE HEALTH
Sync seamlessly with Apple Health, so your numbers stay up to date without extra work.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your measurements, photos, and notes stay yours. We don't track you, share your data, or show ads.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What can I track in Progress?
Weight, body fat, BMI, waist, hips, chest, arms, thighs, neck, calves, and any other measurement that matters to you. You can also add progress photos and notes.
Is Progress a BMI calculator?
Yes. Progress is a full BMI calculator and tracker. Enter your height and weight and we'll calculate your BMI, then track how it changes over time.
Can I compare before and after photos?
Yes. Take progress photos any time and compare any two side by side. It's the easiest way to see changes the scales might miss.
Does Progress sync with Apple Health?
Yes, two-way, so your weight and measurements stay in sync with the rest of your health data.
Is Progress free?
Yes, you can start tracking for free. Pro unlocks progress photos, unlimited measurement areas, custom reports, past-data entry, and more.
Will I be judged for my weight or my goals?
Never. Progress is body positive by design. Every body is different and every goal is valid, whether you're losing weight, gaining muscle, or just want to understand your body better.
How is Progress different from a regular weight tracker?
A weight tracker shows you one number. Progress shows you the whole picture: weight, body measurements, body fat, BMI, and photos, all in one place. When the scales aren't moving, your measurements and photos often tell you they are.
Is my data private?
Yes. Your measurements and photos are stored privately on your device and synced through your own iCloud. We don't sell, share, or look at your data.
Can I use Progress without a goal?
Yes. Set a goal if it helps you stay motivated, or just track for understanding. Both are valid.
Track your measurements, achieve your goals. We're in your corner.
Progress integrates with the Health app. This feature is free and optional.
Progress Pro is a subscription service.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://theprogressapp.com/terms.pdf
Privacy policy: https://theprogressapp.com/privacy.pdf

Your dog pulls on the leash? Barks at visitors? Doesn't come when you call? You're not alone. And you don't need expensive obedience classes to fix it.
All you need is a plan that fits the two of you.
Hundeo builds you a personal training plan and shows you one exercise each day - matched to your dog, their age, and your goals. Short videos, simply explained, ready to use right away. No experience needed.
What changes after a few weeks
Your dog responds to basic commands. Walks become more relaxed. You understand why your dog behaves the way they do - and you know what to do about it. Your bond grows with every session.
Instant help for any question
Your puppy chews on everything? Your dog eats things off the ground? Ask the Hundeo Coach and get a clear answer. Any time, as often as you want.
Training that fits your life
No fixed schedule, no commute, no group pressure. Train on the couch in the morning or at the park in the evening. Hundeo adapts to you, not the other way around.
More than an app
30+ expert courses from dog trainers and vets. 500+ tricks, games, recipes, and guides. 2,500 quiz questions with trophies. 300+ dog breed profiles. Clicker and dog whistle built right in.
Hundeo on Apple Watch: log walks, feeding, training and potty breaks in your journal right from your wrist. Practice what you’ve learned in short sessions, with the clicker always at hand. Your watch face shows when your dog last peed, plus your streak. Start a walk on your iPhone and the timer runs on your watch too. The watch app uses your Hundeo account from your iPhone, so there’s no separate sign-in.
Start for free. No risk, no commitment.

bluejetty:00179551:ios.name: Rummy 500: Card Game
bluejetty:00179551:ios.summary: Rummy 500 (sometimes known as 500 Rum, Pinochle Rummy, Persian Rummy or 500 Rummy) is the classic skill based strategy card game you can enjoy offline against smart AI, online with players from around the world, or in private games play wit
bluejetty:00179551:ios.description:
Rummy 500 (sometimes known as 500 Rum, Pinochle Rummy, Persian Rummy or 500 Rummy) is the classic skill based strategy card game you can enjoy offline against smart AI, online with players from around the world, or in private games play with friends and family.
Rummy 500 brings a classic card game experience built around sets, runs, sequences, and smart decisions. Reach 500 total net points by creating valid melds and managing every card you draw. Play Rummy against AI when you want a challenging solo session without an internet connection. Choose offline play for relaxed matches or online games when you want to compete with other players. The standard 52-card pack creates familiar gameplay while giving every round a different challenge. Build sets of three or four cards with the same number and create runs of three or more cards in the same suit.
Carefully watch the discard pile because the right card can complete your next sequence. Draw from the stock or take a card from deeper in the discard pile when the opportunity is worth the risk. When taking from the discard pile, all cards above your selected card must be collected. The selected card must immediately become part of a set or be laid off on an existing set. Lay down your melds during your turn and add suitable cards to combinations already on the table.Aces can work high or low, but sequences cannot go around the corner from King to Ace to 2. Every card placed on the table can increase your score, while cards left in your hand can reduce it The round ends as soon as a player gets rid of all their cards, making the timing of your final move important. The first player to reach a net score of +500 wins the match. If several players reach the target during the same hand, the highest final score determines the winner.
# Play Your Way
Enjoy Rummy offline against smart AI for a focused single-player challenge. Take your game online when you want a more social card experience with other players.
Challenge friends and family in 2 PLAYER, 3 PLAYER, or 4 PLAYER matches. Play with friends, compare your scores, and discover who can reach the target first.
Free to play sessions make it easy to enjoy a quick match whenever you have time. The gameplay combines casual accessibility with strategy, memory, timing, and careful risk management. Use each discard to gather information about what your opponents may be collecting. A strong strategy can turn an ordinary hand into a winning combination through well-timed melds.
# Why Players Love Rummy 500
1. 2, 3, 4 player card game 
2. Online Multiplayer Card Game — Compete against players from around the world in engaging multiplayer matches
3. Private Tables with Friends — Create private tables and enjoy a personal card game with friends
4. Brand-New Rummy 200 Quick Mode — Try a faster scoring format when you want a shorter and more dynamic match
5. Offline Play with Bot AI — Continue playing against computer opponents even without an internet connection
6. Daily Rewards and Spin Wheel Coins — Return every day to collect rewards and try your luck with the spin wheel
7. Global Leaderboards — Track your progress and compete for a place among the best players
# Build Your Winning Hand
Choose your cards carefully, because every draw can open one possibility while closing another.Keep useful cards available for future combinations while avoiding unnecessary high-value cards in your hand.Watch the table, remember discarded cards, and decide when collecting from the pile is worth the extra cards.Whether you prefer a relaxed solo match, a competitive online session, or a game with friends, each round offers a new challenge.Test your strategy, improve your timing, and work toward the 500-point finish one meld at a time.Play the classic rules, create your best combinations, and see whether you can become the top Rummy 500 player.
Download now and experience the authentic fun of the traditional 500 Rummy card game.

bluejetty:00023952:ios.name: GPS Altimeter - Altitude & Map
bluejetty:00023952:ios.summary: Altimeter is a smart tracking devices, used to altitude measure. It is perfect app for people who love hiking, skiing, mountain biking and other outdoor activities. Any time and with high precision you can check altitude, elevation or local
bluejetty:00023952:ios.description:
Altimeter is a smart tracking devices, used to altitude measure. It is perfect app for people who love hiking, skiing, mountain biking and other outdoor activities. Any time and with high precision you can check altitude, elevation or localization coordinates. It works online and offline.
This altimeter app, to measure altitude uses: 
- GPS satellites triangulation - works without internet connection, 
- barometer pressure sensor (if available in your device) - high accurate data; if internet connection is available it calibrates itself to improve accuracy, 
- online networks location services (wifi and other) - need internet connection.
You can use each sensor separate or all together.
App altitude meter includes the following features:
- accurate measurement of altitude - indication in meters or feet
- recording sports activities with a map of the route traveled
- record of: lowest (low), highest (max) altitude
- smart mini compass
- full GPS coordinates - latitude and longitude
- current localization name and state
- results of measurements are shown in the chart
- ability to stop and record the results of measurements at any time
- invert background color (black and white)
- sharing with others your achievements (photo taking function with the current altitude above sea level)
You can activate in app the Premium version which includes:
- No ads in the entire application
- Activity stats (speed, calories, etc.)
- Checkpoints
- Analog drum-type aircraft altimeter
- Full history and archives of measurements
- Tracking map with altitude chart
- Sunrise and sunset times
- No watermark on the picture
- Copying and sharing coordinates and map link
Check altitude wherever you are!
Information:
This apps works in the background to proper operation uses GPS. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Enjoy with this altimeter app !

bluejetty:00175561:ios.description:
This epic survival game finds you and your raft alone on an ocean full of dangers and mysteries. Your only objective is to survive, but remember – there are more dangerous things than thirst and hunger at sea! Collect resources, build your raft, research and craft items, explore islands and fight for your life. Don’t let your guard down – zombies, sharks, mutant crabs and other enemies will do their best to put an end your adventure!
Features:
First things first: find water and food to stay alive. It isn’t as simple as getting them from the ocean – you’ll have to find a way to collect water and cook food.
Build your raft, collect resources from the ocean and islands, craft vital items and equipment using the advanced crafting system and find unique recipes on islands. Become a real survivor!
The weather is both your friend and your enemy. Try to adapt to different weather conditions and see how they influence characters.
World map. The ocean is huge! Start off your adventure by exploring islands and all the mysteries and dangers they hide. Every island has its own story to tell to those who listen...
Danger is everywhere. Fight for your life against sharks, zombies, mutant crabs and many other threats. Zombie sharks never miss the scent of blood...
Graphics. Epic Ocean Survival colourful graphics set it apart from other survival games.

bluejetty:00076179:ios.name: Stock Trading AI : SharePreds
bluejetty:00076179:ios.summary:
SharePreds brings AI stock predictions, penny stocks, stock price alerts, technical analysis and stock market news together in one app for U.S. stocks and ETFs.
AI STOCK PREDICTIONS EVERY MARKET DAY
Each market day our AI model gives a sto
bluejetty:00076179:ios.description:
SharePreds brings AI stock predictions, penny stocks, stock price alerts, technical analysis and stock market news together in one app for U.S. stocks and ETFs.
AI STOCK PREDICTIONS EVERY MARKET DAY
Each market day our AI model gives a stock its likelihood of rising over the next 10 days, with its last five days beside it. Top predictions ranks today's stocks among the largest U.S. companies, by sector and by market value, so you see at once which stocks are most likely to rise. Predictions are indicative: they rest on price and volume data, and they can be wrong.
PENNY STOCKS AND AI PORTFOLIOS
Follow how AI predictions do in the AI, Penny and Trend portfolios. Each one is a simulation that shows the cumulative result on a time axis, profit or loss, from each prediction's own targets and before fees and other trading costs. Real trades can differ.
STOCK PRICE ALERTS AND PREDICTION ALERTS
Set a price and get an alert when the stock reaches it. Hear about a new prediction on a stock you follow, its target or stop being reached, a bullish or bearish signal, or a move of at least 5% in a day. Switch each kind on or off, for all your stocks or stock by stock, or choose Fewer notifications.
STOCK CHARTS AND TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Candlestick charts up to a year on any stock or ETF, with moving averages, Bollinger bands, volume, MACD and RSI, and a crosshair to read any day. What the numbers say puts a stock's data in plain lines: where the price stands against its averages, its RSI zone, its volume against its 20 day average, and where it sits in its year.
BULLISH AND BEARISH STOCK SIGNALS
Each market day, technical indicators flag the stocks whose price crossed a moving average, whose shorter moving average crossed a longer one, or whose MACD crossed its signal line. These signals come from the indicators and are separate from the AI predictions.
SECTOR PREDICTIONS AND MARKET BAROMETER
Sector predictions show where each part of the market leans. The market barometer shows which way the day's predictions lean, as a 5 day average or day by day, with each line on or off and a finger to read any day. Market movers lists the largest rises and falls and the most traded stocks. Market hours and the next open are shown in your own time.
STOCK WATCHLIST AND HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Follow any stock with a star. Prices and the day's change refresh every minute while the market is open, each with the time the data is from. Add the widget to see your stocks without opening the app.
STOCK MARKET NEWS WITH SENTIMENT
The latest articles on the market and on each stock, with the sentiment the news source gives it and its reason. Insider buys and sells from SEC filings sit beside a stock's other data.
PAST PREDICTIONS AND THEIR RESULTS
Every closed prediction stays in the app with the day it was published, its prices and how it ended. Search the record by stock, month and outcome. A stock's own screen shows how its earlier predictions ended.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
SharePreds is an analysis tool for information and education. Nothing in the app is financial, investment or trading advice. Predictions can be wrong, and past results do not guarantee future results. All investing carries the risk of losing some or all of your capital.

bluejetty:00042426:ios.name: Ash - AI for Mental Health
bluejetty:00042426:ios.summary: Ash is an AI built from the ground up for mental health and emotional support. Whether you need support for stress, anxiety, relationships, family problems or a bad day, Ash can help right now with a private, zero judgment space to speak fr
bluejetty:00042426:ios.description:
Ash is an AI built from the ground up for mental health and emotional support. Whether you need support for stress, anxiety, relationships, family problems or a bad day, Ash can help right now with a private, zero judgment space to speak freely. Ash is built for long-term growth, learning from your patterns and building a program to help you reach the goals you want. Each week, get personalized insights to help you understand yourself more deeply and move forward with clarity.
How is Ash built?
Most AI tools were built using data from the internet. Ash is a specialist AI in human psychology trained on a large-scale data set of proprietary expert data, and is designed and guided by an expert team of the world’s top mental health leaders. Use Ash AI for motivation, accountability, support, reflection, encouragement, pattern-breaking, or a catalyst for change.
What outcomes have you seen from people who downloaded Ash?
For users who speak to Ash a few times a week or more:
- 91% made progress or met goals they set for themselves
- On average, users have about one more meaningful real-world relationship
*Based on an ongoing research study
What does Ash do?
Ash gives you a secure space where you can share your unfiltered thoughts without fear of judgement. It remembers what you say, and learns from your interactions to find patterns and generate insights specific to you. It’s available 24/7 over voice & text, so you can use it for a quick check-in or longer deep dive.
Who made Ash?
Ash is built by a team of therapists, mental health leaders, AI researchers, engineers, and designers. Our work is inspired by our personal stories, lived experience, and loved ones on similar journeys. We believe in a future where quality personalized support is available exactly when people need it.
Features of Ash
No judgment: Say what you really feel, and get professional guidance.
Weekly insights: Ash helps identify themes and patterns of your life.
Long-term growth: Ash is designed to help you do the hard work for real change.
24/7, speak or text: Talk to Ash at home, or text Ash in an Uber.
Privacy-first design: Speak with the confidence that your chats are secure and anonymous.
A fully personalized program: Ash learns from and builds custom support for each person. Get the precise modalities and therapeutic style that you need right now.
Testimonials
- “As a therapist myself, I’m really impressed by this app!”
- “The weekly insights is the best part of this app. Ash spotted patterns of my thoughts in ways I've never considered. And the next steps have given me ways to grow. This is extremely helpful.”
- “I cried so hard. It’s so relieving to express myself freely.”
- “My strengths are all being pointed out and I really appreciate it. I've been thinking I'm not real great at anything. I really needed this.”
- “I'm actually finding support in this app in a way that feels private, useful and keeps my sense of self-respect. I don't go around telling other people about what's going on so it's very nice.”
- “Fantastic! We solved a problem I have been dealing with for a week in 5 minutes.”
Ash is designed for users 18+. Ash sometimes makes things up. Ash is not a replacement for any medical diagnosis or treatments. Ash cannot, and does not intend to, provide medical advice or diagnosis. Interaction with Ash does not constitute a medical professional–patient relationship. Please do not avoid or delay medical attention as a result of a statement from Ash.
Ash is not designed to be used in crisis. If you are in crisis, please seek out professional help, or a crisis line. You can find resources at www.findahelpline.com.

bluejetty:00014719:ios.description:
Shopify POS unifies your online and retail stores to strengthen sales conversions everywhere you sell, streamline store management, and help you build stronger relationships with your customers. It has all the essential features you need to make sales, track performance, and manage customers, orders, and inventory. With local pickup and delivery — and the ability to sell from other locations — you can reach more customers and give them seamless shopping experiences.
Learn why retailers using Shopify grow revenue by 30% year over year by unifying online and in-store sales.
CHECKOUT’S BEST FRIEND
• Take your smartphone or tablet to your customer—and sell anywhere in-store. 
• Securely accept all major credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay, and cash.
• Process all credit cards at the same low rate with no hidden fees with Shopify Payments. 
• Automatically apply the correct sales tax at checkout based on your store’s location.
• Collect customer contacts with SMS and email receipts.
• Customize printed receipts with your website URL, store hours, promotions, or store policies.
• Save carts and retrieve them later to continue serving other customers quickly. 
• Create discounts and promo codes that span your ecommerce and retail business.
• Scan product barcode labels with the camera on your phone or tablet.
• Identify store staff that helped with a sale to keep track of performance.
• Integrate barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more.
MAKE THE SALE EVERY TIME—FROM ONLINE TO CHECKOUT LINE
• Email carts to customers to remind them of their in-store favorites so they can buy online.
• Track all pickup orders from your online store and notify customers when they’re ready. 
• Sell inventory available at other locations and automatically calculate the right shipping rates at checkout.
TURN ONE-TIME CUSTOMERS INTO LIFETIME FANS
• Easily exchange and return items purchased online or at other locations.
• Create fully-synced customer profiles so staff can give every customer a personal shopping experience with quick access to notes, lifetime spend, and order history. 
• Add loyalty apps to your POS to reward customers for shopping with you, both in-store and online.
• Create personalized marketing campaigns via email and social media in your Shopify admin. 
STREAMLINE OPERATIONS
• Manage one product catalogue and sync inventory so it’s available for online and in-person selling. 
• Create staff login PINs to secure access and track activity.
• Use customizable role-based permissions to give staff the right level of access. 
• Make informed decisions with insights on your store’s daily sales performance.
• Track payments to hold staff accountable for transactions by payment types and cash handled.
• Adapt to growing trends in your business with unified analytics that blend in-store and online sales in your Shopify admin
• Generate purchase orders and transfer stock based on inventory forecasts and performance.
"It’s impossible to think of retail as separate. You have to be able to bring the physical into the digital, and the digital into the physical...this idea of unified retail is the future.”
Juliana Di Simone, Tokyobike
Questions?
We'd love to learn more about your business and how we can help.
https://help.shopify.com/

bluejetty:00019557:ios.summary: De ANWB Onderweg app is alles-in-één app voor je autorit. De app heeft alles wat je onderweg nodig hebt: navigeren met informatie over files, flitsers en werkzaamheden, goedkoop parkeren, actuele benzineprijzen en beschikbaarheid van laadpa
bluejetty:00019557:ios.description:
De ANWB Onderweg app is alles-in-één app voor je autorit. De app heeft alles wat je onderweg nodig hebt: navigeren met informatie over files, flitsers en werkzaamheden, goedkoop parkeren, actuele benzineprijzen en beschikbaarheid van laadpalen.
De functionaliteiten in deze app:
• Betrouwbare navigatie 
Plan een route en bekijk voor je in de onderweg gaat waar je kunt tanken, laden of parkeren op jouw route of bestemming. Bekijk waar je het best en goedkoop kunt parkeren en stel deze parkeerplaats direct in als eindbestemming. Wil je onderweg tanken? De app toont alle tankstations inclusief prijzen op of langs jouw route. Voeg eenvoudig het tankstation naar keuze toe aan de route. De appt geeft aan hoeveel extra reistijd er eventueel is. Als je elektrisch rijdt, filter je op laadpalen. De app toont alle laadpalen op jouw route of eindbestemming. Met één klik voeg je een laadpaal toe aan de route. In Europa tonen we ook tolkosten. Zoals je van de ANWB gewend bent, krijg je alle actuele files en verkeersinformatie. 
• Actuele verkeersinformatie en filemeldingen 
In de app vind je een overzicht van actuele en betrouwbare ANWB verkeersinformatie in de buurt of op je route, zoals files (alle wegen), flitsers (snelwegen) en wegwerkzaamheden. Met de handige verkeersinformatielijst kun je per wegnummer alle files en incidenten bekijken.
• Goedkoper of gratis mobiel parkeren 
De app toont alle parkeerlocaties met tarieven in heel Nederland. In een handig overzicht zie je waar je op loopafstand van je bestemming goedkoper of gratis kunt parkeren. Heb je een parkeerplaats gekozen, dan stel je deze met één klik in als eindbestemming. De navigatie plant je route naar deze parkeerplaats. Parkeren in een parkeergarage? De app toont de tarieven en openingstijden. Op bestemming aangekomen betaal je gemakkelijk via de app. Je start en stopt de transactie wanneer jij wil. Zo betaal je alleen voor de tijd die je hebt geparkeerd. We sturen je gratis parkeermeldingen zodat je nooit een lopende transactie vergeet. ANWB Parkeren is een samenwerking met Yellowbrick en werkt in heel Nederland. Log in met je ANWB Parkeren account, voer de zonecode in, controleer je kenteken en start de transactie. Meld je gratis aan en parkeer voordelig met de ANWB Onderweg app https://www.anwb.nl/mobielparkeren
• Laadpalen of tankstations zoeken inclusief actuele brandstofprijzen (voortaan ook in Europa)
In de navigatie tab vind je actuele benzineprijzen van alle tankstations in Nederland of specifiek op jouw geplande route via de knop 'tips'. Met handige kleuren zie je meteen waar je goedkoop kunt tanken. Door te klikken op een tankstation, zie je alle openingstijden, voorzieningen en prijzen. (Super Plus 98, Euro 95, Diesel). 
Ook alle openbare laadpalen vind je via de navigatie tab. Je kunt kiezen voor laden onderweg zodat de app alle snelladers op jouw route toont of je kiest voor laden op bestemming en ziet daarmee alle laadpalen rondom jouw eindbestemming. Met het aantal elektriciteit iconen geven we een indicatie van de laadsnelheid en de kleur geeft de beschikbaarheid aan.
• Digitaal pech melden (voortaan ook in Europa)
Geef je pech makkelijk door aan de Wegenwacht via de ANWB Onderweg app. In Nederland en het buitenland. Via de app kun je alle benodigde informatie zoals je exacte locatie doorgeven. Zo helpt de Wegenwacht je snel weer op weg. Na de pechmelding ontvang je een sms met een link waarmee je kunt volgen wat de status van je Wegenwacht is.
• Mijn ANWB en digitale ledenpas 
Hier vind je je digitale ledenpas en jouw ANWB producten en diensten. Sommige diensten zijn alleen voor ingelogde ANWB leden.
Heb je vragen over deze app? Of heb je verbetersuggesties? 
Stuur deze dan naar appsupport@anwb.nl o.v.v. ANWB Onderweg app of kijk in de app bij Mijn ANWB en klik op Info & Help om ons feedback te geven.

bluejetty:00071271:ios.description:
SkinPick is the #1 platform to treat excoriation disorder (dermatillomania).
The SkinPick App is a proven and effective solution for addressing and managing your skin picking disorder. Gain direct one-on-one access to a specialized therapist with expertise in treating skin picking, who guides you through overcoming your personal challenges. The app also offers a range of resources and tools to support you in your journey towards recovery and growth. 
Key Features:
Expert Therapist Support: Our therapists specialize in treating skin picking disorder using evidence-based techniques from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) as well as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT).
Personalized Treatment Program: Receive a customized treatment plan tailored to your specific needs by an expert therapist. This program will help you address the underlying causes of your skin picking and allow you to develop healthy coping mechanisms.
Education: Gain a deeper understanding of skin picking and its causes, triggers, and associated conditions, as well as the physical and emotional impact of skin picking. Learn about evidence-based treatment strategies and practical techniques and steps that you can take towards healing.
Helpful Tools: Access a range of in-app tools to easily implement the evidence-based therapeutic techniques you learn during your sessions. Begin your journey by taking a self-assessment in order to measure your progress and tailor your treatment plan. Monitor your picking episodes and urges in our Self-monitoring tool to become aware of your picking patterns. Practice mindfulness techniques in our Mindfulness tool to increase awareness and manage your racing thoughts. The app has many other tools designed specifically to enhance your healing journey and support your progress.
Support Groups: Engage with a community of individuals facing similar challenges through virtual support groups led by skilled therapists. Share experiences, gain support, and offer encouragement to one another.
Educational Content: Explore a rich library of educational materials, such as articles, videos, and webinars, to deepen your understanding of skin picking disorder and its management. This content provides valuable insights and empowers you with knowledge.
Take the first step towards overcoming skin picking and improving your well-being with the SkinPick App. This app is designed to facilitate your journey towards healing by providing you with the therapeutic support and tools you need. Start your path to recovery today.
CONNECT WITH US!
We’d love to connect with you and receive feedback.
Email us: support@skinpick.com
Check out our website: www.skinpick.com

bluejetty:00087499:ios.description:
Simply walk and donate steps to a cause. Use your Phone or a Fitness Band or Apple Watch to track your walks, jog, runs, indoor workouts and convert those steps into money for charity. 
We'll be using HealthKit to track your steps throughout the day from your wearable as well as your iPhone.
Impact is world's kindest health app. It is a very simple yet efficient distance tracker & step counter app that enables you to measure your walk, jog, run, indoor workouts and calories, while contributing to the community.
Companies sponsor your steps through CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility). You sweat out for a good cause. Nonprofits get money to drive their on-ground projects.
APP'S FEATURES & BENEFITS
PASSIVE STEP TRACKER - Easy To Use Pedometer/Step Counter (Every step counts, literally!)
Impact counts your steps throughout the day even without having to open the app. You can donate the collected steps to a social cause of your choice every day. You can feed kids, plant trees, empower women and so much more with just your steps. Every 2500 steps (~2 km) = ₹10 for charity.
ACTIVE WORKOUTS TRACKING - Choose a cause and start workout. Every kilometer or every 1250 steps you walk/jog/run raises Rs 10 for the chosen social cause. 
Your Impact is doubled when you do an ACTIVE indoor or outdoor workout.
TEAMS - Create your own teams with family, friends, neighbors, running buddies etc and motivate each other to be active every day. You can do monthly challenges, leaderboard tracking, claps and comments on your team members’ posts to keep the fun flowing. And it’s completely free!
BADGES & STREAKS - Impact along with being step counter and step tracker, also tracks how consistently you do it. You will be rewarded with badges for your achievements and streaks. Compete with yourself and beat your best!
IMPACT LEAGUE - Impact League is a month-long step challenge with a cause in which you compete with your colleagues to win exciting prizes and badges. You can join one of the open leagues on the app or reach out to us to organize a special one for your organization.
Why You Will Love Impact And Why More Than 1 million People Across The World Trust Us?
1. Most Unique among fitness apps in the world- Along with fitness for you, we want to make a difference in the lives of needy people.
2. Easy Step Tracker - It automatically tracks all your steps throughout the day and you can donate those steps to help someone. Why waste steps when you can donate them to a cause?
3. Participate in fun fitness challenges and win exciting prizes
Make every step count with Impact.
Get Fit. Do Good.
Privacy Policy: https://impactapp.in/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00183615:ios.description:
The Silverado Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances. 
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization. 
Alerts and Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes, or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you're looking for when searching through your finances. 
Contact: Locate ATM's or branches and contact Silverado Credit Union customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you're on the Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED 
To use the Silverado Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a Silverado Credit Union Internet Banking User. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00180878:ios.description:
Epson Setting Assistant is an app that automatically corrects the shape of a projected image by using your camera. 
By taking a shot of the projected pattern, the app automatically corrects distortion in the projected image and adjusts its shape to match the screen.
[Main Features]
1) Shape correction
The app adjusts the image to a rectangular shape or aligns it with a frame, such as a projector screen.
2) Unevenness correction
The app detects small surface irregularities, such as on a wall, and corrects distortion in the projected image.
[For Home Projector (EH Series) Users: Using the App]
Make sure your iPhone®, iPad®, or iPod® touch and the projector are connected to the same network.
1. Select [Installation] ([Installation] > [Geometry Correction Wizard]) from the projector's menu.
2. Open this app on your iPhone®, iPad®, or iPod® touch and select [Home] as the projector type to automatically connect to the projector.
3. Follow the on-screen instructions to take a shot of the projected pattern using the camera in the app, and the corrections will be completed automatically.
[For Business Projector (EB Series) Users: Using the App]
Make sure the [Wireless LAN Power] setting is set to [On] in the projector‘s [Management] menu. 
1. Select [Installation] > [Connect to Setting Assistant] from the projector's menu to project a QR code.
2. Open this app on your iPhone®, iPad®, or iPod® touch, select [Business] as the projector's type, and then scan the QR code to automatically connect to the projector.
3. Follow the on-screen instructions to take a shot of the projected pattern using the camera in the app, and the corrections will be completed automatically.
[Supported Projectors]
Visit https://support.epson.net/projector_appinfo/setting_assistant/en/ for details.
Depending on your projector model, some features may not be available.
[Notes for use]
Depending on your environment, such as a curved projection surface or wallpaper with rough textures or patterns,　automatic correction using the app may not be available. In these situations, please correct the image shape from the projector's menu.
Depending on your smartphone/tablet, the Wi-Fi settings may prevent you from temporarily connecting to the projector. Turn your Wi-Fi off and then on again and try again.
For detailed important points, visit https://download2.ebz.epson.net/sec_pubs_visual/apps/setting_assistant/230/EN/index.html.
You can also check these from the [Online support guide] in the menu at the top right of the app.
Images used here are for illustrative purposes only. The actual images may differ.
[App Permissions] 
To use the app, the following permissions are required.
[Required] Local Network
For searching and connecting to the projector. 
[Required] Camera
For capturing correction patterns or QR codes for connection.
* Optional permissions can be declined, but some features may not work.

bluejetty:00046324:ios.description:
Welcome to University Golf Club!
If you are looking for a traditional west coast golf experience with majestic, towering old growth trees and long narrow fairways that anyone can play, then this is it. Carved out of the pristine forests of the University Endowment Lands, the 18 hole par 72 course is a favourite among both casual golfers and regulars.
Full of history (since 1929) the course today has a mature landscape which is both challenging and forgiving. It’s only minutes away from the city but you feel away from it all. Not to mention a clubhouse that benefits a private club. It’s no wonder the University Golf Club is a voted best Public Golf Course time and time again.
The relatively level terrain from hole to hole makes power carts optional and many opt to enjoy the tradition of the game by walking. However you choose to get around your time on course will be time well spent.

bluejetty:00016746:ios.summary:
Put your voice to work with MegaPhone! Use your device as a live microphone, capture conversations, and turn recordings into AI summaries, transcripts and to-dos. Keep the discussion and its next steps together.
MICROPHONE AND AUDIO RECORD
bluejetty:00016746:ios.description:
Put your voice to work with MegaPhone! Use your device as a live microphone, capture conversations, and turn recordings into AI summaries, transcripts and to-dos. Keep the discussion and its next steps together.
MICROPHONE AND AUDIO RECORDING
Route your microphone audio to your device’s speaker or a connected audio output. Record, view speech transcription when available, and save recordings with or without transcript text. Revisit saved audio with playback and seeking.
Mic works without an account.
FROM CONVERSATION TO CLEAR NOTES
Record in-person meetings, discussions and spoken ideas from Notes. Pause when you need a break and resume the same recording. After cloud processing, review the transcript, read the AI summary and find the action items.
Add your own thoughts in My Notes, rename notes and keep your library organised.
ASK YOUR NOTES
Ask questions about a specific note or across your accessible notes. Revisit decisions, find commitments and clarify follow-ups. Answers include links to source notes when returned, so you can explore the context.
FOLLOW THROUGH WITH TO-DOS
Keep conversation follow-ups alongside tasks you add yourself. Create and edit to-dos, set due dates, mark items complete and switch between open, completed and all tasks. View linked action items directly inside a note.
MEETINGS WITH PREEYA
Send Preeya, your AI meeting assistant, to a supported Google Meet, Zoom or Microsoft Teams link. Choose participant or silent notetaker mode, view upcoming and past meetings, and open linked notes afterward.
Start a Google Meet meeting or schedule a meeting using a configured agent and connected calendar.
SHARE THE TAKEAWAYS
Create a shareable link to a ready note’s summary and to-dos. Share through the system share sheet or copy the link. Shared recap pages exclude your transcript and personal My Notes text.
RECORD FROM APPLE WATCH
Capture a note from your wrist, pause and resume, then transfer it to your paired iPhone for upload and processing. Browse note titles and status in the companion library.
SIRI AND RECORDING STATUS
On supported devices, use Siri to start a note recording. Follow recording status with a Live Activity and return to the recorder from the Lock Screen.
WHAT YOU’LL NEED
Notes, To-dos and cloud features require an account. Internet access is required for cloud processing, Ask and meeting services. Meeting features depend on the selected agent, connected services and meeting access.
Apple Watch recording requires a reachable paired iPhone and a signed-in Notes account to start or resume. Siri recording requires iOS 16 or later and an unlocked device. Recording Live Activities require iOS 16.2 or later.
Record conversations only with the necessary permission from participants.
---

bluejetty:00099522:ios.summary: How do you turn a stack of receipts into organized digital files? What about converting handwritten notes into searchable PDFs? Document Scanner uses advanced image processing and optical character recognition to transform any paper documen
bluejetty:00099522:ios.description:
How do you turn a stack of receipts into organized digital files? What about converting handwritten notes into searchable PDFs? Document Scanner uses advanced image processing and optical character recognition to transform any paper document into high-quality digital files you can search, share, and store.
Whether you are digitizing business receipts for tax season, converting meeting notes for team sharing, or archiving important contracts, this scanner handles everything from single pages to multi-page documents with automatic edge detection and perspective correction.
HOW IT WORKS
The app captures documents using your phone camera with enhanced image stabilization and lighting adjustment. Advanced algorithms automatically detect document edges, correct perspective distortion, and enhance text clarity. The OCR engine processes text in over 50 languages, making scanned content fully searchable. Processing happens locally on your device for privacy, with results available in seconds.
KEY FEATURES
— Automatic Edge Detection: Point your camera at any document and watch as the app instantly identifies borders, even on cluttered desks or uneven surfaces.
— Perspective Correction: The app automatically straightens skewed pages and adjusts for camera angle, producing professional-looking scans every time.
— OCR Text Recognition: Scanned documents become searchable with optical character recognition that works on printed text, handwriting, and even faded documents.
— Multi-Page PDF Creation: Combine multiple scans into single PDF documents with consistent formatting. Perfect for contracts, reports, or any multi-page paperwork.
— Cloud Integration: Save directly to iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive. Access your scanned documents from any device, anywhere.
WHO USES THIS APP
Small business owners who need to digitize receipts, invoices, and contracts for accounting and record-keeping. Students and researchers who want to convert textbook pages, handwritten notes, and research materials into searchable digital libraries. Remote workers who need to share physical documents with team members instantly. Homeowners managing important documents like insurance policies, warranties, and legal papers.
HOW TO GET STARTED
1. Open the app and position your document on a flat surface with good lighting
2. Tap the camera button and let auto-detection frame your document
3. Review the scan, choose PDF or JPEG format and add to your document library
For best results, ensure documents are flat and well-lit. The app works in various lighting conditions but performs optimally with natural light or bright indoor lighting.
SUBSCRIPTION
Annual Plan: $19.99 per year — less than $2 per month
Weekly Plan: $4.99 per week with 3-day free trial
Payment charged to App Store account upon purchase confirmation. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before current period ends. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings. Unused free trial forfeited upon subscription purchase.

— OCR Text Recognition: Scanned documents become searchable with optical character recognition that works on printed text, handwriting, and even faded documents.

— Cloud Integration: Save directly to iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive. Access your scanned documents from any device, anywhere.

Small business owners who need to digitize receipts, invoices, and contracts for accounting and record-keeping. bluejetty:00022145:ios.description:
Although the alarm clock has few functions, it is indispensable in life. Every weekday morning, the alarm clock keeps ringing until you press the stop button. Then, with annoyance and sleepy eyes, you struggle to check the time. Will the music used as the alarm become the one you hate the most?
I'll get up, but I don't need to be woken up noisily early in the morning! It's time to change the way of alarm reminder!
Ding - dong ~ It is six thirty now... (Gentle music swelled forth afterward)
This app will use a short and refreshing tone and voice - announce the current time to remind you. Then, it wakes you up with light music. The music stops after 30 seconds without any operation needed. You can freely set the combination of the tone, voice - announced time and music. Remove the music part from the ringtone, and it becomes a time - announcing device.
- Have breakfast at seven thirty and go out at eight o'clock. Okay, remove the music and just have the time - announcing reminder. 
- You're so absorbed in looking at your phone in bed. Set an alarm for 11 p.m. to remind yourself not to miss the best bedtime.
Alarmix is such a simple app, an alarm that is neither annoying nor disturbing.
===== Features =====
- Focus on the alarm clock, no other complex functions, simple interface, easy to set.
- Customize ringtones that are composed of a combination of prompt tone, voice time and music.
- The ring tone stops after 30 seconds of playback. No action is required.
- Snooze time can be set from 5 minutes to 30 minutes.
** The built-in ringtone is generally softer so as not to scare you. If you are a deep sleeper and it's difficult for you to wake up, please download with caution.

bluejetty:00187156:ios.description:
We help home inspectors save 1-2 hours per inspection. Built for inspectors who live in the field, not in the office. Don’t waste time writing reports after the inspection, use Tap Inspect to easily write effective reports while you’re performing the home inspection. Trusted in over 1,000,000 home inspections, 96% of home inspectors stick with Tap Inspect.
MAIN BENEFITS
* Recover Wasted Working Hours With Our Automated Tools
* Easiest Home Inspection Mobile App on the Market
* Run Your Home Inspection Business From Your iPhone
* Simplify The Home Buying Process for Clients
* #1 In the App Store with 4.8 Stars and 4k+ Ratings
* Built By Home Inspectors Who Understand What Matters Most
ABOUT US
With generations of home inspection experience, we set out to build the report writing software that we wanted to use for our own home inspection businesses. The Tap Inspect mobile app is the easiest report writing system available and allows us to save up to 10 hours per week by publishing the report before leaving the property.
TIME-SAVING PROCESS
* Select a default or customized home inspection template
* Work through that template’s home inspection checklist at the property
* Take photos directly within the app while you’re performing the home inspection
* Add circles, arrows, rectangles, and text to your photos to emphasize issues for your clients
* Easily write custom comments or choose from your library of popular comments
* Preview final home inspection report, review comments and make edits
* Attach test results or other documents
* Share your report online and deliver to clients before leaving the home inspection
* Get notified when clients receive the home inspection report
FEATURES
* Save 1-2 hours per home inspection by completing the report before you leave.
* Redesigned HTML reports to improve client readability on every device
* Stunning high resolution photo support for increased clarity
* Modern & cleaner user interface for better performance
* Overhauled team experience to reduce hassle for multi-inspector firms 
* Rewritten codebase to reduce app crashes
* Easy to learn and use with our library of demo videos.
* Our home inspection reports are structured to quickly communicate the info clients need most.
* Access attentive technical support or our knowledge base right from the app.
* Upload company logo and attachments to personalize your report pickup page.
* Securely back-up all reports, libraries, and templates on our web server in case your phone or iPad gets lost, stolen, or broken.

bluejetty:00180911:ios.description:
Introducing Hashrate – the ultimate crypto mining app for miners of all levels! With Hashrate, you can effortlessly monitor all your mining rigs from one convenient place, no matter where you are.
What sets Hashrate apart is its cross-platform compatibility – it works seamlessly on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS devices. Plus, it supports multiple pools, so you can keep track of all your mining activities in one app.
And the best part? Hashrate's lock-screen widgets make it easy to keep tabs on your miners without even unlocking your device. You can customize your widgets to display all your farms, and they look stunning in Dark Mode too!
For those who like to crunch numbers, Hashrate comes equipped with a built-in calculator that lets you calculate your profits and energy costs anytime, anywhere.
And that's not all – Hashrate also notifies you when one of your miners goes offline on iOS or iPadOS.
Hashrate currently supports a wide range of coins, including Bitcoin, Kaspa, Dynex, Iron Fish, Nexa, Flux, Radiant, Monero, and many more. And with support for popular pools such as Herominers, WoolyPooly, Kryptex and K1 Pools, you can rest assured that you're always up-to-date with the latest data.
But we're not done yet – we're constantly adding support for new pools and coins, so you can always stay ahead of the curve.
To be clear, Hashrate is not a wallet app, and it doesn't store or use any private keys. It simply displays data obtained from the supported pool websites.
Try Hashrate today and take your mining game to the next level!

bluejetty:00073799:ios.summary:
magicApp is the most affordable & simple way to get a second phone number on your mobile phone. You can use your magicApp second line for your personal or business needs and enjoy unlimited calling and texting to the U.S. and Canada.
magic
bluejetty:00073799:ios.description:
magicApp is the most affordable & simple way to get a second phone number on your mobile phone. You can use your magicApp second line for your personal or business needs and enjoy unlimited calling and texting to the U.S. and Canada.
magicApp makes it possible to have different phone numbers without having to switch out your SIM and at an affordable monthly. You can easily AND quickly switch from your magicApp phone number to your actual phone number.
MAGICAPP FEATURES
* Choose a U.S. phone number from any available area code
* Unlimited calling to the U.S and Canada*
* Send or receive unlimited text messages to U.S. and Canadian numbers**
* Traveling? Make calls over Wi-Fi so you never have to worry about roaming charges when abroad!
* Unlimited calling to other magicJack customer worldwide
* Caller ID, voicemail, call blocking, block anonymous callers and call forwarding
* Caller ID pulled from your mobile phone contact list, so you always know who is calling
* Cheaper than the rest of the apps out there AND AD FREE!
EXISITNG MAGICJACK DEVICE CUSTOMER?
magicJack customers can enjoy texting to any U.S. or Canadian number** using magicApp - your friends & family don't have to download the app to text! Calls to your magicJack number rings on your smartphone at the same time so you never miss a call. Download now and login to magicApp with your existing magicJack email and password to make and receive calls over Wi-Fi.
NEW: Now available to magicJack device customers with Canadian numbers, you can add the option to text with your Canadian phone number for a small annual fee through the app store.
TURN YOUR IPAD INTO A PHONE
Connect your tablet to the internet, download magicApp and start making calls from your iPad.
Use magicApp on devices running iOS14 or higher. Find out more on www.magicJack.com
*Texting to international numbers is not available and texts to some US mobile numbers may not be delivered. Unlimited calling to numbers within the United States and Canada, and unlimited texting and other services provided by magicJack®, are based on normal, non-excessive use. A combination of factors is used to determine excessive use, including but not limited to the relative use when compared to the average magicJack® user, the number of unique numbers called, calls forwarded, minutes used, texts sent/received and other factors. Unlimited calling does not include calls to Alaska or the Yukon and Northwest Territories of Canada or calls to non-8YY calling card, platform, conference, or chat lines, for which additional fees will apply. Subject to our Subscriber Agreement located here: http://www.magicjack.com/action/saps/.
**Canadian magicJack numbers require a separate subscription for texting.

bluejetty:00183652:ios.description:
Manage Your Account
• Enroll in Mobile and Online Banking through your app.
• Manage cards: activate debit and credit cards, create or change your card PIN, report lost or stolen cards, and order replacements.
• View balances with one touch before logging in with Quick Balance or by using Siri®.
• View deposit, credit card, lending statements and loan/line of credit and investment* account balances.
• Manage, select, and customize your alerts; pick alert settings and choose how to receive them (text, email, or push messages).
• Set up, change, or cancel Autopay credit card payments.
• Manage your contact details: edit, add, or delete contact information.
Stay Secure
• Put your misplaced debit or credit card on hold with Santander® Instant Card Hold. (Santander® Instant Card Hold will block most types of transactions, including purchases made with your card. Please note that some types of transactions will continue to process, including recurring debit/credit transactions presented to us by certain merchants for monthly membership or subscription fees.)
• Retrieve your User ID and change or reset your Password securely from your mobile device using password reset.
• Verify your identity on certain transactions using One-Time Passcode (OTP) security.
• Log in using Touch ID® or Face ID®. (If you share your device with other people, please note any fingerprints or face image stored on your device may be used to log in to the Santander Mobile Banking App and access your account.)
Navigate with Ease
• Tutorials and tips guide you through updates and improved Mobile Banking features when you first log in to your Mobile Banking App.
Deposit Checks
• Skip the ATM and deposit checks from your app.
Pay Bills
• Add and select Bill Pay payees to make payments.
• Schedule payments for future dates.
• Review your Bill Pay activity and pay your unpaid e-Bills.
Transfer Funds
• Make one-time and recurring transfers between your Santander accounts.
• Move money from your personal bank accounts at other financial institutions to your Santander checking, savings or money market accounts.
• Transfer money to other Santander customers.
• Make transfers to accounts at other banks within the U.S.
(Restrictions apply. Please refer to the Digital Banking Agreement for details).
Contact Us Anytime for Assistance
• Use One-touch calling to Santander Customer Service.
• Schedule a Meeting to meet with a banker.
• Find directions to the nearest Santander branch or ATM.
Get Started Today. It's Easy!
If you have a personal account with Santander Bank, download the Mobile Banking App today and bank when you want to!
