bluejetty:00175075:ios.name: HiMommy: Pregnancy Tracker
bluejetty:00175075:ios.summary:
HiMommy is a pregnancy tracker app that helps expecting moms follow their baby's development week by week with daily messages from the baby, a 3D baby view, kick and contraction counters and a pregnancy journal.
Before pregnancy it offers
bluejetty:00175075:ios.description:
HiMommy is a pregnancy tracker app that helps expecting moms follow their baby's development week by week with daily messages from the baby, a 3D baby view, kick and contraction counters and a pregnancy journal.
Before pregnancy it offers a cycle and ovulation calendar for trying to conceive, after birth it tracks the baby's first months, and partners can follow along in the companion HiDaddy app.
Preparing for pregnancy? HiMommy gives you the tools to support your fertility!
• Menstrual and ovulation calendar - accurate cycle predictions to help you determine your fertile days, ovulation and increase your chances of getting pregnant.
• Fertility symptom tracking - monitor your basal body temperature, cervical mucus and other symptoms to get to know your body better.
• Fertility recipes (HiMommy+) - a healthy diet plays an important role in planning a pregnancy, so we have prepared delicious and nutritious meals for you.
• Meditation and stress reduction (HiMommy+) - take care of your wellbeing with relaxing recordings to support fertility and emotional balance.
And if the pregnancy test shows two lines, HiMommy will still be your reliable companion!
Are you pregnant? HiMommy is with you every step of the way!
HiMommy is your personal guide through the days and weeks of your pregnancy. Every day we provide you with valuable information about your baby's development and the changes in your body.
• Daily messages from your baby (HiMommy+) - feel close to your baby and follow its development!
• Healthy habits - find out which products are safe and which to avoid during pregnancy.
• Pregnancy Tracking - a contraction counter (HiMommy+), kick counter (HiMommy+), and weight tracker help you prepare for delivery.
• Exercises for moms-to-be (HiMommy+) - specially tailored workouts to support your health and well-being.
• Checklists and layette (HiMommy+) - pack your hospital bag and prepare for your baby's birth without stress.
• Pregnancy Diary - document your growing bump and create a beautiful keepsake for life.
HiMommy will be with you even after the baby is born!
HiMommy will give you tips on how to take care of your newborn, breastfeed and support your child's development.
• Learn the secrets of your baby's speech and body language.
• Understand the world of a newborn from his or her perspective.
• Introduce creative play and build an amazing bond with your little one.
• Track your newborn's key measurements and activities throughout the day, such as baby's sleep
• Find out which products are safe for your baby and which are not.
• Monitor your baby's feeding - breastfeeding or bottle feeding.
The biggest adventure of your life is just beginning - HiMommy will be your trusted guide!
Download the app today and start your unique journey to motherhood!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
HiMommy offers a free version with basic pregnancy information. Some premium features marked with (HiMommy+) require an active subscription. HiMommy+ subscription is auto-renewable. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
HiMommy is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
Privacy Policy: https://himommyapp.com/en/pages/himommy-privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://himommyapp.com/en/pages/terms-and-conditions

■ VISUALLY STUNNING AND IMMERSIVE DESIGN

bluejetty:00024064:ios.summary: Our diverse portfolio of games keep kids engaged, motivating them to learn more! We’ve developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and
bluejetty:00024064:ios.description:
Our diverse portfolio of games keep kids engaged, motivating them to learn more! We’ve developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
Smarter, Inclusive Learning for Every Child
SKIDOS now supports kids with ADHD, Dyslexia, Dysgraphia & Dyscalculia. Built with accessibility guidelines, the experience is tailored to every child’s unique learning needs—making learning more personalized, inclusive, and enjoyable for neurodivergent learners too
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids’ progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
SKIDOS HOSPITAL
Heal, Help, Play
Explore a busy hospital! Become a doctor, treat patients, run scans, do lab tests, or relax in the cafeteria. Boost cognitive, executive function, social & emotional, and motor skills through fun roleplay. Discover medical tools, quirky characters, and explore the daily life of a hospital - all in 4 exciting game floors full of interactive surprises and endless fun!
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child’s learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keep them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions, as well as nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We’ve curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalog.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-Day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, & auto-renewal for subscriptions may be turned off in the user’s device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00178835:ios.description:
A simple expense diary for daily spending, cash, and income.
Just Money is the place to write down what you spend and earn. No bank login, no account, no ads—just a clean record of where your money goes.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Add expenses and income in seconds, with a built-in calculator
• Use categories that match how you actually think about your money
• See simple statistics for any period—by category, by month, by year
• Compare income and expenses side by side
• Track cash, daily spending, and household money
• Export to CSV anytime
• Code lock with Face ID support
THE IDEA
The idea is small: write down what you spent and what you earned. The act of typing a number and picking a category is where awareness lives—it's the reason Just Money is a manual app, not a bank-connected one.
QUIET, PRIVATE, YOURS
• No bank connection
• No account to create
• No ads
• Your records stay on your device and your iCloud—not on a Just Money server
BUILT TO LAST
Just Money has been around since 2013. A one-time purchase stays a one-time purchase—we don't gate features you've already paid for.
WHAT IT ISN'T
Not a budgeting platform. Not accounting software. Not a bank-connected finance dashboard. A notebook for the money in your day.
Questions, ideas, or feature requests? Write to hello@justmoney.nl—every email is read by the developer.

bluejetty:00074450:ios.description:
الدليلة — طريقك في البر أسهل
في موروث أهل الجزيرة العربية، «الدليلة» هو العارف بدروب الصحراء ومعالمها، الذي يستدل على الطريق ويقود رفاقه إلى وجهتهم. ومن هذا المعنى استلهم الدليلة اسمه، ليجمع أدوات معرفة المكان والتوجيه في تطبيق يرافقك في رحلات البر.
منذ 2012، يرافق الدليلة محبي البر والرحلات. واليوم يأتيك بتجربة متجددة، راعينا فيها سهولة الاستخدام ووضوح المعلومات، لتجد وجهتك، وتحفظ مواقعك، وتسجّل مساراتك، وتشاركها مع من تحب.
وجهتك أمامك
اختر موقعًا من الدليل أو محفوظاتك أو الخريطة، وتابع الاتجاه والمسافة المباشرة إليه عبر سهم التوجيه والبوصلة. واطّلع على موقعك الحالي وسرعتك وارتفاعك ودقة إشارة الموقع من واجهة واضحة.
القبلة ضمن البوصلة
اعرف اتجاه القبلة من البوصلة نفسها، دون الحاجة إلى اتصال بالإنترنت. وتعمل أدوات التوجيه والسرعة والارتفاع والإحداثيات أيضًا دون إنترنت عند توفر قراءة الموقع.
خرائط وبيانات لجميع الدول العربية
تتوفر في الدليلة خرائط وبيانات مواقع لجميع الدول العربية. ابحث في دليل مضمّن بأسماء عربية للمواقع والمعالم، حتى دون إنترنت، ونزّل الخرائط التي تحتاجها لاستخدامها دون اتصال ضمن الاشتراك. تصفّح المواقع حسب الدولة، واعرض الأقرب إلى موقعك، واحفظ أماكنك الخاصة ونظّم مفضّلتك للعودة إليها بسهولة.
خرائط تناسب رحلتك
استخدم خريطة جوجل، أو اكتشف خرائط الدليلة بثلاثة أنماط: فاتح، داكن، وتضاريس. استعرض المواقع والمعالم وتفاصيل التضاريس، ونزّل خرائط المناطق التي تحتاجها لاستخدامها دون إنترنت ضمن اشتراك خرائط الدليلة.
وابحث على الخريطة باسم موقع، أو الصق إحداثياته بصيغ مختلفة للوصول إليه واختياره وجهة لك.
مسارك محفوظ
سجّل مسارك وتابع الوقت والمسافة المقطوعة، مع إمكانية الإيقاف المؤقت والاستئناف. احفظ المسار واعرضه على الخريطة لاحقًا، وفعّل التسجيل في الخلفية من الإعدادات إذا رغبت في متابعة التسجيل عند الانتقال إلى تطبيق آخر أو قفل الشاشة.
مشاركة سهلة
شارك موقعًا أو مسارًا برابط عبر واتساب أو تطبيقات المشاركة، وافتح المواقع المستلمة في الدليلة لاختيارها وجهة أو حفظها.
استيراد وتصدير بعدة صيغ
استورد المواقع والمسارات من ملفات GPX وKML وKMZ، وصدّرها بهذه الصيغ حسب حاجتك. اختر موقعًا أو مسارًا واحدًا، أو عدة عناصر، أو جميع محفوظاتك للتصدير والاحتفاظ بنسخة منها أو نقلها بين التطبيقات المتوافقة.
واجهة على راحتك
اختر الوضع الفاتح أو الداكن، واضبط وحدات القياس وصيغة الإحداثيات بما يناسبك، مع تجربة مهيّأة للآيفون والآيباد.
خرائط الدليلة وتنزيلاتها متاحة ضمن الاشتراك، ويتطلب تنزيل الخرائط اتصالًا بالإنترنت قبل استخدامها دون اتصال. يعتمد التوجيه على الاتجاه والمسافة المباشرة إلى الوجهة.
الدليلة — من معرفة الدروب إلى سهولة الوصول.

Burn fat and build lean muscle with quick workouts, tasty food, no expensive equipment, and a feel-good way to transform your mind and body!

- Unlock new workouts and recipes each month to keep you progressing, motivated and enjoying the journey, every step of the way.

bluejetty:00015577:ios.summary:
** More than 7,000,000 musicians around the world use Piascore! **
** Fully optimized for iPad Pro and iPhone 18! **
Piascore is a digital sheet music reader for iPad and iPhone, made for pianists, guitarists and every other musician who p
bluejetty:00015577:ios.description:
** More than 7,000,000 musicians around the world use Piascore! **
** Fully optimized for iPad Pro and iPhone 18! **
Piascore is a digital sheet music reader for iPad and iPhone, made for pianists, guitarists and every other musician who plays from a score. The idea behind it is simple: all the world's sheet music, right there in your hands.
It takes on the everyday problems every performer knows too well. No more hauling a bag of heavy binders to rehearsal, and no more digging through piles of paper for the one piece you need.
** Features **
: Annotate freely
Six pens, each with its own color, thickness and nib, let you mark up a score exactly as you would on paper. Stamps for dynamics and other symbols, plus text boxes, make annotating quick.
: Smart browsing
Our own rendering engine gives you page turns among the fastest anywhere. Jump straight to the first or last page, preview a page before you turn to it, and crop pages to enlarge the staves for easier reading. Password-protected PDFs are supported.
: Automatic vertical scrolling and half-page turns
Let the score scroll by itself and forget about turning pages altogether. The scrolling speed is yours to set.
: Over 130,000 classical scores to download for free
Piascore connects to IMSLP (the International Music Score Library Project) / Petrucci Music Library, so you can download 131,000 public domain works by 16,200 composers, free of charge.
: Plenty of ways to bring in your own scores
Piascore reads PDF files. Transfer your own scores over iTunes File Sharing, import them from Dropbox, photograph printed music with the camera, or download a score you found in Safari.
: Easy library management
Tags and setlists keep even a large library in order, with powerful sorting and keyword search.
: Metronome
A metronome with a natural, realistic sound to keep your daily practice on track.
: Piascore music tools
Everything a musician needs beside the score: a keyboard, a chromatic tuner, a music player (iTunes) and a voice recorder.
: Custom covers
Use a photo or any image you like to give each score its own cover.
: Editable table of contents
Build your own table of contents, or import one from the PDF.
: Reorder pages, jump between them
Put the pages in whatever order suits you. For repeats, D.S. and the like, place a jump button on the page and go straight where the music takes you.
: Export your scores
Print an annotated score over AirPrint, or send it by email.
: The Piascore Store
Classical works, folk songs and easy arrangements, all in one store. Search by genre or by artist and find that piece you have been looking for.
: Air Page Turning (iPhone required)
Pair an iPhone running the companion app "Piascore Air" and turn pages more easily than ever, without touching the screen at all.
: AirTurn Bluetooth pedal support
Connect an AirTurn pedal and turn pages with your foot.
** Praise **
"This is a sheet music viewer that is genuinely worth having" - GRAMOPHONE
"Very easy to use, a beautiful sound library" - appPicker
"The most wonderful and convenient music sheet viewer you can't miss!" - Best10Apps.com
"Impressed with the outstanding visibility!" - AppBank
** Award **
: 2011 International Business Awards - Consumer Entertainment / Information (Distinguished Honoree)
: 2012 4th SF NewTech Japan Night Winner
** FAQ **
: https://help.piascore.com/
** Contact **
: https://piascore.com/
: support@piascore.com

bluejetty:00165879:ios.description:
This app lets you practice cursive by tracing. 
It includes uppercase and lowercase letters, as well as words in multiple languages. 
You can also add your own words for custom practice.
Practice Cursive
- Trace to practice cursive writing.
- Practice both uppercase and lowercase letters.
- View animated stroke order for each letter.
- Supports special characters in German and Spanish (ä, ö, ß, ü, ñ).
- Practice words in multiple languages.
- Includes over 100 words per language.
- Supports words with accent marks.
Cursive Languages
- Switch between different cursive languages.
- Supports English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, and Portuguese.
- The app’s display language can be linked to the selected cursive language.
- Use the search button to look up word meanings (opens in external browser).
- You can also switch the search button to a share button.
Custom Words
- In “Custom,” you can display typed text in cursive.
- Add typed text to "Custom Words" for practice.
- Custom Words can be sorted and deleted.
- Custom Words are shared across all cursive languages.
Cursive Settings
- Change the font of the example text.
- Adjust the font size of the example text.
- Switch example styles (with line, without line, or none).
- Toggle between pen and eraser.
- Change the pen’s thickness and color.
- Enable or disable zooming.
Customization
- Supports dark mode.
- You can also change the theme color.
- Features a simple design based on Material Design.

bluejetty:00147191:ios.description:
A delightfully simple todo app that respects your focus and privacy. There are no due dates, reminders, or push notifications.
JUST TWO LISTS
One screen, two lists: "Sooner" and "Later". New todos are added to "Sooner" but if they're not time-sensitive, move them down to "Later". This simple paradigm makes triaging tasks easy, and keep stress to a minimum.
DELIGHTFUL SIMPLICITY
Enjoy a rich, interactive interface with gestures, custom sound design, haptic feedback and accent colors. There's also support for both light and dark mode so it's easy on the eyes day or night.
WIDGET SUPPORT
With Home and Lock Screen widgets, you'll have your tasks visible at a glance, ensuring you never miss a beat.
PRIVATE
Twodos stores all of your data securely on your device, and backs it up to your iCloud account. No one else has access to it. No third-party analytics or tracking.

bluejetty:00063036:ios.summary:

Match blocks to complete lines and squares to remove them. Keep the board clean, and beat your hig
bluejetty:00063036:ios.description:
Blockudoku® is an original combination of sudoku and block puzzle games. It’s a simple yet challenging puzzle you won’t be able to put down.
Match blocks to complete lines and squares to remove them. Keep the board clean, and beat your high score.
How to play:
- Drop the blocks on the 9x9 grid.
- Fill up lines and squares to keep the board clean.
- Complete Daily Challenges and get unique trophies.
- Join Seasonal Events and get unique animated postcards.
- Compete against other players in Tournaments, beat your high score, and climb the leaderboard.
- Destroy several elements at once to make a Combo.
- Make several successful moves in a row to get a Streak.
How to become a Blockudoku® master?
• There is no time limit, so no need to rush. Think one step ahead when faced with a difficult move. It might be your last one.
• Try to place blocks on the board to destroy lines or 3x3 squares with every move to keep the board from filling up.
• Find your zen by balancing between destroying figures as quickly as possible and getting as many combos and streaks as you can to score higher.
• Score more points by making streaks. The emptier the board, the better for you!
• It's always risky to wait for a good block – you may quickly run out of moves. When you see a chance to destroy a figure, do it.
Relieve stress, or train your brain with a relaxing, yet challenging, game of Blockudoku® anywhere, anytime!

Download LTA Courtside now and get ready for an unforgettable summer of tennis.

bluejetty:00147209:ios.summary: Echo records your meetings and writes the notes for you. It works for online calls and in person conversations, transcribes in 100+ languages, and hands you a summary with the key points and action items when the meeting ends. Downloaded 36
bluejetty:00147209:ios.description:
Echo records your meetings and writes the notes for you. It works for online calls and in person conversations, transcribes in 100+ languages, and hands you a summary with the key points and action items when the meeting ends. Downloaded 360,000+ times by professionals, students, and teams.*
Most note takers only handle online meetings. They send a bot into the call, it sits in the attendee list, and someone always asks what it is. Echo records from your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch instead. Nothing to invite, nothing to set up.
DOES ECHO WORK FOR IN PERSON MEETINGS?
That is what it was built for. Client meetings, 1:1s, interviews, lectures, site visits. Phone on the table, one tap, and you can stop writing and start listening.
CAN ECHO RECORD ZOOM, TEAMS, AND GOOGLE MEET CALLS?
Yes, and any other call too. Echo records from your iPhone the same way it records a conversation in the room, so the platform does not matter and there is nothing to connect.
WHAT DO YOU GET WHEN THE MEETING ENDS?
The full transcript, a summary of what was discussed, the key points, and the action items. Enough to write the follow up email without opening the recording again.
And when you need one specific thing out of an old meeting, just ask. Echo AI searches the recording for you: what the client agreed to, when the deadline is, who owns what.
FEATURES
Summaries that give you the decisions and the next steps
Key points, so you can jump to the part that mattered
Ask Echo AI for answers about any recording
Recording on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch, so you can start from whatever is closest
Works with Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, and calls on any other platform
Upload audio you already have and get it transcribed
Transcription in 100+ languages
Sharing by message, email, or anywhere else you work
Folders and search across everything you have recorded
Workspaces that keep your whole team on the same notes
WHAT USERS SAY
From App Store reviews in the US:
"One touch and my 90min zoom meeting was summarized in seconds afterwards. This is a career changing tool for me."
"If you're in a meeting, this is a must have tool. Never miss anything important!"
"Really an amazing tool and very accurate transcriptions with great AI built in features."
WHO USES ECHO
Salespeople and consultants who need a record of what the client actually said
Managers running back to back 1:1s
Students recording lectures and seminars
Teams that keep losing decisions between meetings
IS ECHO FREE?
Free to download, and you can record your first meeting straight away. Echo Plus adds longer recordings, unlimited notes, audio file uploads, and sharper summaries, and it starts with a free trial.
IS MY DATA PRIVATE?
Your recordings, transcripts, and summaries are end to end encrypted, and Echo follows European data protection standards.
Download Echo and stop taking notes in meetings.
*Total downloads as of 2026.

Terms of Use: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/27023519

bluejetty:00127099:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Cry Babies Magic Tears! Meet your favorite characters, and learn something new every day! Have fun playing games and taking care of them. Coney, Dotty, Lady, Elodie, and many more are waiting for you with their adorable pets, just a click away! 
Thanks to the Magic Tears Cry Babies App, you can play games, explore and learn something new, all while have a great time!
DISCOVER THE TROPICAL ISLAND
Explore the Tropical Island with Coraline, Lora and her pet Pixie. Discover pirate Lora’s beautiful boat.
CARING FOR CRY BABIES
You will learn how to take care of your babies. You will learn how to feed, shower, change, and accessorize Coney, Dotty, Lady, Mia, Phoebe, and Elodie. You can even play with their pets! 
MAKE UP LADY
You can paint Lady's face with masks, stickers and much more!
MAKE CAKES
Have fun learning how to cook, bake and decorate cakes with Coney!
CARING FOR PETS
Some pets are sick. Help the veterinarian Dotty, as her assistant, and learn how to heal and care for the pets so they can keep playing in Baby Bottle Valley! 
ORDER THE GARDEN
Water the plants in Mia's garden and help her store them in their colored boxes.
COLLECT STONES
Memory game. Remember and order Phoebe's stone collection.
MAKE SCULPTURES
Make sculptures of your favorite characters in Elodie's castle following the order of numbers.
CREATE YOUR PARTY
Help Coraline decorate the party to receive Cry Babies from other worlds.
SAIL TO TROPICAL ISLAND
Navigate with Lora and add pacifiers to get the treasure.
WATCH ALL THE EPISODES FROM THE SERIES
Enter the theater to watch all the episodes of Cry Babies Magic Tears.
SELECT YOUR FAVORITE CRY BABIES
You can select which Cry Babies are your favorites and view the entire collection.
SCAN QRs
Scan the QR of the capsules with our scanner to discover which baby is waiting for you inside.
SHOP NEW ITEMS
In the new store you can buy exclusive houses, outfits and accessories for your Cry Babies.
Welcome to the world of Cry Babies Magic Tears! Enter Baby Bottle Valley, Icy World and Tropical Island, learn and play with your favorite characters, while discovering all new adventures! Make sure you have the latest version downloaded to stay up to date on all the newest surprises!

bluejetty:00115174:ios.description:
Next Agers is a civilization-themed, city-building and strategy game. Experience the role of a civilization's leader and lead the populace toward continuous development and expansion, building a civilization whose name will last for eternity.
[Era Progression]
Lead the people on a daring discovery of the unknown. Choose your technology development path and complete the evolution from the primitive Stone Age to the dark Middle Ages, and onwards into the marvelous future ages, reproducing all of the cornerstone inventions of human history.
[World Wonders]
Experience the charms of history's greatest civilizations, building famous wonders of the world and making your cities into civilizational landmarks.
[Unique Troop Types]
Recruit troop types from various civilizations and eras, with the possibility of seeing cavemen fight tanks and airplanes on the battlefield. Each troop type has its own specialty, and only by playing to strengths and avoiding weaknesses can you overcome the enemy.
[Freedom to Build]
Freely build your cities, giving them the forms you desire.
[Domestic Management]
Manage the city's affairs by increasing its manpower and optimally assigning them to various production industries, growing your economy and developing new technologies.
[Legendary Leaders]
The legendary leaders of the world's civilizations will appear one after another. Invite them as allies to join your city, fight with them side by side or ask them to assist with management. Whether or not the talents of these giants of history are fully realized will be decided by you.
[Real-Time Battle]
Engage in real-time and large-scale strategy-based battles. Plan your formations and send them out, using famous generals across history as key factors that shift the battle.
[Form Alliances]
Create an Alliance with other players, advancing through collaboration and developing the Alliance's territory 
together.
Next Agers is a free-to-play game. Some in-game items (including random items) can be purchased.

bluejetty:00018892:ios.description:
*** Fun EDUCATIONAL game for toddlers of age 2.5 and up 
*** Developed with certified child psychologists 
***12 beautiful mini-game boards 
*** 4 difficulty levels 
About the game: 
----------------- 
This game is the second game in our Pairs matching series. Like the previous game in the series it is based on pairs matching, but it introduces more challenging concepts such as logical groups, counting, numbers, and associations. In most cases this game requires the child to understand WHAT he sees in order to make the correct match as opposed to visual similarity.
The game is designed to enhance the following: 
-----------------------------------------
– Attention to details 
- Quantitative perception (counting and numbers) 
- Categorization 
- Logical thinking 
- Visual perception 
Game Boards: 
--------------- 
The game consists of 12 boards ordered in an ascending level of difficulty. The boards were carefully chosen in order to represent basic concepts from the child's world. 
Who's hiding: Animals hiding behind household items. 
Groups: Match kitchen utensils by their group
Patterns: Match wild animals to their patterns
Sliced fruit: Match fruits and vegetables to their slices
Shapes width: Match similar shapes with differing width
What did I eat: Guess what the children ate by the colors on their bib
Close it: Match different boxes and containers to their lids
Color it: Match objects to their typical color. 
Who's leg is it: Match animals to their paws/legs. 
Multiple colors: Match beach items according to their colors 
Bugs: Match beetles and snails according to their number 
Association: Match items that usually go together 
TinyHands Games:
TinyHands Sorting Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.
TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking games. The game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.
TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.
TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.
TinyHands Raccoon TreeHouse
This game is intended for toddlers aged 3+. The game presents 12 boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.
Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.

The game consists of 12 boards ordered in an ascending level of difficulty. The boards were carefully chosen in order to represent basic concepts from the child's world. 

Who's hiding: Animals hiding behind household items. 
Groups: Match kitchen utensils by their group
Patterns: Match wild animals to their patterns
Sliced fruit: Match fruits and vegetables to their slices
Shapes width: Match similar shapes with differing width
What did I eat: Guess what the children ate by the colors on their bib
Close it: Match different boxes and containers to their lids
Color it: Match objects to their typical color. 
Who's leg is it: Match animals to their paws/legs. 
Multiple colors: Match beach items according to their colors  
Bugs: Match beetles and snails according to their number 
Association: Match items that usually go together 

TinyHands Games:
 
TinyHands Sorting Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.

TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking games. The game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.

TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.

TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.

TinyHands Raccoon TreeHouse
This game is intended for toddlers aged 3+. The game presents 12 boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.

TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.

TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.

Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.

Use the app or your phone camera to scan EVA Check-in QR codes (displayed on posters or the EVA Check-in ki
bluejetty:00021750:ios.description:
The fast, secure, and contactless sign-in app for visitors, contractors, and staff at workplaces using EVA Check-in. 
How it works 
Use the app or your phone camera to scan EVA Check-in QR codes (displayed on posters or the EVA Check-in kiosk). 
Quickly confirm your details, optionally select who you are visiting and answer any additional questions required by the workplace as part of your sign-in. 
As you leave the site, sign out via the app. The app keeps a personal record for you of places you’ve been – across all sites that use EVA Check-in. 
Your profile will be securely remembered to save re-entering your details if you regularly visit the same site. You can store multiple profiles and check-in multiple people from the same phone. 
Optional extras 
If the site you’re visiting has this enabled, you’ll be able to:
• Opt-in to use geofence check-ins - put sign-in/out on autopilot
• Get on-site alerts from the site administrator
• View any certificates you've been granted - for example, inductions and safety orientations
• Report site hazards, including uploading photos
EVA Check-in customers may also enable specific visitors/staff to:
• Start an evacuation from the app and conduct roll calls
• See who is on site right now
• Raise an SOS request for help
Data security
All check-in data is encrypted, sent, and stored securely. Workplaces select data retention rules to suit their business requirements.

bluejetty:00094678:ios.description:
Crossword Colorful: Solve Puzzles with a Vibrant Twist!
Welcome to Crossword Colorful, where classic crossword puzzles meet an exciting color-coded challenge! Your mission is to solve the crossword grid using both traditional word clues and a unique color system. Certain cells are marked with colors – and here’s the trick: any letter placed in a colored cell will be the same in all other cells of that exact color throughout that puzzle!
For example, if you determine the letter 'S' goes into a blue square, every other blue square in that puzzle will also be an 'S'. This adds a fascinating layer of strategy to Crossword Colorful, allowing you to use discovered letters and their colors to unlock other words across the grid. It's the perfect blend of word knowledge and logical deduction!
Key Features:
Unique Color-Linking Mechanic: The heart of Crossword Colorful! Letters in like-colored cells are the same – use this to your advantage!
Classic Crossword Gameplay: Enjoy traditional word clues and the familiar grid you love.
Engaging Crossword Clues: Test your vocabulary and general knowledge.
Vast Puzzle Library: Enjoy countless puzzles that will keep you entertained for hours.
Learn New Words: Enhance your vocabulary with every puzzle solved.
Smart Booster System: Need a hint? Boosters are available to guide you.
Relaxed Gameplay: Solve puzzles at your own speed with no stressful timers.
Progress Saved: Auto-save lets you continue any unfinished puzzle anytime.
User-Friendly Design: Enjoy a polished interface designed for a seamless puzzle experience.
Download Crossword Colorful now and experience the next evolution of crossword fun – where every color brings you closer to solving the mystery!

bluejetty:00178761:ios.description:
Logic Remote is a companion app for Logic Pro and GarageBand on the Mac. It provides an innovative way to extend the creative power of Logic or GarageBand by using your iPad or iPhone. Designed to take full advantage of Multi-Touch, Logic Remote offers new ways to record, mix, and even perform instruments from anywhere in the room, turning your iPad or iPhone* into a mixer, transport control, and a flexible Touch Instrument.
Play Logic Instruments
• Play any Logic instrument using a familiar piano keyboard or guitar fretboard 
• Tap out beats on drum pads or a drum kit
• Control Live Loops by triggering cells or switching between scenes
• Program beats, bass lines, and melodic parts in Step Sequencer
• Perform Remix FX over individual tracks or the entire song 
• Use the scale mode to limit notes to fit the key of your song
• Tap and strum entire chords using Chord Strip view
• Make simple or dramatic changes to your sounds with Smart Controls
• Add the Arpeggiator plug-in to any instrument
Navigate Logic Projects
• Operate basic transport controls like start, stop, record, and cycle
• Swipe the LCD or bar ruler to navigate to any location
• Select and jump to any Logic project marker
• Control recordings on your Mac from another room
• Browse the Sound Library and remotely change Patches
• Enable Smart Help and hover over interface elements on your Mac to display documentation on your iPad
• Remotely trigger Logic key commands with customizable buttons
Mix Your Logic Sessions
• Use Multi-Touch gestures to adjust Mixer volume, pan, solo, and mute controls
• Swipe to scroll or jump in banks to navigate through Mixer faders
• Use the level meter strip to monitor levels and identify clipping 
• Enable and change automation modes for each fader
• Use Multi-Touch gestures to shape the tone of your tracks with Visual EQ
• Plug-in view provides access to Logic or Audio Unit plug-in parameters
*Smart Controls, Sound Library navigation, Smart Help, full mixer, and access to plug-in controls are available only on iPad

bluejetty:00145886:ios.name: MWeb - Markdown Writing, Notes
bluejetty:00145886:ios.summary:
MWeb was born in 2015. It is a writing, note-taking and publishing app focusing on Markdown. If you like Markdown or text writing, We highly recommend you try MWeb.
MWeb is composed of a complete and stable editor, a Folders mode for manag
bluejetty:00145886:ios.description:
MWeb was born in 2015. It is a writing, note-taking and publishing app focusing on Markdown. If you like Markdown or text writing, We highly recommend you try MWeb.
MWeb is composed of a complete and stable editor, a Folders mode for managing documents, a Library mode specifically for notes, and a document publishing and sharing function set, with a total of four modules. The feature of MWeb's software is that it chooses platform-native technology for each platform. It is built using AppKit on macOS and UIKit on iOS/iPadOS. The following is a brief introduction to these four modules. If you are interested, you can continue reading.
## Editor features
Here are some of the key features of an editor:
* Base on CommonMark syntax and GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) extended syntax, supporting TOC, tables, code blocks, math formulas, task lists, footnotes, etc.
* Display the text of the Markdown document completely without any deletion.
* Images can be displayed directly in the Editor, supporting jpg, png, gif, webP, HEIC and etc.
* Math formulas, mermaid and Echarts drawings can be previewed in the editor.
* You can set your favorite font or multiple fonts for writing.
* You can choose from 11 light themes and 21 dark themes, and also support custom themes.
* There is a menu to facilitate the input of Markdown syntax, and a special Markdown syntax keyboard is also provided in iOS.
* Convenient tools for generating and formatting Markdown table syntax.
* You can view the outline and word count of Markdown documents.
* Markdown documents can be previewed and support Editor & Preview mode.
## Folders mode
The first requirement of Markdown is to create and edit Markdown documents, and MWeb's Folders mode does this. It supports the following features:
* Create Markdown, Textbundle documents, or simply open them for editing.
* Introduce a folder with Markdown documents into the Folders mode of MWeb. MWeb will provide practical functions such as management of Markdown documents, full-text search, copy and paste to insert images, and unified storage of referenced images.
* iPadOS/iOS version supports Dropbox folders.
## Library mode
Markdown is so easy to use, so taking notes is also in great demand. Of course, you can use Folders mode and introduce a folder to take notes, which is also very nice and easy to share. So why do we still create a separate Library mode? Mainly, the Library mode has the following features:
* There is no need to consider the file name, title and storage location, Just create note and writing.
* Use category trees and tags to manage notes. A single note can be classified into multiple categories, making it easier to set categories for notes.
* Organizing notes is more convenient. When moving categories and notes, renaming categories will not affect each other. You don't need to worry about incorrect associations between notes, incorrect reference location of images and attachments in notes, etc.
* Complete cross-device synchronization using iCloud CloudKit technology.
* The Library follows the "local first" principle and is stored in a folder, very easy for backup. Even if you use iCloud sync, your Library can be completely backed up locally.
* Export the entire category of notes to PDF or Epub e-book.
* The macOS version of MWeb Pro also supports generating static blogs from categories. The generated blog fully supports math formulas, mermaid, echarts etc. Allows you to create your own blog in a very simple way.
## More features...
* Publish documents or notes to Wordpress, Metaweblog API, Evernote, Blogger, Tumblr, Yuque, sspai Matrix, Ghost and Medium.
* Upload images in documents or notes to imgur, Qiniu, SM.MS, Tencent COS, Youpai, Alibaba OSS, custom API, etc.
* Export documents or notes to PDF (with Table of Contents in macOS version).
* Export documents or notes to Epub or image.
Privacy Policy: https://www.mweb.im/policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.mweb.im/terms.html
Hope you enjoy MWeb!

• Just train: no timer, no setup. Every exercise tracked.
• Strength: just lift. Atlon logs every set at the weight you set.
• AMRAP, RFT (rounds for time), EMOM and Intervals: set up in seconds with a slider, no crown needed.
MADE FOR THE MIDDLE OF A WORKOUT
• Big, clear numbers: your work or rest timer leads, with total time and heart rate beside it.
• A live strip of your session shows every set: how long it lasted and how hard you worked.
• Count a round with one tap, or with a double tap of your fingers on supported watches. Hit it twice? Undo.
• Pause, resume and end from one page, with a confirmation so you never end a workout by accident.

Type the workout, paste a screenshot or snap the whiteboard, before you train or after. Want it different? Just say so.

RESULTS ON YOUR WRIST AND YOUR IPHONE
After every workout, right on your wrist: your points, time, rounds, heart rate, effort and top exercises. On your iPhone, Home opens on today's workout, and the Workouts tab shows all of it and every set. A class recorded in pieces (warm-up, strength, WOD) counts as one workout.

POINTS THAT ADD UP

37 EXERCISES, RECOGNISED ON YOUR WATCH
Including air bike, bench press, bike erg, box jumps, box step-ups, burpees, carries, cleans, clean and jerks, deadlifts, devil presses, double-unders, front squats, GHD sit-ups, handstand push-ups, handstand walks, kettlebell swings, lunges, muscle-ups, overhead squats, planks, pull-ups, push-ups, ring rows, rowing, running, shoulder-to-overhead, single-unders, sit-ups, ski erg, snatches, squats, thrusters, toes-to-bar, wall balls and wall climbs.
Recognition runs on your watch, in every workout mode, and gets better with every release.
WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
Atlon uses your heart rate and calories during workouts and saves your workouts to Apple Health, so your Activity rings stay up to date.

inFlow Inventory is used in over 90 countries to manage inventory, sales, purchasing, and manufacturing.

Create and manage orders without a computer.

Generate invoices from any order and email them straight from the app. Your customers can even pay your invoices online (US & Canada only). 
Transfer and adjust stock at any time.
Need to adjust inventory due to damaged goods? Sending something back to your main warehouse? inFlow makes these tasks easy and fast. 
Manage product, vendor and customer details.
No need to call the back office to check on stock. inFlow gives you full access to item details and current quantities. You’ll also have vendor and customer information you need to get the job done. 
If you have any questions, issues or requests, please contact us at support@inflowinventory.com.
We’re ready and happy to help!

bluejetty:00017824:ios.description:
ELLIPAL Wallet is a secure, simple, all-in-one crypto wallet app.
MOST WALLETS ADD BETTER LOCKS. WE REMOVED THE DOORS.
ELLIPAL Titan series cold wallets have no Bluetooth, no Wi-Fi and no USB data transfer. Transactions reach them by scanning a QR code. ELLIPAL X Card signs transactions with a tap over NFC. Your ELLIPAL cold wallet stays offline throughout the signing process.
YOUR KEYS NEVER LEAVE THE CHIP
Private keys are generated inside a CC EAL5+/6+ certified Secure Chip and never leave the chip. The ELLIPAL App holds no private keys — it only builds the transaction. Your cold wallet signs it completely offline and sends back only the signed result.
WORKS WITH ELLIPAL COLD WALLETS
- ELLIPAL Titan series — the flagship air-gapped cold wallets
- ELLIPAL X Card — an NFC cold wallet you carry
EXTENSIVE BLOCKCHAIN & TOKEN SUPPORT
- 45+ Blockchains: BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, XLM, BNB, TRON and more
- 100+ Stablecoins: USDT, USDC, USDe, RLUSD, DAI, USD1 and more

bluejetty:00120124:ios.summary:
The Evolution of the Flashcard — FlashGreek: Mounce Edition!
From the makers of PαrsεGrεεk & FlαshGrεεk Pro — Multimedia Flashcards for learning New Testament Greek, designed to be compatible with William Mounce's Basics of Biblical Greek
bluejetty:00120124:ios.description:
The Evolution of the Flashcard — FlashGreek: Mounce Edition!
From the makers of PαrsεGrεεk & FlαshGrεεk Pro — Multimedia Flashcards for learning New Testament Greek, designed to be compatible with William Mounce's Basics of Biblical Greek (2010).
The flashcards are keyed to the chapters of the textbook and include the following:
- image/mnemonics
- audio for both sides of the card (Erasmian pronunciation)
- a contextual example for all forms
Tailor quizzes to your needs, including as much or as little of the extra content as you want. Or sit back and study in slideshow mode ! Either way, you'll be acing those vocab tests in no time.
BEFORE YOU BUY - consider whether you need flashcards beyond your first year of Greek. If so, then we recommend purchasing FlashGreek Pro, as it it contains ALL words in the Greek New Testament AND is keyed to Mounce's intro grammar. FlashGreek Pro allows you also to study by frequency or root, and to drill yourself on Principal Parts too.
*Disclaimer 1* I am in no way associated with the publisher nor the author of the grammar. This is not an official companion app - it is simply compatible with the text.
**Disclaimer 2** I have tried my darndest to be entirely accurate with the vocabulary lists according to chapters in the textbook. But mistakes do happen— my apologies if there are any. Please be responsible and check these flashcards against your textbook to ensure accuracy. If there are errors, please let us know and they will be fixed.
***Disclaimer 3*** The meanings in these flashcards derive from the awesome ©Accordance Bible Software, and sometimes particular authors view some words slightly differently. In most cases the differences are minor and inconsequential - but again, be responsible and check them against your textbook.

bluejetty:00186938:ios.description:
We help you organize the attendance process, save time running instant reports, and go paperless. Whether you are a teacher, instructor, or coach, you will find all you need in the Alora app. 
Effortless and straightforward setup. Various attendance marks and notes help to stay on top of the attendance tracking process. Exportable reports save time and make it easy to track attendance in multiple classes or events. Collaboration allows you to work together with your team. Available on iPhone and iPad.
FREE FEATURES:
- UNLIMITED CLASSES: Setup up your classes according to your schedule (weekdays, time, student groups).
- UNLIMITED STUDENTS: Add or import your students.
- TRACK ATTENDANCE: Track dates of classes attended for each student across multiple classes.
- ADD NOTES: You can add notes to record additional info (example: late 15 min, excused, etc.)
- MULTI-DEVICE SYNC: Instant synchronization between all your devices.
PREMIUM FEATURES:
* Access a free trial after you download the app
- INTELLIGENT REPORTS: There are three types of reports that help you spot attendance trends for each student or an entire class.
- PDF & CSV EXPORT: Export attendance reports in multiple formats.
- COLLABORATION: Invite and work together with your team.
LOVE THE APP?
Please rate us on the App Store. You’re the best!
SUPPORT
Have questions, want to learn more about our features, or want to share your feedback? We love hearing from you, so go ahead and shoot us an email at support@aloraapp.com – and we’ll get back to you pronto.
PAYMENT INFORMATION
In addition to our free app, we offer two types of Premium membership: Monthly and Annual. All subscriptions and payments are offered via in-app purchase and will be charged to your iTunes account as soon as we confirm the purchase. All subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of your selected subscription duration. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, depending on the option you have selected. All subscriptions can be managed through the App Store. Note: If you upgrade to Premium before the end of your free trial, any unused portion of the trial will be forfeited.
TERMS OF SERVICE
Terms Of Use: https://aloraapp.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://aloraapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00086762:ios.description:
Lalamove Driver App - Deliver and Earn Anytime, Anywhere
The Lalamove Driver app connects you with customers needing delivery or ride services, letting you earn competitive income on your own schedule. No bosses, no fixed hours—just earnings, freedom, and flexibility. Powered by technology, Lalamove operates in 14 markets across Asia, Latin America, and EMEA, seamlessly connecting people, vehicles, freight, and roads to move what matters and bring valuable benefits to local communities.
Drive & Earn Anytime, Anywhere with Lalamove Driver App
• Choose when you work - mornings, evenings, weekends, or full-time
• No auto-assigned orders - accept orders that fit your preferences and location
• Easy earnings cash-out - fast payouts
• Multiple vehicle options - trucks, vans, motorcycles are welcome
• Real-time tracking system - efficient route planning and delivery management
Exclusive Benefits for Our Valued Driver Partners
• Complete missions to earn attractive bonuses on top of your regular fares
• Exclusive partner discounts on fuel, vehicle maintenance, and more
• Strong support system to ensure that you and your customers are well protected
Join Our Thriving Driver Community
Become part of our rapidly expanding network of drivers who have chosen Lalamove as their platform for flexible and rewarding earnings. As a leading on-demand delivery and ride-hailing platform, we connect millions of users with drivers like you every single day, creating abundant opportunities in major cities around the globe.
Get Started Quickly and Easily
1. Download the App: Get the free "Lalamove Driver" app 
2. Create Your Account: Fill in your personal details and upload your ID, driver's license, and vehicle documents.
3. Complete Training: Learn how to use the app and maximize your earnings
4. Start Earning Immediately: Begin accepting all delivery (and ride) orders and earn income right away!
NEW: Double Your Opportunities with Ride-Hailing in Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam!
We don't just do delivery, now we take ride orders too in select markets. Boost your income potential by seamlessly accepting both delivery orders and passenger ride requests – all within the same Lalamove Driver app! Enjoy the flexibility to switch between services based on demand in your area and your personal preferences.
- Accept ride requests from passengers in your area
- Enjoy competitive fares for both services
- Maintain the same flexible schedule
Whether you're a full-time driver or looking to earn extra money on the side, Lalamove is the perfect platform for you. Download the Lalamove Driver app today and start earning on your own terms!

Enter the Arena! Build your Battle Deck and outsmart the enemy in fast real-time battles. From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS comes a real-time multiplayer battle game starring your favourite Clash characters and more. Start battling against players from around the world!
Clash Royale is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.
BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING
Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle!
Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Princesses from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match.
COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS
Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection!
BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world.
Compete for glory and rewards!
SEASONAL EVENTS
Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test!
JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR
Join or form a Clan with other players to share Cards and battle in Clan Wars for BIG rewards!
See you in the Arena!

bluejetty:00172310:android.summary:
HEDERA GUILD GAME - Slime World Major Update
Slime World is back with an exciting new look! With this major rebranding update, explore a broader world, enjoy diverse features, and experience a user-friendly interface that enhances gameplay.
bluejetty:00172310:android.description:
HEDERA GUILD GAME - Slime World Major Update
Slime World is back with an exciting new look! With this major rebranding update, explore a broader world, enjoy diverse features, and experience a user-friendly interface that enhances gameplay.
We’ve also prepared welcome events for new, returning, and existing users, along with community and game-based events. Join us and dive into the fun!
✪ SlimeWorld Major Update Highlights
 ● MAIN UI
 ● Two New Minigames (Super Jump, Road Crossing)
 ● Roulette
 ● Profile System
 ● Friends Feature
 ● Chat Function
 ● Multi-Staking
 ● Three New Languages (Vietnamese, Filipino, Indonesian)
 ● Transition to HGG (Hedera Guild Games) Token
✪ Game Overview
HGG (Hedera Guild Game) Token
 ● Earn Orichalcum through gameplay and exchange it for HGG Tokens, based on Hedera's blockchain! 
 ● The HGG Token is listed on major global exchanges like HTX, MEXC, Poloniex, GOPAX, and INDODAX, allowing for easy trade.
 ● Slime NFTs can be traded in the in-game NFT marketplace.
PVP Arena Mode
 ● If you own an NFT, showcase its power in PvP Arena Mode! Don’t have an NFT? Join with our rental system to get started.
Infinite Mode
 ● Battle waves of enemies in this strategic random defense game! The more enemies you defeat, the more Orichalcum you earn. Exchange Orichalcum for HGG Tokens and boost your gameplay!
Mini-Games
 ● Enjoy a range of mini-games in Slime World for extra fun and rewards! Each mini-game is filled with challenges to keep you entertained.
Roulette
 ● Spin the roulette for a chance to win rare items and resources! Become the hero of Slime World and strengthen your gameplay with these exciting rewards.
HGG Token Staking
 ● Experience innovation with our "Multi-Staking" service. Stake multiple assets simultaneously for diverse rewards, enjoying enhanced benefits through Slime World’s unique multi-staking offerings.
Profile, Chat, and Friends
 ● Customize your profile with your NFT, flags, and emblems, and express yourself in Slime World! Connect with friends and enjoy real-time chat to share strategies and build teamwork.
◈ Official Community Links
 ● Brand Page: https://hguild.io/
 ● Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/hederaguildgame
 ● Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hederaguildgame
 ● Twitter: https://x.com/HederaGuildGame
 ● Teleg

bluejetty:00019043:ios.summary: Looking for a fast, reliable, and easy-to-use dice roller? Whether you’re in the middle of a game night, need a quick random dice roll, or simply don’t have physical dice nearby, Dice Roller Pro gives you instant, accurate results every tim
bluejetty:00019043:ios.description:
Looking for a fast, reliable, and easy-to-use dice roller? Whether you’re in the middle of a game night, need a quick random dice roll, or simply don’t have physical dice nearby, Dice Roller Pro gives you instant, accurate results every time. Choose your dice, tap to roll, and enjoy smooth, realistic rolling—it’s as simple as that.
Dice Roller Pro is a powerful, intuitive, and beautifully designed dice rolling app created for all your dice needs. Enjoy quick access to multiple dice types, customisable styles, and effortless rolling, making it perfect for board games, family games, RPGs, tabletop adventures, and any activity that needs a fair and random dice result. With Dice Roller Pro, you always have a complete set of dice in your pocket.
Top Features You’ll Love:
• Roll multiple dice at once – Roll up to six dice simultaneously, including d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, and d20, ideal for board games and role-playing games.
• Accurate random results – Dice Roller Pro uses a dependable random number generator to ensure every dice roll is fair, unpredictable, and trustworthy.
• Shake-to-Roll interaction – Add more fun by shaking your device to roll the dice, creating a realistic dice-rolling experience.
• Customise your dice – Choose from a variety of dice styles, colours, themes, and spot designs to create the perfect set for your game.
• Perfect for every game – Ideal for Monopoly, Cluedo, Yahtzee, Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder, and any game requiring reliable dice rolls.
Who Can Use Dice Roller Pro?
This dice roller app is designed for everyone—from casual players needing quick random numbers to dedicated tabletop and RPG gamers who want a professional, polished, and always-ready dice tool. Whether you’re rolling for initiative, settling a friendly competition, choosing a number, or running a full game session, Dice Roller Pro gives you fast, accurate dice rolls whenever you need them.
Download Dice Roller Pro today and make every dice roll easier, faster, and more enjoyable. Never worry about missing dice again—roll anytime, anywhere with the ultimate dice roller on your device.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00177507:ios.description:
Hey there! Do you enjoy puzzle solving and relaxing colorful ball popping? Then you are in right place. From the makers of Princess Pop, Gummy Pop, and Frozen Pop, we welcome you to our new classic Bubble Shooter Original Game. 
Dive deep into the world's colorful bursting adventure with brain-teasing puzzles and addictive levels. A never-ending bubble pop journey with spectacular animation, daily rewards, and challenging levels this bubble shooter original game is the best balloon bursting puzzle you are looking for.

bluejetty:00176350:ios.description:
1-Tap to fall asleep easily, relax, or focus.
Say goodbye to sleepless nights and fussy babies. 
Green, Brown, Pink, and White noise help you sleep better & relax in different ways.
Rain sounds, Lofi Music, Brainwaves, and Healing Frequencies all work to calm your mind and body. 
New and Easy-to-Use Features of Color Sleep:
* Most versatile high-quality white noise.
* Colored Noise: Pink, Green & Brown Noise.
* Recommended Soothing Sleep Sounds.
* Integrated Sleep Timer that fades out noise after a set time.
* 1-Tap to play: simple and effective, not hindered.
* Without any distracting digital looping.
* Play on speakers, AirPods, or HomePod.
* Control from the lock screen.
* Background mode
* Auto Play mode
There are numerous benefits to using Color Sleep:
• Helps you sleep by blocking distractions
• Relaxes and reduces stress
• Pacifies fussy and crying babies
• Increases focus while enhancing privacy
• Soothes headaches and migraines
• Masks tinnitus (ringing of the ears)
Discover four types of noise with unique properties:
① Green noise resembles natural sounds like ocean waves or waterfalls, ideal for gentle ambient noise while falling asleep.
② Pink noise mixes high and low frequencies, resembling falling rain or ocean waves, offering a soft and calming experience.
③ Brown noise, deeper than pink noise, features more bass tones and concentrated low-frequency energy, akin to hard ocean surf during a storm or a low note from a brass instrument.
④ White noise, encompassing all audible frequencies, effectively masks outside sounds, aiding in quicker sleep onset. It resembles the static from an unused cable TV channel.
Experience curated sleep sounds and healing sounds for the mind & body:
① Rain Sounds: Calm your mind with the soothing ambiance of rain sounds, perfect for relaxation and sleep. The gentle patter of rain promotes tranquility, masking background noises for improved sleep quality.
② Healing Frequencies: Explore the therapeutic benefits of healing frequencies like 528Hz and 432Hz, fostering harmony and inner peace during sleep.
③ Brainwaves: Influence your mental state with brainwave sounds, facilitating relaxation and sleep for a restful night.
④ Lo-Fi Music: Immerse yourself in Lo-Fi music for a relaxed atmosphere that reduces stress and enhances sleep quality.
ColorSleep helps ADULTS sleep by:
- Blocking out unwanted noises
- Forming a sleep association that cues you to fall asleep

TV Remote: Control Smart TV transforms your iPhone into a powerful universal remote, allowing you to effortlessly control a wide range of smart TVs and streaming devices. No more juggling multiple physical remotes – one app is all you need to manage all your streaming equipment.
## KEY FEATURES
### Multi-Device Control
Supports a full range of mainstream streaming devices and smart TVs, with more compatible devices coming soon.
### Smart Detection
Auto-discovers all compatible devices on your home Wi-Fi network. Instant pairing is available with no complicated setup steps.
### Multi-Room Management
Switch seamlessly between devices in different rooms. You can instantly control streaming devices in the living room and smart TVs in the bedroom with just one tap.
### Touch Interface
A large, responsive touchpad provides precise navigation. Enjoy smooth scrolling and quick launching of various video and audio apps.
### Smart Text Input
Type with your iOS keyboard or issue voice commands – ideal for content searches and account logins.
### Apple Watch Support
Take control of your devices right from your wrist. Adjust volume, navigate menus, and play/pause content effortlessly via Apple Watch.
### Quick App Access
One-tap launch for popular streaming apps like Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, Hulu, Prime Video and more, instantly starting your viewing experience.
### Full Playback Control
Achieve full playback control across all controlled devices, including play, pause, rewind, fast-forward, and volume adjustment.
## WHY CHOOSE TV REMOTE: CONTROL SMART TV?
This app breaks down ecosystem barriers with a unified interface for cross-platform control. It is fast, reliable, and constantly expanding with new features. Perfect for:
• Households with multiple smart devices
• Users wanting to replace multiple remote apps with just one
• Anyone looking to reduce clutter from physical remotes
• Cord-cutters seeking simplified control over their streaming setup
## COMPATIBILITY
• Mainstream streaming devices
• Smart TVs of various brands
• iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch
## REQUIREMENTS
• Streaming devices connected to your home Wi-Fi
• iPhone/iPad on the same Wi-Fi network as the controlled devices

Christmas Coloring Pages & Easy Drawing Activities

Designed for children of all ages with a simple and intuitive interface. No ads, no tracking, no external links, and no interruptions. Works completely offline — perfect for travel, long drives, plane trips, restaurants, and quiet moments at home during the holiday season.
New Christmas Content Every Week
New coloring sheets, drawing models, winter scenes, and creative prompts are added throughout December for continuous discovery and fresh holiday fun.
Optional Christmas Countdown (Advent Activity)
Children can enjoy a daily Christmas countdown with a new drawing or coloring activity unlocking each day — just like a digital Advent calendar that builds excitement until Christmas.

bluejetty:00062591:ios.description:
Preply: Learn Languages with Real Tutors - Anytime, Anywhere
Looking for the best way to learn a new language? Preply is more than just another language learning app: It’s a complete online learning platform and app that connects you with thousands of professional tutors for live, personalized classes. Unlike gamified apps that rely only on repetitive exercises, Preply gives you the flexibility of self-study combined with the structure, accountability, and human connection of real teachers.
With the Preply app, you can:
• Learn on the go - Book and attend lessons from anywhere, right from your phone.
• Access thousands of expert tutors - Choose teachers based on price, ratings, availability, or specialization.
• Practice real conversations - Build confidence by speaking with a live tutor instead of memorizing phrases.
• Flexible scheduling - Book lessons that fit your lifestyle, whether daily practice or weekly study.
• Study over 90 languages - English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, and more.
• Track your progress - Follow your learning journey with clear goals and personalized feedback.
Why Preply?
Most language apps stop at vocabulary drills or gamified practice. Preply takes you further by connecting you with real people who adapt lessons to your goals. Want to prepare for exams? Boost your career opportunities? Improve pronunciation? Preply tutors customize your learning path, so every lesson gets you closer to fluency.
Key Benefits of the Preply App
• Structured alternative to gamified apps: Skip endless exercises and focus on meaningful progress.
• Personalized learning: Lessons tailored to your level, learning style, and objectives.
• Affordable options: Tutors for every budget, with transparent pricing and secure payment.
• Convenient experience: Same great Preply platform, optimized for mobile so you can learn anytime.
• Trusted by learners worldwide: Millions of students already use Preply to achieve their language goals.
How It Works
• Download the Preply app.
• Choose your tutor: Filter by language, specialty, budget, or availability.
• Book your first lesson: Flexible scheduling makes it easy.
• Learn & track progress: Stay motivated with real results and ongoing support.
Whether you’re a beginner or advanced learner, preparing for exams, traveling abroad, or building a global career, Preply helps you succeed. With Preply, you’re not just downloading an app, you’re joining a global learning platform built to support your growth. 
Learn languages your way, with the flexibility of an app and the reliability of real classes. 
Start your language journey today. Download Preply and discover why it’s the best app for live tutoring, online language classes, and personalized learning.

bluejetty:00141218:ios.description:

- Save favorite locations for future reference
- Major & Minor Feeding / Activity Periods
- Tides forecast
- Day Rating
- Moon Rise / Moon Set Times
- Sunrise / Sunset Times
- Day / Month Views
- Current Weather and 5-Day Forecast
- Calendar for checking solunar data in advance

bluejetty:00069185:ios.description:
Looking for a new keyboard that will reflect your style? No need to worry – just try out Luxury Gold Keyboard Themes and bring some elegance into your life now! Indulge yourself with cool and eye-catching keypad changer designed especially for those with unique and sophisticated style. Customize your phone by choosing one of stylish neon, golden or simple keyboards backgrounds, amazing key sounds and funny emojis that will turn everyday texting into an extraordinary experience.
How to set your stunning keyboard theme:
When you download the app from the app store for the first time then go to Settings > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add new keyboard > from where you will select Luxury Gold Keyboard Themes. 
In case your selected keyboard was not activated click Settings button next to Space button on your keyboard, after which you will see a list of installed keyboards along with Luxury Gold Keyboard Themes so you can choose your new keyboard skin and enjoy.
* Choose from many cool designs to customize your keyboard
* Write funny messages and insert cool emoji
* A huge collection of symbols and emoticons for all your moods
* Choose the default language: English, Spanish, Malay, Vietnamese, Turkish, Italian, French, German, Portuguese, Polish, or Romanian
* Quick message option for fast typing
* Choose from many key sounds
Pick your own keypad skin that reflects your personality! Catch everyone’s attention with your awesome neon keyboards designs, or feel like a celebrity every time you have simple or golden keys under your fingertips. Check out many sounds and emoticons that you can use in your messages and comments and add a sense of elegance to your life. Download the coolest custom keyboard changer now and text with style!
----------
Gold Keyboard terms of service
1 week Keyboard + from 4.99$ per week (prices may vary slightly depending on the region).
1 month Keyboard + from 19.99$ per month (prices may vary slightly depending on the region)
You can find all in-app purchases on this app store page below under “In-app purchases”.

You can manage your subscriptions in the iOS settings and switch the automatic renewal on or off. A subscription that is already running cannot be canceled within the term that has already started.

Terms: https://zipoapps.com/luxurykeyboardios/terms/

bluejetty:00073761:ios.summary:
Make new social friends with Wave. If you want to request someone's profile swipe right, or swipe left if you are not interested. Links to your social media are kept private until you approve a user.
Wave Features:
- Fun swiping to make ne
bluejetty:00073761:ios.description:
Make new social friends with Wave. If you want to request someone's profile swipe right, or swipe left if you are not interested. Links to your social media are kept private until you approve a user.
Wave Features:
- Fun swiping to make new friends.
- Location aware search, find nearby friends!
- Make local friends with location aware search.
- Add them on social media or get to know them directly in Wave.
- Connect with new people on your favorite social media apps [Instagram, Tik Tok, Twitter].
- Let other people discover you on your favorite social media apps.
- Make new friends from around the world.
- Send disappearing text messages.
- Send animated GIFs by Giphy.
- Take 10 seconds videos that can only be viewed once and send them to your friends.
- Take photos that can only be viewed once and send them to your friends.
- Chat with your matches directly on Wave.
- Chat and Ephemeral messages include screenshot protection. If someone takes a screenshot of a chat, photo or video you send them their account will be automatically suspended.
- Screen Recording Protection: If Wave detects that the screen is being recorded the app will refuse to open up chat.
- Automatic screenshot protection, if a user takes a screenshot of a chat they will get suspended.
- Upload verified photos directly in the app so others know you are REAL using the built in camera and machine learning.
- Filter out fake users by only showing users with at least one verified selfie.
Go make new friends today!
Wave is a fun way to connect with new people, chat with them, ,meet new people with similar interests, send ephemeral photos and videos and look at their linked profiles.
------------------
Unlimited gems and boosted profile views are available through a VIP Subscription
If you choose to purchase a VIP Subscription payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don't choose to purchase a VIP Subscription, you can simply use Wave for free.
For more information read:
Terms of Use: https://www.getwave.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.getwave.app/privacy
This app is not affiliated with any 3rd party social media apps.

Welcome to Local Mate—the dating app that turns chance encounters into exciting possibilities. Whether you're here to meet someone new nearby, spark a casual romance, or keep things playful, Local Mate brings the fun back to dating!
What Makes Local Mate Unique
-No Fake Profiles, Just Real People
Say goodbye to boring matches! Everyone on Local Mate is real, verified, and ready to mingle. Connect with active users who are here for the same reason you are—to meet someone amazing!

Why wait for the perfect opener? Dive straight into real-time conversations with our instant chat feature. Exchange fun banter, share cheeky jokes, and discover sparks that keep the conversation going.
-Find Matches Next Door
Looking for someone nearby? Local Mate uses smart location-based matching to connect you with people close to you. Your next coffee date, late-night chat, or spontaneous adventure could be just around the corner!
-Keep It Light, Keep It Fun
Not ready for big commitments? No problem! Local Mate is perfect for those who want to explore, and enjoy the thrill of meeting new people without pressure.
-The Right Match, Every Time
Our advanced matching system goes beyond looks to find people who get your vibe. Whether it’s shared interests or a magnetic personality, Local Mate helps you find someone you click with effortlessly.
Ready to Make Your Move?
Download Local Mate today and start exploring a world of playful possibilities. Whether it’s flirty banter, casual meetups, or something more adventurous, your next exciting connection is just a tap away!
You can contact our Customer Support at contactus@localmateapp.com

bluejetty:00174717:ios.description:
Be prepared! Plan your next trip to one of the great California parks. Download maps and guides before you venture into the Wi-Fi free wilderness.
Discover
- 400+ national parks, state parks, monuments, forests
- 340+ neatly folded maps by the National Park Service, Bureau of Land Management, United States Forest Services, and other agencies.
- Motor Vehicle Use Maps (MVUM), Motor Vehicle Travel Maps (MVTM) and visitor maps for California national forests.
- 5,000+ campgrounds and campsites
- 6,200+ trails and trailheads
- 140,000+ points of interests
Plan 
- Download maps, park brochures, and newspapers. These downloads are ready when you are offline and off the grid in the great outdoors.
- Download arbitrary map sections as offline packs.
- Photo galleries, panorama views.
- Share links to parks and maps with friends
Have fun
- GPS and GPX support: record your hikes, import GPX routes, tracks and waypoints for your hiking trails.
- Detailed national park information: alerts, news, visitor centers, campgrounds, driving directions, weather.
- Open your favorite maps app to get a route to the selected park.
- Current weather conditions, easy access to multi-day forecasts, sunrise and sunset times.
- Push notifications for park alerts, park news, weather warnings
