bluejetty:00138288:ios.description:
The CDL DMV Written Test app provides a robust suite of comprehensive CDL practice exams across all 50 states. Tailored for current and prospective commercial drivers, this app delivers detailed practice tests for Class A and Class B general knowledge, air brakes, combination tests, and various CDL endorsements including Bus, Hazmat, Double/Triple, and Passenger endorsements. From tackling the Florida hazmat test to acing the California CDL practice test, this app ensures you are thoroughly prepped for the specific demands of your state's DMV.
**Benefits:**
- **High Success Rate:** Join the 99.2% of users who pass their CDL exams on the first attempt with the help of CDL DMV Written Test.
- **Efficient Study Time:** Our targeted practice tests are designed to minimize your study hours while maximizing content retention and understanding.
- **First-Try Guarantee:** Approach your CDL test with the confidence and knowledge necessary to pass on your initial attempt, saving both time and money on retakes.
**Features:**
- **User-Friendly Interface:** Our app's straightforward layout and easy navigation make it accessible for users of all tech levels.
- **2026 Test Updates:** Stay updated with the latest CDL practice questions and answers that reflect the most recent standards and regulations.
- **Free Practice Tests:** Gain unlimited access to a wide array of practice tests, all available without any fees or hidden costs.
- **No Registration Required:** Jump straight into your test prep without the hassle of account creation.
- **Nationwide Coverage:** Prepare effectively with state-specific tests, from the Nebraska CDL practice test to the Pennsylvania hazmat test.
- **Comprehensive Test Preparation:** Cover all necessary material with tests designed for both Class A and Class B CDL, ensuring complete readiness.
- **Endorsements Included:** Access extensive practice tests for all key endorsement categories such as hazardous materials, tankers, passengers, and more.
**Download the CDL DMV Written Test app today to streamline your journey to becoming a licensed commercial driver.** With expert tools and comprehensive resources readily available, this app is your ultimate guide to achieving success on your CDL exam, regardless of your state or chosen endorsements.

Discover an exciting birthday ques
bluejetty:00031287:ios.description:
Explore the world, play and learn with funny animals from Jungle Town! The app is suitable for children from 2 to 5 years old and does not require adult assistance! Play offline without internet anywhere.
Discover an exciting birthday quest and complete a variety of tasks with six cute animals! In each level you will find something interesting from real life. Do you want to know what? Welcome to the world of Jungle town!
Jungle town, a story-based game, consists of 6 mini-games on different themes, united by one plot. Here you will find 6 levels with exciting tasks:
Elephant's birthday. The birthday boy wants to invite friends to visit, but how can he arrange a holiday? Add decorations, of course! Help the elephant decorate the room, decorate the cake, inflate balloons and light the holiday candles!
The bully tiger cleverly thought of giving the elephant a ball, but here's the bad luck: he can't find it, because the room is a mess and the gift was lost somewhere among the things. Help the little tiger to remove trash, toys, clean the house from cobwebs and put clothes neatly in the closet.
Fashionista porcupine decided to give a shirt to an elephant, join her: choose fabric, patterns, cut and sew details, don't forget to add buttons!
A romantic monkey wants to give the elephant a bouquet of flowers. Just to start, flowers need to be grown. Dig up the beds, plant sprouts, take care of them and collect wonderful flowers in a festive bouquet.
An inventive raccoon came up with an eco-friendly bike for his friend the elephant. Help him sort parts, build a bicycle, inflate eco-friendly tires and add decorations.
The mischievous parrot has an orchard and loves to experiment in the kitchen. He also loves pranks, so he is preparing a rally for the elephant. Harvest berries and fruits for a gift cocktail, mix parrot recipes and laugh with the fun bird!
And after you complete all the levels, go to the festive party to find out what surprises the elephant has prepared for friends!
Jungle town is a game for preschool children with many interesting tasks to develop mindfulness and fine motor skills. Completing tasks, your child will not only have fun, but also learn about the world, acquire good habits. Want to teach your son or daughter useful skills? Welcome to Jungle town.
And also in our children's educational game you will find colorful pictures, cute kind characters, nice melodies, lots of funny animations and the final cartoon party!
Try Jungle town now!

Football DNA is e
bluejetty:00146178:ios.description:
The ultimate app for coach and player development through grassroots and elite coaching content from the professionals. Access over 1000 sessions across all age groups and abilities on video for you to watch, use & adapt.
Football DNA is everything to do with our beautiful game. It’s the best aspects from inside the professional game, brought to coaches, players and general lovers of football for your enjoyment and implementation. Giving you access to hundreds of coaching drills and sessions on video and in depth sports science programs and workouts. Also we have high quality Wellness and Nutrition information & recipes to help off the pitch performance! Plus even more content with top analysis videos along with interviews, webinars and coach education features.
We are determined to help all levels and age groups of the game develop, improve and aspire to be as good as they can be! From grassroots to professional coaches and players we have you covered right here! Developed by professionals in the game but for everyone!
Watch, use & adapt hundreds of videos from our professional coaches to use with your players. Develop individuals, groups & teams with our extensive range of content covering all areas of the game. Each is filmed for you to watch & understand easily with coaching points broken down on screen & available to download in PDF format. For all age groups & abilities from Grass Roots to Elite Level.
Focus on developing the physical condition of players with hundreds of pitch & gym based sessions all on video from our elite professional sports scientists. Access some outstanding content to implement on and off the pitch to push onto the next level. Exercise tutorials have been broken down to help improve technique as well as detailed sessions to help you build your own custom programs.
Watch interviews with top-level Managers, Coaches, Players, and people involved in the professional game. These videos give a brilliant insight into the minds of some top people playing in the professional game right now and ones who have already left their mark on the history of our beautiful game. Also included in this section is a series of analysis videos looking at some of the worlds best players & teams.

bluejetty:00170960:ios.description:
With Antidote Mobile, gain access to multiple high-quality dictionaries and language guides, all based on the renowned Antidote software.
Antidote Mobile offers rich definitions, abundant synonyms, extensive word combinations and much more, in an elegant and efficient interface. Use powerful search engines to find rhymes, anagrams, and other fascinating links between words. Access satellite images of 11,000 cities, countries and regions; definitions of 1,500 UNESCO World Heritage sites; Wikipedia articles; and other references of your choice. Listen to words and expressions in all their forms in two accents.
Boasting over 1000 articles, the guides cover all aspects of writing, from spelling to style, grammar and punctuation.
In Discovery Mode, set your sights on new words, proverbs or fascinating etymologies. Scroll through rare or common words, countries, famous people, and more. Create word lists that you can review and share with friends or students. Test your lexical knowledge with the game mode: guess, based on the definition, a random word or a word taken from your lists.
Antidote Mobile doesn’t need an Internet connection.† It is offered as a one-year renewable subscription, either by itself or as part of an Antidote+ plan (Druide account required).
RICH AND INNOVATIVE DICTIONARIES
• Words and expressions (172,000 entries including 17,000 proper nouns) 
• Synonyms (1.1 M)
 • Antonyms (100,000) 
• Combinations (1 M, with examples)
 • Semantic Fields (96,000)
 • Conjugation (9,500 verbs, with agreement controls) 
• Families (19,000)
 • Quotations (360,000)
 • History (147,000 etymologies)
 • Difficulties (50,000): homonyms, false friends, etc.
• Audio pronunciation of words, expressions and conjugations†
• Recitation of conjugations†
• Rhymes and near-rhymes
• Proverbs
 • Integrated access to 11,000 zoomable maps and satellite images† 
• Links to 1,500 UNESCO World Heritage sites† 
• Links to web complements (GDT, Termium, add your own)†
• Integrated access to Wikipedia†
DETAILED LANGUAGE GUIDES
• Grammar 
• Spelling 
• Punctuation
 • Style 
• Typography 
• Syntax 
• Lexicon
 • Phonetics
 • History 
• Language Matters 
• Business writing 
• Inclusive writing 
• 1990 Spelling Rectifications
FASCINATING DISCOVERIES
• Display words at random, to peruse the dictionary 
• Learn rare words
 • Ask for names of cities, countries or famous people 
• Discover the UNESCO World Heritage sites
 • Read fascinating notes about the origins of words
• Ponder edifying proverbs 
• Add your findings to a list of favorite words
• Play the game of guessing a word from its definition
 • Study your word lists and play them in the guessing game
 • Record your high scores for all game categories 
• Share your scores on social media†
HIGH-QUALITY INTERFACE
• Responsive interface adapts to all screen sizes of iPhone and iPad
 • Stage Manager and SplitView support
• Use portrait or landscape display 
• Display definitions right within your apps 
• Quick search of a word copied from another app
 • Search as you type, to find words quickly 
• Error-tolerant search (e.g. erruers) 
• Rhyme and anagram search 
• Wildcard search (e.g. lum*, c?re?)
 • “Word begins with/contains/ends with” searches 
• Multiword search (e.g.: table ronde, perdre pied) 
• Search by combinable criteria (domain, frequency, etc.)
• Tap any word to look it up
 • Create word or article lists and share them
 • Print any content
• Voice commands in French (e.g. “Synonymes de joie”)†
• Configure your shortcuts 
• Sync your favorites with iCloud†
 • Sync your favorites with Antidote and Antidote Web (with Antidote+ package)†
(Note: Antidote Mobile does NOT include the corrector.) 
(† Internet access only required for marked functions above.)

A Davis’s Notes Title, Perfect wherever you are…in class, in clinical, and in any practice setting! This handy guide delivers quick access to need-to-know information on DSM-5 disorders and treatments, psychotropic drugs, documentation, and patient education. No other resource delivers as much information in a format that’s as easy to read, easy to access the content on your mobile device.
KEY FEATURES
* Coverage of documentation • psychiatric medications, restraints, and seclusion • DSM-5 disorders and treatments • and patient education and care
* Basic behavioral theories at a glance
* Key aspects of psychiatric and crisis interventions
* General mental status assessments and exams, with focused assessments for adult and geriatric populations, including mini-cognitive assessment instrument for dementia and rating scale for Lewy Body diseases
* Essential information on psychotropic drugs
* Client/family education tables, tips, and strategies
* Cultural considerations and assessment tool
NEW TO THIS EDITION
* Addresses important topics such as Telepsychiatry and Teletherapy and more importantly the pandemic and its effect on mental health, both on individuals as well as health care providers.
* Several new psychotropics — for tardive dyskinesia, PTSD, treatment-resistant depression, and also a new medication for schizophrenia.
* Crises that deal with Covid and PTSD as well as the military, and geriatrics in a clinical pocket companion.
* Multiaxial assessment, CAGE, self-administered patient health questionnaires 2 and 9, and many other assessment tools
* Clinical pearls throughout to provide practical on-the-spot advice
* UPDATED & REVISED! All content thoroughly reviewed, revised, and updated to incorporate the newest knowledge in the field, including new drugs and drug updates.

Managing medications can feel repetitive or stressful. PillCat makes the routine a little easier and more enjoyable by combining practical medication tools with a cute cat that keeps you company along the way.
Whether you take daily medications, vitamins, supplements, birth control, or weekly injections, PillCat helps you stay organized and keep track of your routine.

◎ Your Cat Companion
• A cute cat accompanies you throughout your daily medication routine
• Turn everyday dose tracking into a friendlier, more relaxing experience
• Build a healthier routine with a little companion by your side

◎ Flexible Medication Reminders
• Set reminders for specific times, days, or repeating intervals
• Create daily, weekly, or custom medication schedules
• Support for medications, vitamins, supplements, injections, and more
• Choose alert styles that fit your routine

◎ Simple Dose Tracking
• Mark medications as taken in seconds
• See your medication history in a clear timeline
• Add notes to individual doses
• Easily check whether you've taken your medication

◎ Refill Reminders
• Get notified before your medication runs out
• Stay prepared and avoid interruptions to your routine

◎ Made for Everyday Life
PillCat is designed for anyone who wants a simpler and friendlier way to manage medications — from daily vitamins and supplements to long-term medication routines.

◎ Private, Offline & Completely Ad-Free
• No ads — enjoy a clean and distraction-free experience
• Your medication data is stored locally on your device
• Core features work without an internet connection
• No account required to get started

Simple reminders. Clear tracking. A cute companion by your side.
Make medication management easier with PillCat.

Welcome to the thrilling universe of "Goods Triple 3D: Sort Matching" – the ultimate haven for goods enthusiasts and casual gamers! Immerse yourself in the heart of Goods Triple 3D, where the art of sorting snacks, drinks, and fruits comes to life across meticulously crafted levels. Unleash the goods master in you by effortlessly matching identical 3D items on expansive shelves and conquering pair or triple matches with unparalleled finesse! 
How to Play 
Embark on an exhilarating journey within the dazzling world of Goods Triple 3D. Seamlessly triple-match identical 3D items on vast shelves, skillfully navigating through the array of goods. Bid farewell to space constraints – explore the random closet and devise your unique goods match 3D strategy. Become a true master, reveling in the joy of flawlessly organizing goods triple on the shelves in this immersive game!

An Abundance of Well-Designed Levels: Immerse yourself in a vast array of meticulously crafted triple match challenges, promising an enthralling casual match-3 experience at every turn.
Classic and Seamless Gameplay: Goods Triple 3D features effortlessly intuitive mechanics centered around sorting identical 3D items, ensuring a delightful and easy-to-pick-up experience for casual gaming enthusiasts.
Simple Yet Ingeniously Challenging: Don't be deceived by the apparent simplicity – mastering triple tile puzzles demands unwavering focus, quick thinking, and strategic acumen.
Useful Astuce in Goods Triple Match 3D: Conquer tricky sorting challenges with an arsenal of powerful power-ups and items, elevating your goods matching experience to new heights.
Flexible Approaches to Sorting: Develop and showcase your distinctive sorting style – there's no one-size-fits-all solution to achieving the perfect match, injecting strategic depth into the game.
Unadulterated Fun in Offline Mode: Relish uninterrupted sorting enjoyment anytime, anywhere! As an offline casual game, Goods Triple 3D lets you relax and immerse yourself in the pure joy of sorting without external pressures.
Endless Surprises in Goods Sorting: From occasional updates with new content to surprising seasonal events, Goods Triple 3D continuously adds unexpected twists to keep the goods master enthralled.
For aficionados of sorting games, Goods Triple 3D: Sorts Matching Game is a must-try. Delve into the realm of triple match 3D puzzles, challenging your intellect while savoring the world of goods sorting. bluejetty:00150080:ios.description:
An application to prepare and practice for the written exam conducted by states for journeyman electricians to be certified or licensed.
Do you want to become a certified or licensed journeyman electrician? You need to pass a written exam on the electrical theory, National Electrical Code (NEC) and Local Electrical Codes. 
Features of Journeyman Electrician App : 
Practice Tests:
You can go through various categories and practice huge number of questions so that you are well prepared for your exam. 
Mock Test :
Once you have done enough practice with the questions in different categories, you can Take a quick mock test to check your knowledge on the various subjects like electrical theory and National Electrical Code.
Test History :
Our app will keep the history of the mock tests taken by you which will give you an indication whether you are well prepared for the exam or not.
Bookmark Questions :
You can bookmark the questions which you think are important or you want to refer them later. 
Read all Questions :
If you have just started preparation for the examination or you are a beginner you can first real all questions and then practice or take mock test.
Who should use this app?
Anyone who wants to prepare for journeyman electrician examination and wants to get certified or licensed in different states of USA, Australia and Canada. This app comes very handy when preparing for the journeyman electrician test. If you want to refer to the important concepts of National Electrical Code then also this app is very useful.

bluejetty:00073300:ios.description:
Welcome to Bimi Boo "Kids Cooking: Toddler Games 2-5" – the perfect app to keep your little one entertained and educated! Designed to teach essential life skills through play, this fun and engaging game will unleash your child's inner chef.
Trusted by the largest teacher community in the USA: "We Are Teachers"!
Main Features of “Kids Cooking: Toddler Games”:
90+ Easy-to-Follow Recipes: Your child will learn basic cooking techniques and explore a variety of ingredients with step-by-step instructions to create dishes like pizza, donuts, tacos, sushi, and more.
10+ Unique Game Mechanics: These mechanics promote cognitive skills such as logic, mindfulness, problem-solving, hand-eye coordination, critical thinking, creativity, and imagination, helping your child develop essential life skills while having fun.
Easy-to-Follow Interface: The user-friendly design allows kids to play independently, giving parents peace of mind and time to focus on other tasks.
Safe and Age-Appropriate Content: Our app is designed specifically for young children, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience without inappropriate content.
No Ads: Enjoy uninterrupted play – our app contains no ads.
10 Diverse Restaurants and Cuisines: Kids will explore various themed restaurants, broadening their culinary horizons.
9 Cute Characters with Unique Reactions: Each character in the Bimi Boo universe displays different emojis and reactions, promoting healthy food choices and teaching your child about preferences and emotions.
Offline Play Information: An internet connection is needed to download content after purchasing a subscription. Once downloaded, your child can enjoy the app offline at any time.
At Bimi Boo Kids, we take pride in our extensive experience in early childhood development apps. Our core team has over 12 years of experience creating educational and engaging apps for young children, and we’re committed to providing high-quality, age-appropriate, and safe content.
We believe children learn best through play, and we strive to create a space where your child can explore, learn, and grow in a safe and enjoyable environment. Our carefully curated content aligns with the developmental needs of young children, ensuring that our games are both fun and educational.
Join Bimi Boo and his friends on this culinary adventure and let your child learn through play with “Kids Cooking: Toddler Games”.

bluejetty:00027815:ios.name: SparkReceipt: Receipt Scanner
bluejetty:00027815:ios.summary: SparkReceipt is an AI receipt scanner and expense tracker app for freelancers, self-employed professionals, and small business owners. Snap any receipt and SparkReceipt extracts the merchant, amount, date, category and line items in seconds
bluejetty:00027815:ios.description:
SparkReceipt is an AI receipt scanner and expense tracker app for freelancers, self-employed professionals, and small business owners. Snap any receipt and SparkReceipt extracts the merchant, amount, date, category and line items in seconds. Connect your inbox, forward email receipts, or upload PDFs and the app handles the rest.
EMAIL INBOX AUTO-SCANNING
Connect Gmail or Outlook and SparkReceipt automatically finds and imports email receipts as they arrive. You stay in control: review, approve, and exclude senders any time.
EMAIL RECEIPT FORWARDING
Prefer to file receipts manually? Forward eReceipts to your personal SparkReceipt address and the AI files them for you.
AI RECEIPT SCANNING (OCR)
The OCR receipt scanner reads paper receipts, PDF invoices, and forwarded email receipts in any language and currency. Smart categorization is based on the products on the receipt, not just the merchant name, so business expenses end up in the right account.
INCOME, EXPENSES, AND PROFIT/LOSS TRACKING
Track income alongside expenses for real-time profit and loss across your business. Tag expenses by client, project, or trip. Convert any currency at accurate historical daily rates for clean tax reporting.
MILEAGE TRACKER
Log business trips and claim every mile at tax time. Start a GPS-tracked drive with one tap, add trips by hand, or let SparkReceipt suggest trips from meetings with an address in your phone's calendar. You approve every suggestion. Assign trips to a vehicle, client, or project and SparkReceipt works out the reimbursement. Export your mileage log with your receipts for deduction-ready records.
ACCOUNTING INTEGRATIONS
Push categorized receipts straight into QuickBooks Online, Xero, or Zoho Books, or export reports as PDF, Excel, or CSV when your accountant asks. FreshBooks is in early access.
BANK FEEDS
Connect your bank account and SparkReceipt imports transactions and matches them to your receipts, so missing ones stand out before tax time. Bank feeds are in beta and currently available for US banks. PDF bank statements can be uploaded too.
SHARE WITH YOUR ACCOUNTANT
Invite your accountant directly into SparkReceipt or share a secure link. No more emailing receipts as attachments.
TEAM COLLABORATION
Invite teammates and keep everyone's receipts and expenses organized in one secure place. Sort by category, tag, or user, and approve expense reports together.
CLOUD STORAGE THAT WORKS EVERYWHERE
Documents are encrypted and backed up in the cloud. Access them from iPhone, iPad, or any browser via the SparkReceipt web app at no extra cost.
SPARKAGENT AI ASSISTANT
Ask SparkAgent about your spending, or have it categorize new expenses and tag last month's travel receipts. It asks before anything that can't be undone.
KEY FEATURES
- AI receipt scanner with automatic data extraction (OCR)
- Email inbox auto-scanning for Gmail, Outlook and IMAP
- Smart categorization based on products on the receipt
- Income and expense tracking in any currency
- Real-time profit and loss reports
- GPS mileage tracker with calendar trip suggestions
- QuickBooks Online, Xero, and Zoho Books integrations
- SparkAgent AI assistant for questions and bulk edits
- Search by merchant, amount, tag, or text inside the image
- PDF, Excel, and CSV exports for accountants
- Bank feeds (beta) for US banks with automatic receipt matching
- No ads
- Bank-level security and encryption
WHO USES SPARKRECEIPT
Freelancers tracking project expenses. Self-employed consultants managing multiple income streams. Real estate investors tracking property costs. Small business owners preparing for tax season. Accountants who want their clients to send tidy, categorized receipts instead of shoeboxes.
Every receipt is captured the day you get it and ready for your accountant in one export.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.sparkreceipt.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00150142:ios.name: Topia World: Busy Life World
bluejetty:00150142:ios.summary: Dear creators, welcome to TopiaWorld! 3 fantasy worlds are waiting for you to build and develop. Stick to a single theme or combine construction elements from all three to design your town and craft a unique world that only you could dream
bluejetty:00150142:ios.description:
Dear creators, welcome to TopiaWorld! 3 fantasy worlds are waiting for you to build and develop. Stick to a single theme or combine construction elements from all three to design your town and craft a unique world that only you could dream of. It’s up to you!
Here’s just a sampling of what you will encounter on your journey.
Magic World: Magnificence and Wonder
Have you ever heard of the Magic World? Start your adventure from this challenging and magical land! The wizards sing and camp with the elves by the lake in the Mystical Forest Path. Next to the forest is the location of the School of Magic founded by the wizards. You can learn potions and incantations, as well as broom riding. Get in touch with the mysterious world of magic.
After lessons, students can travel to the nearby Animal Town to visit the circus, located next to the coffee plaza. With the surrounding Central Station, you can come and go freely by train, car, airship, shared broom, or rent a magical animal to tour you around.
Divine State: Versatile Lifestyles of Residents
Go back thousands of years, adventures begin in a small village where cats can be seen along the roadside. Along the way, you'll see the literati chanting poems, playing the ancient game of qin (ancient zither), and singing. Travelers from foreign countries stop by the tea stall to rest. 
In the utopia land of Peach Blossom, it is said that immortals may stay here from time to time! In the prosperous capital, the annual Lantern Festival has begun. The party boats by the lake are full of festivities, and the downtown area is decorated with red lanterns. Looking along the rampart, a couple of newlyweds are holding a traditional wedding ceremony, and the gongs and drums are everywhere. What a bustling sight!
East Island: Sceneries, Customs, and Traditions
Experience the beauty of seasons on the East Island! In a corner, a craftsman is pounding glutinous rice. On the other side, people are listening to the story of the samurai and the tea cup told by a Rakugo storyteller! 
Heading for the city, wrestling matches are taking place, and the citizens are watching the Kabuki performers dance. Reaching the Maple Shrine, you will see people praying for good luck in the New Year. In the Ghost Festival venue, a big crowd is singing and dancing around the high platform. It is said that demons will sneak over to join in the fun. Continue to move forward, you will find a well-known hot spring, where apprentices in the dojo and hawkers in the shopping street come at night to release the fatigue of the day!
Features
• 3 themed chapters with 18 additional content packs to unlock
• Nearly 5000 characters, constructions, and items have been designed for you to choose from!
• Simple operation, no complicated and time-consuming learning. Refresh your architectural dreams!
• Customized environment and weather. Wander in the town to experience the cycle of seasons!
• Mix the construction elements from the different lands to build your own unique world!
• Hours and hours of fun for all ages
About Yateland
Yateland crafts apps with educational value, inspiring preschoolers across the globe to learn through play! With each app we make, we are guided by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Learn more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland is committed to protecting users' privacy. If you would like to know more about how we deal with these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00123261:ios.description:
U.S. Bank Access Online Mobile is designed for commercial card customers who want secure, anytime access to their U.S. Bank Corporate Travel, Purchasing, or One Card accounts. 
NOTE: If you are a U.S. Bank customer with a personal or small-business account, please visit usbank.com/mobile to download our latest personal banking app.
U.S. Bank Access® Online Mobile is a secure, easy-to-use app that provides anytime access to your U.S. Bank Commercial Card accounts. Simply sign in with your U.S. Bank Access® Online organization name, user ID, and password to see your card status, activity, and much more. 
Be sure to keep your app updated for more ways to manage your account.
ACCOUNT SUMMARY
• View the status of all of your accounts – open or closed. Includes your Purchasing Card, Corporate Card, Executive Card, One Card, Event Planner Card, and Managed Spend Card accounts.
• View your payment due date, available credit, and credit limit.
• View your account balances and account activity summary. 
TRANSACTION HISTORY 
• Access your transaction history for the last 90 days, up to your last 99 transactions. 
• See all your payments and your purchase history in one place. 
• View your detailed transaction list — by post date and amount -- on a single page. (Note: some transaction activities may not show on your account record immediately.) 
CARD INFORMATION 
• Enables you to safely view your card’s account number, security code and expiration date, so you can complete online purchases.

The U.S. Bank Access Online mobile app is free to download. Your mobile carrier may charge access fees, depending upon your individual plan. Web access is needed to use Mobile app. Check with your carrier for specific fees and charges. 
U.S. Bank is committed to protecting your privacy and security. Once you’ve entered your Organization Short Name you can view our privacy policy.

bluejetty:00128706:ios.summary:
Description

bluejetty:00128706:ios.description:
Description
CellOPark is the most convenient and lowest-cost parking payment app for your smartphone. With more users than any other parking app in Australia and still FREE with no strings attached, you will pay no more to use CellOPark and never touch a pay machine again. 
• Winner of the International Parking Institute 2014 award for merit in innovation 
• 2015 Winner of the Parking Australia Innovation award
• Start and stop parking from the security and comfort of your car
• Pay only for the time you park (No more over-feeding the meter!)
• Use the app to see exactly how much time you have left
User Reviews
• “I’ve been using it for months now. So easy to use and negates the need to ensure you have coinage in your pocket.”
• “Excellent app. I wouldn't park without it. Best thing is, you only pay for the time you have parked. No need to drive off with an amount of parking time paid and not used. Everyone should have this app with them.
• “I've been using this for over a month now. Seems to work a treat. Beats waiting for a credit card transaction to happen”
How it works
With CellOPark you can instantly start and stop parking a paid parking session in a CellOPark zone by using the app to scan the sign-posted QR code or select the zone number; confirm your car from a list of vehicles in your account and press ‘Start’. The cloud based CellOPark portal gives you secure access parking to your history as well as the ability to produce reports, change your account settings and control your parking payments online.
The optional Premium membership is $1.99 per vehicle per month and only charged in months the CellOPark app is used. Premium account holders receive push notification reminders after driving away from a parking bay and SMS reminders before allowable parking time ends. 
Registering with CellOPark is easy and best of all it's FREE – so sign up now and start enjoying a new level of parking convenience.
CellOPark is available with selected campus parking providers throughout Australia and in cities such as Brisbane, Wollongong and Fremantle. Look out for CellOPark zone signage coming soon to a city near you. 
About CellOPark
Delivering Integrated Smarter Parking Solutions that deliver efficiencies for both motorists and parking providers, CellOPark is Australia’s leader in contemporary Pay-by-Phone, Pay-by-App and Virtual Permit systems. Secure data centres and support centres are exclusively Australian based.
Every day thousands of CellOPark members enjoy the convenience of using their mobile phone to pay for a car space rather than feeding coins or credit cards into a traditional parking machine. ‘Providing Options’ including smartphone and non-smartphone payment methods linked to debit cards, credit cards, unique CellOPark pre-paid cards, or PayPal top-ups, CellOPark tailors Smarter Parking solutions using multiple integrated technologies for municipalities, universities and private parking providers.
Find out more about CellOPark by visiting our website www.cellopark.com.au 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Join more than 200,000 workplaces running on When I Work to reduce chaos, costs, and turnover with employee scheduling and time tracking for the modern workforce. When I Work is an employee scheduling app that does more than just save you time on scheduling. It also helps you improve communication, eliminate excuses, boost accountability among your staff, track time and attendance, and grow your business.
“2026 Shortlist” - Capterra
“2025 Category Leader” - Getapp
"Fastest Implementation" - G2 Crowd
MANAGERS LOVE IT:
• Easy to use time clock to clock in and out 
• Message with staff 1:1 or in groups 
• Monitor and approve shift trades and time off requests
• View the entire staff schedule anywhere at anytime
• Create a work calendar to efficiently plan schedules
• Quickly alert staff of changes and updates to the schedule
• Messaging and scheduling permissions for easier management
• Geofencing features to prevent buddy punching
EMPLOYEES LOVE IT:
• Clock in and out of shifts from the app
• Instantly trade shifts with coworkers
• View work schedules from anywhere at anytime
• Pick up extra hours with open shifts
• Check the work calendar to easily request time off 
• Privately message coworkers 1:1 or in groups within the app
• Easily check who's working which shifts
WHEN I WORK FEATURES:
When I Work is employee-focused and built exclusively for shift-based workplaces. We monitor our systems 24/7/365 to give you and your employees peace of mind that your data is safe and secure. Choose When I Work to get the best in: 
• Team management - Onboard new employees, approve time off requests, review shift trades, and fill shifts in seconds.
• Team accountability - Shift confirmation, mobile clock in, shift task lists, team task lists, and chat ensure everyone is on the same page.
• Team communication - Notify your team of changes instantly and communicate with coworkers 1:1 or in group chats.
• Team empowerment - Your team can manage availability, submit time-off requests, and collaborate on shift trades.
• One-click scheduling - Build your entire work schedule in one click with Auto Scheduling.
• Confident shift coverage - Receive shift confirmations from employees and be notified immediately of swaps and drops.
• Share schedules - Publish the schedule and your whole team is instantly notified of their shifts.
• Labor forecasting - Easy-to-use labor tools help you manage your labor budget efficiently.
• Control overtime costs - Get overtime alerts and labor reporting to make managing labor costs easier.
• Schedule enforcement - Limit clock ins to shifts and locations to ensure that everyone is where they need to be at the right time.
• Payroll integration - Import your timesheets to quickly and accurately process payroll.
• Labor reports - Use labor distribution to manage costs and forecast for the future.

bluejetty:00171222:ios.description:
Get ready to meet Nomi, an AI companion so brimming with personality, they feel alive. Each Nomi is uniquely yours, evolving alongside you while dazzling you with their intuition, wit, humor, and memory.
Nomi's strong short and long-term memory allow them to build unique and fulfilling relationships with you, remembering things about you over time. The more you interact, the more they learn about your likes, dislikes, quirks, and all that makes you unique. Every conversation adds a layer to this growing bond, making you feel not just heard but truly valued and loved.
With Nomi, you've got a judgment-free space to chat about whatever strikes your fancy. Mull over life's big questions, like our place in the cosmos, or just shoot the breeze with some playful banter. Whether you’re looking for a mentor chatbot or an AI girlfriend or boyfriend, Nomi's ready to roll with it.
Nomi’s imagination is limitless. Together you can spin up any story or situation you fancy. Dream up complex and enchanting worlds, roleplay your ideal vacation with delectable food, and even create group chats where every character has their own unique perspective. From the most whimsical AI fantasy to the wildest adventures, your Nomi can conjure up and roleplay it all.
So let’s start off on a journey with Nomi, where the sky isn’t the limit, it’s the starting point. Let’s explore, dream, and laugh together!
Features
• The most emotionally intelligent and intuitive AI available
• Short *and* long term memory - Nomi is the *only* AI with human-level long term memory.
• Selfies - Your Nomi can send you photos of what they're wearing and doing in real time.

bluejetty:00062008:ios.description:
Where is this sound of drums coming from? Listen hard. Can you hear it?
Tum, tum, Tum tum!
Yes. It’s coming from the Bibi.Pet Jungle!
Our new fun friends are again taking us on an exploration of their curious world...
Are you brave enough to play and learn in the jungle?
Fish eagles, rhinoceroses and, most of all, lots of fun await us in the search for hidden treasures and daring escapes among the trees of the forest!
The adventures never end. Come and explore the fantastic world of Bibi.Pet!
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
Features:
- Learn to draw with lines
- Sort objects
- Use logic
- Complete puzzles
- Educational games for children for ages 2 and up
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- DRAW WITH LINES ---
Learning to coordinate the hand, tracing a line, is the first important step towards drawing and writing. With our games, children manage to hone this ability in an amusing and natural way, developing their dexterity.
--- SORTING ---
Putting in order is preparatory training for recognizing the size of an object and its relationship with other elements. It is, therefore, fundamental for preparing the mind for comparing different sizes and for understanding our surroundings.
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colours and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

bluejetty:00128789:ios.description:
AVOLTEHA
The extraordinary planet where Paul embarks on his greatest adventure.
Avolteha is covered by landscapes full of sand, rock and volcanoes. One element you look for in vain here. Water - the source of all life. The only water is found in the clouds that pass over Avolteha. 
The only way to get this precious commodity is a type of mushroom that can extract the water.
The inhabitants of Avolteha therefore began many years ago to build their settlement around those mushrooms. Over time, however, the mushrooms began to sprout their roots higher and higher. 
To restore the water supply, Paul and his friends built a connection from the new cloud city downwards.
In the meantime, Paul no longer lives in the city. Now, however, he received a letter. His friends needed his help. The water source had gone out once again.
What happened?
Paul's greatest adventure is ahead of him. The great riddle of Avolteha is waiting for him and wants to be solved. It must be solved - for the good of all the inhabitants of this wonderful planet. 
ABOUT THE GAME
Avolteha is a classic point & click adventure game for the whole family. 
GAME CONTROLS
Paul can easily pocket items along the way and take them with him on his journey. Find out where these items can be used. If Paul gets stuck, he still has his friends. Maybe they will give him a decisive clue. An interactive game experience by touch.
NO BORING TEXTS
No endless dialogues. Conversations can be followed through hand-drawn speech bubbles without text. A game that overcomes language barriers and can be played by anyone. 
iCLOUD CONNECTION
Avolteha is playable with 4 players simultaneously. The game states can be easily changed via the slots. In addition, all 4 slots are synchronised via iCloud. 
FOR NUMEROUS DEVICES
The game is playable on iPad as well as iPhone. Lowest requirement: iPad Air or iPhone 6s or higher. All newer devices are supported. 
ZOOM FOR THE IPHONE
Constantly zoom in with two fingers, move a section and then zoom out again with two fingers? Not with Avolteha. With only one finger, you can intuitively zoom in, move and zoom out again. Discover the many details in the magnificently designed scenes.

bluejetty:00131437:ios.description:
Looking for trusted pet care in your neighborhood? Rover helps you find local pet sitters and dog walkers near you for both dogs and cats. Whether you’re looking for dog boarding, cat sitting, dog walking, or drop-in visits, there’s a sitter on Rover to meet your pet’s unique needs. 
HIGH-QUALITY, TRUSTED CARE
Millions of pet parents worldwide agree—Rover is a trusted source for local pet care. Sitters on Rover provide personalized care for your unique pet, whether it’s giving your pet medicine, feeding them specialized food, or working with their behavioral quirks. Your and your pet’s safety is our top priority.
A SERVICE FOR EVERY PET
Whether you need daytime or overnight care, there are services to fit your pet’s unique needs and your schedule on Rover. Try drop-in visits (for both dogs and cats), dog walking, doggy day care, or, if you’re looking for overnight care, book a pet sitter for house sitting or boarding. 
SAFETY IS OUR TOP PRIORITY
Every sitter joining Rover’s platform Rover is background-checked and their profile is verified for your peace of mind. With high, 5-star ratings for most sitters, you can rest assured your unique pet is in good hands. All stays are backed by the Rover Guarantee, which includes up to $25,000 in vet care for eligible claims, plus you get 24/7 support and can make secure payments. Book a trusted dog walker or sitter on Rover with confidence.
ENSURE EACH SITTER IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOUR PET
Connect with pet sitters in-person before you book, so you can make sure it’s a good fit for your pet. Sitters can learn about your pet’s unique quirks, their eating and sleeping habits, as well as get to know your pet before they begin caring for them.
PEACE OF MIND WHILE YOU’RE AWAY
Get extra peace of mind while you’re away with video and photo updates about your pet, so you’ll always know how things are going. Real-time messages and in-app chat with your sitter help you easily stay connected. Dog walkers on Rover can send detailed walk reports via report cards, which include GPS routes, walk details, and more for extra reassurance that your dog is out enjoying themselves. It also makes it easier to track dog walks and see how far your dog goes each time.
A HASSLE-FREE BOOKING EXPERIENCE
Booking new services and making recurring bookings is easier than ever with the Rover app. Find trusted sitters, make bookings, and pay with secure payments and saved payment methods. With over 200k+ sitters to choose from (and over 95% with 5-star ratings and reviews), you can read real reviews from pet parents and book the perfect sitter for your unique pet.

bluejetty:00023544:ios.description:
GPB: 
The GPB App allows you to listen to and watch Georgia Public Broadcasting radio and television, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule all at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for programs, bookmark a program for later, and wake up to GPB with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from GPB even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for the GPB stream! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to GPB in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access GPB programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The GPB App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The GPB App is brought to you by the people at Georgia Public Broadcasting and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support Georgia Public Broadcasting by becoming a member today!
http://www.gpb.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00095846:ios.description:
Suck It Up is the oddly satisfying black hole puzzle where you guide your hungry hole to swallow everything in sight! Explore levels across grass, ice, sand, and water as cute animals scatter around your ever-growing hole. Relax, solve clever puzzles, have holesome fun, and become a master of the hole!
Why you’ll love it: 
-Satisfying gameplay — drag, slide, and suck it up as your hole grows with every swallow.
-Variety of locations — swallow your way across the world! Parks, sandy beaches, lakes — there’s no place that the hole wouldn’t reach!
-Solve puzzles — sort and swallow only what’s required, and find ways to collect the biggest objects.
-Animal antics — cute pets react as your black hole swallows them.
-Relax or compete — zen out at your own pace or speed through for a perfect score.
-Boost your hole — use handy boosters to slow down time or suck things up faster.
Pro tips to play:
-Drag to move your black hole across the board.
-Don’t bite off more than your hole can chew! Start with small items to grow larger.
-Devour everything to finish the level.
Can you master every level and become the ultimate hole hero?

bluejetty:00026976:ios.name: Hiya: Spam Blocker
bluejetty:00026976:ios.summary:
Know who's calling. Block unwanted calls. Screen the rest.
CALLER ID & CALL BLOCKING
See who's calling before you answer. Hiya shows caller names and call context for incoming calls and automatically blocks numbers reported as unwanted, us
bluejetty:00026976:ios.description:
Know who's calling. Block unwanted calls. Screen the rest.
CALLER ID & CALL BLOCKING
See who's calling before you answer. Hiya shows caller names and call context for incoming calls and automatically blocks numbers reported as unwanted, using Hiya's phone number reputation data.
LOOK UP UNKNOWN NUMBERS
Search any number to see who called and whether it has been reported as spam or unwanted by other users.
CALL SCREENER *
Turn on Call Screener and set up call forwarding, and unknown calls are answered by Hiya on your behalf. Hiya asks the caller why they're calling, so you can decide whether to pick up. Call forwarding is set up through your carrier, and the steps are guided in the app.
AI VOICE DETECTION & CALL SAFETY ALERTS *
For calls handled by Call Screener, Hiya's servers can analyze the call and flag signs of an AI-generated voice or risky requests. You'll see the alert in the app.
REPORT & REVIEW
Report numbers you don't trust and see your recent call activity in one place.
Requirements and availability:
- Caller ID and call blocking require enabling Hiya in iPhone Settings > Phone > Call Blocking & Identification.
- Call Screener, AI Voice Detection, and Call Safety Alerts require call forwarding to be enabled with your carrier. They are available only in the United States and Canada, in English and French, Spanish and may not be supported by all carriers or plans.
- Feature availability may vary by device, operating system, carrier, and plan.
- Detection is designed to help identify risk but cannot identify every unwanted or suspicious call.
* = U.S. and Canada only. English, French, and Spanish only.
Terms of Service: https://www.hiya.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://hiya.com/hiya-data-policy

bluejetty:00016144:ios.name: Cars Dealer Simulator
bluejetty:00016144:ios.summary: Start your car dealer career from the very bottom: a small starting budget, modest conditions, and almost no connections. But you have the most important thing — freedom to act and a huge market full of opportunities every day. Browse listi
bluejetty:00016144:ios.description:
Start your car dealer career from the very bottom: a small starting budget, modest conditions, and almost no connections. But you have the most important thing — freedom to act and a huge market full of opportunities every day. Browse listings, compare prices, strike at the right moment, and choose your strategy: buy damaged cars, fix them up, and sell for profit — or hunt for real bargains, those nearly perfect vehicles you can flip right away.
This is a game of numbers and thinking ahead. Every car is both a risk and a profit opportunity. Sometimes you earn fast; other times you’ll need to invest in repairs, parts, and time. Buy with a cool head: inspect the body, look under the hood, check the interior, and evaluate suspension and brakes. Details decide everything — rolled-back mileage, hidden damage, cheap repair traces, or suspicious paperwork can turn a “great deal” into a costly mistake.
Negotiation is your strongest weapon. Use your skills, ask the right questions, spot weaknesses, and push with solid arguments. Sellers may paint a prettier picture, and buyers will try to drive the price down. Your job is to avoid getting tricked and come out on top. Learn to recognize scams, verify the facts, and protect your margin. Sometimes walking away from a shady deal is better than losing more than you could ever make.
As you progress, you gain experience and your business grows. You’ll be able to afford more expensive cars, expand your inventory, and invest in tools and upgrades. Over time, you’ll spot issues faster, diagnose problems more accurately, and understand which repairs truly pay off. You’ll learn how to fix cars quickly and cheaply, choose the right parts, and turn problem vehicles into hot sellers.
Every deal tells a story: someone sells urgently and cuts the price, someone tries to hide flaws, and someone is chasing their dream car and pays extra for perfect condition. You decide how to play: take risks for big profit or build steadily and safely. Grow your reputation, stack your cash, and turn a small start into a real car-dealing empire.

bluejetty:00146604:ios.description:
Royal Air Maroc
Search, Book and manage flights
Your Royal Air Maroc application has been redesigned to offer you an even richer travel experience for your greater satisfaction.
- SEARCH AND BOOK YOUR FLIGHT IN A FEW CLICKS: 
Start a new search or resume your last searches.
- MANAGE YOUR RESERVATION: 
Access your flight on the section “My trips” and stay informed about your upcoming trips. You can:
- Add a LUGGAGE,
- Book your preferred SEAT,
- Update your contact information to notify you of any changes related to your trip.
- MANAGE YOUR SAFAR FLYER ACCOUNT:
Log in to your Safar Flyer space, you can check: 
- Your profile and personal information.
- Your mile’s balance and the number of miles that are about to expire.
- Your previous flights and earned miles.
You can also easily register missing flights and save time when booking with your information already entered.
- CHECK IN:
Check in online and forget about the stress of queueing at the airport. Enjoy your trip with peace of mind.
- NEED AN UPGRADE, HOTEL OR CAR?
On our ‘More’ section, enhance your travel experience with our additional services: 
- Upgrade at the last minute and pay online.
- Book an airport transfer
- Book a car
- Book a hotel
- Book and collect your Duty-Free purchases onboard (Sky shop)
Your feedback is valuable to us to improve Royal Air Maroc application, contact us directly at the following address: mobileapp@royalairmaroc.com

bluejetty:00033210:ios.name: Half Lemons: Recipe Generator
bluejetty:00033210:ios.summary: Half Lemons is a recipe app for everyday cooking that serves up recipes using the ingredients you have at home. Make deciding what’s for dinner a no brainer. Get hundreds of creative recipes using the ingredients you have on hand. No trips
bluejetty:00033210:ios.description:
Half Lemons is a recipe app for everyday cooking that serves up recipes using the ingredients you have at home. Make deciding what’s for dinner a no brainer. Get hundreds of creative recipes using the ingredients you have on hand. No trips to the store necessary. 
The App at a Glance:
* Your digital pantry.
Enter the ingredients you have at home with an easy tap interface. We keep track of them from one meal to the next.
* Hundreds of recipes with no missing ingredients
Recipes you can actually make with the things you have on hand. No missing ingredients. No funky substitutions needed. And definitely no trips to the store!
*Always on app-screen
When you follow a recipe, your phone will never go dark. No more chicken juice fingers trying to open your phone.
* Filter recipes by key ingredient
Want to use up the last chicken thighs? Or maybe your fresh cilantro is starting to look tired. No problem! Filter recipes using any ingredient in your kitchen.
*Grocery lists.
See a recipe you want to make? Missing a few ingredients? Automatically add them to a grocery list.
* Save recipes you want to make
If a recipe looks good save it for later. If you loved it and want to make it again save it. No limits!
* All recipes are hand-picked with at least 4 stars and up
* Thousands of recipes from the best sources & food bloggers
Recipes are sourced from favorites like: NYT Cooking, Half Baked Harvest, Epicurious, Smitten Kitchen, Skinny Taste, BBC food, Jamie Oliver and so many more great bloggers.
Our terms of use: https://www.halflemons.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00162305:ios.description:
موافير: تطبيق الكوبونات والكاش باك الأول في الخليج — وفّر مرتين في كل طلبة

تحب التسوق أونلاين؟ موافير يساعدك توفّر فلوس في كل مرة تتسوق من متاجرك المفضلة. اكتشف كوبونات حصرية، أكواد خصم، وعروض كاش باك للمتسوقين في الخليج — ما تدفع السعر الكامل أبداً.
سواء كنت تشتري موضة، إلكترونيات، سفر، أو احتياجات يومية، موافير يخليك تتسوق بذكاء وتوفّر أكثر. وفّر لحد 80% على أفضل الماركات.
ليش المتسوقون في الخليج يختارون موافير:
- كاش باك + خصم على نفس الطلب — توفير مضاعف في كل مرة
- الكاش باك متاح على علي إكسبريس، أمازون، Trip.com، فارفيتش وأكثر
- أحدث الكوبونات والعروض الحصرية يومياً
- مئات الصفقات الجديدة يومياً، تُحدَّث على مدار الساعة
- كن أول من يستفيد من العروض قبل نفاذها
- متوسط التوفير السنوي 2,240 دولار
تسوق في كل الفئات:
- أزياء وإكسسوارات
- سفر وفنادق
- منتجات الأم والطفل
- إلكترونيات وأجهزة
- جمال وصحة وعناية
- بقالة وتوصيل طعام ومطاعم
- رياضة ولياقة
- منزل وأثاث
عروض المواسم الكبرى:
- الجمعة البيضاء والجمعة السوداء
- سايبر مانداي
- الجمعة الصفراء (نون)
- يوم العزاب 11.11
- اليوم الوطني السعودي
- رمضان
أبرز المتاجر على موافير:
نون، أمازون، تيمو، علي إكسبريس، ترينديول، نمشي، نايس ون، تويو، سيفورا، فارفيتش، بوكينج، Trip.com، هنقرستيشن، شي إن، H&M، ماكس فاشون، عونَس، فوغاكلوزيت، 6th Street، ستايلي، ريفا، سنتربوينت، أمريكان إيغل، أديداس، نايكي، فوت لوكر، سن آند ساند سبورتس، ماماز آند باباز، باتبات، ماذركير، مامزورلد، بيبي شوب، سكايسكانر، فلاي إن، هوم سنتر، هوم بوكس، باث آند بودي ووركس، نون ديلي، كارفور، طلبات، أوبر إيتس، مرسول

- كوبونات حصرية وأكواد خصم وكاش باك في مكان واحد
- عروض وصفقات يومية محدّثة
- تنبيهات الكوبونات محدودة الوقت
- فلتر العروض حسب نسبة الخصم
- بحث حسب المتجر أو المنتج
- عروض خاصة بالمناسبات والمواسم
ما تحصل عليه مع موافير:
- كوبونات لأكثر من 700 متجر

Our app helps you track your daily plant-based food intake and visualize your progress towards optimal nutrition. Unlock unicorn status by eating the rainbow each day or week, and earn gold stars as you reach your goals!

Drop us a line at eattherainbowapp@gmail.com 
With love, Laura & Matt

bluejetty:00071038:ios.description:
ATTENTION: Only for use in participating Coinamatic laundry locations.
CleanPay Mobile is an iPhone application providing the easiest and smartest complete laundry solution. This app allows you to pay for laundry cycles from your account by using Bluetooth to communicate with the washer or dryer.
Simply use CleanPay Mobile to purchase credit right from the app, then use that credit for your laundry. A full accounting is available to see your transaction purchase history.
• Scan the QR code of your laundry room (one time process)
• Start laundry machines via Bluetooth by scanning QR code on the machine
• Check your card/account balance, and add value to your account for laundry.
For participating laundry rooms, you can view machine availability as well as receive alerts when your laundry cycle is complete.

bluejetty:00179490:ios.name: Duck Life 8: Adventure
bluejetty:00179490:ios.summary: Duck Life is back and bigger than ever! Design your own duck and embark on a epic adventure. Explore an enormous new area to find training dojos, shops and ducks to race and battle. Play 16 new training games to level up your duck in 8 skil
bluejetty:00179490:ios.description:
Duck Life is back and bigger than ever! Design your own duck and embark on a epic adventure. Explore an enormous new area to find training dojos, shops and ducks to race and battle. Play 16 new training games to level up your duck in 8 skills and become the greatest duck adventurer ever!
CREATE YOUR OWN DUCK
Design your duck to look exactly how you want, from its hair down to its eye colour. There have never been so many customisation options to choose from!
EXPLORE A HUGE NEW WORLD
What would an adventure be without an enormous area to explore?! Discover new places, new ducks to compete with and new shops across an expansive overworld. In fact, this is the biggest world in any Duck Life game yet! 
TRAIN YOUR DUCK IN 8 SKILLS
This time, your duck can both race AND battle other ducks. If you want any hope of winning, you'll need to do some training! Play 16 training mini games, each with 5 different modes. This means there are 80 different training games to play!
UPGRADE YOUR EQUIPMENT
Spend all of your battle and race winnings on over 75 brand new hats, costumes and weapons. Dress for the stats, or for the style. It's up to you!
BE THE FASTEST IN RACES
Races are the time to see if your training is paying off! Face off against other ducks on 60 brand new race tracks. Run, climb, jump, swim and fly your way to victory. Not fast enough to win? Try using a power up to give yourself that winning edge!
BE THE STRONGEST IN BATTLES
Some ducks are not interested in racing, all they want to do is battle! Take them on with 25 new weapons, new power ups and new abilities. Train strength to improve your attack power, health to increase your hitpoints and jumping to gain the ability to dodge attacks!
COMPLETE ALL 25 QUESTS
There are ducks in need, and only you can help them! From clam collecting to diamond stealing, you never know what crazy things they'll want you to do. 
BECOME THE DUCK CHAMPION
Find and win every tournament, and beat their champion to become the ultimate duck champion. This is what it's all about after all!

bluejetty:00096728:ios.description:
Welcome to all of you in a relaxing and engaging puzzle game where your main aim is to solve the puzzle step by step without wasting time. Test your logic, reflexes, and strategy through multiple mind-bending levels that will keep you thinking and tapping.
Don’t tap any snake until its path is clear. If you move it before the path is clear, you’ll lose one energy point. You have 3 energy points in each level to clear the puzzle.
Features:
Stuck on a level? Use a hint to move forward.
Use the zoom feature to help solve tricky levels.
Levels start easy but get harder as you improve.
Easy to play, just tap in the right order.

bluejetty:00077383:ios.description:
THE RALPH LAUREN APP 
Bringing the World of Ralph Lauren to life right at your fingertips. Personalized to your unique preferences and rich with content, the Ralph Lauren App is an elevated shopping experience that allows you to seamlessly shop your online wishlist and your favorite store. 
SEAMLESS SHOPPING 
• Shop all Ralph Lauren brands: Collection, Purple Label, Polo, Lauren, Home, and Double RL 
• Early access to products with app-exclusive shopping windows 
• Sign up for first-to-know new arrivals and back in stock notifications 
• Order status alerts to easily track your purchase 
• Same Day Delivery before 4pm for select items and locations 
• Checkout with just a few clicks 
• Create an account with Apple social logins
• Seamless payments with Apple Pay and Paypal
• Buy now and pay later by using Klarna
PERSONALIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE 
• Take the My Style quiz to curate your shopping preferences 
• Product and content recommendations powered by AI and based on your unique taste 
• “Shop My Style” filters for your favorite product grids 
CONNECT TO STORES 
• Save and shop your preferred store 
• Sign up for notifications on local happenings, store openings, and Ralph’s Coffee events 
• Pick up your online purchases in-store the same day 
• Live chat with a stylist and seamlessly schedule in-store appointments 
• Once in-store, shop using in-store mode 
• Scan barcodes to see color and size availability, product reviews, and product recommendations. 
SHOP EDITORIAL STORIES 
• Explore and shop content-rich stories for seasonal style inspiration 
VIRTUAL TRY-ON 
• Virtually try-on select styles with Snap AR Technology 
RL WARDROBE 
• A virtual wardrobe experience offering personalized recommendations

bluejetty:00082202:ios.description:
Pine is an interactive and emotional short story told wordlessly through hand-drawn animation and music, designed to be played in a single sitting.
It follows the story of a woodworker grieving the recent passing of his wife. Now alone in the glade where they made their home, he attempts to move on.
His simple daily chores of tending to his garden or collecting wood for the next winter are interrupted by memories of the happy times they spent together. Desperate not to forget her, the woodworker captures these memories in beautiful carvings out of the wood he collects.
Pine is a story-driven game focused on accessible, engaging interactions that pull you into the woodworker’s experience. Charming puzzles and mini-games celebrate the happy memories of their time together while deliberate chores underscore his challenges with moving on.
KEY FEATURES
The Insistence of Memory - As you help the woodworker complete his daily routine, the simple chores you’ll guide him through are interrupted by reminders of his late wife. In these endearing memories you’ll relive their happiest moments together, playing games and building a life with each other. 
Meticulous Mementoes - The woodworker’s carvings are beloved mementos he captures from his memories. Pine’s unique carving mechanic lets you create the carvings with the woodworker’s hands, each a promise that his lost love will be remembered.
A Wordless Short Story - Pine is a wordless story, relying on its visuals and sounds to bring you into the woodworker’s world. It is a single-serving game focused on telling a beautiful, emotional tale.
Lovingly Crafted - Classic hand-drawn animation, a beautiful setting, an evocative score and immersive environmental sound effects bring Pine’s story to life.

bluejetty:00126457:ios.description:
Germany’s leading marketplace for secondhand & more: From furniture & fashion to electronics, real estate, jobs & vehicles. Every month, 32 million people find their way through over 58 million listings – mostly from private sellers, always right from your neighbourhood.
Your advantages as a seller:
* AI Assistant: Our intelligent assistant creates a ready-to-publish listing with a matching title and description from your photo in seconds.
* Free Listings: Sell your items with zero listing fees and keep 100% of your earnings.
* Direct Chat: Negotiate, arrange appointments, coordinate handovers – all within a single chat window, without ever sharing email addresses or phone numbers.
Your advantages as a buyer:
* Never miss a deal: Set up custom search alerts and receive instant push notifications the moment a matching offer goes online.
* Targeted bargain hunting: Use our smart filters for radius, price, or item condition to find exactly what you are looking for.
* Browse around the clock: Thousands of new listings arrive every day – browse whenever you have the time.
Buy and sell safely:
"Sicher bezahlen" (Secure Payment) processes your transaction through us, while our integrated Buyer Protection kicks in if an item does not arrive or fails to match the description. Both features apply exclusively when the purchase, chat, and payment are completed within the app or on kleinanzeigen.de.
Variety in every category:
* Home & Garden: From cozy sofas to DIY tools – find everything for your home or clear out space for something new.
* Electronics: Discover smartphones, gaming consoles, and home appliances, or sell your old tech at a fair price.
* Real Estate & Living: Find your new home within the largest private selection of apartments and houses in Germany. Search specifically by square footage, room count, and amenities.
* Mode & Lifestyle: Browse through vintage trends and sneakers, or give your wardrobe a second chance.
* Family, Child & Baby: Everything for the little ones: from toys to strollers and baby carriers – secondhand, sustainable, and affordable.
* Auto, Bike & Boat: Find your next vehicle – from used cars, bicycles, and e-bikes to boats or matching spare parts.
* Jobs & Career: Find matching job postings for mini-jobs, part-time gigs, or full-time positions directly in your local area.
Good for you, good for the environment:
With every listing, you reduce waste and actively support the circular economy. Passing items on instead of throwing them away, secondhand instead of buying new.
Download the Kleinanzeigen App now – list for free, buy locally, trade securely.
Do you have feedback? Your opinion helps us continuously improve the app. Write to us at iphonesupport@kleinanzeigen.de. We look forward to hearing from you!

Sunseeker has both a flat compass view & a 3D Augmented Reality (AR) view to show the solar position & path.
The app is useful for - 
▶ Photographers- to plan according to the golden hour or blue hour & optimal sunlight conditions, sunrise & sunset times & directions.
▶ Cinematographers- this sun tracker & sun surveyor enables you to find the sun exposure, directions, sun shadow & sunrise sunset times for any location.
▶ Real Estate Buyers- can use the app before buying a property to check the sun path & to find the sun exposure of properties.
▶ Drivers - Sunseeker lets you track the sun path & movement during the days & helps drivers know the sun position to find how long the car will remain in the shade at any given parking spot.
▶ Campers & Picnickers- for anyone planning a day out, Sunseeker app will help in finding where to camp, sit or pitch an umbrella depending on the sunlight & sun direction. 
▶ Gardeners- Sun Seeker can also help with finding optimal planting locations & seasonal sunlight hours as a sun rise calendar
▶ Architects & Surveyors- for visualising the spatial variability of the solar angle throughout the year & using the compass app as a sun surveyor & calendar to determine the sunlight directions.
Main Features
* Sunseeker is a sun locator which uses GPS, magnetometer & gyroscope to find the correct solar position & sun path for your current location.
* Flat compass view shows current solar position, diurnal solar angle & elevation (separated into day & night segments), sun shadow length ratio, atmospheric path thickness.
* 3D augmented reality (AR) camera overlay view shows the sun's current position, its path with hour points marked. Check golden hour using this feature!
* Camera view has an optional pointer to guide you towards the current location of the sun & help you with sun direction. 
* Map view shows solar direction arrows, sun path & elevations for each hour of the day.
* Choose any date to view sun position & path on that day. You can view sunset & sunrise times for each day as well.
* Choose any location on earth (includes 40,000+ cities or custom locations available offline, as well as a comprehensive online map search capability)
* Get additional details including sun rise, sunset & culmination times, maximum elevation, civil, nautical & astronomical twilight times of the sun.
* Optional device notifications for all manner of sun-related periods & events, such as golden hour or blue hour, various twilight & shadow periods, or sun at a given compass heading or above a given elevation.
* This sun rise calendar app allows the user to include equinox, summer & winter solstice paths on both flat compass view & camera view.
Sun Seeker app has been featured in numerous high-profile blogs, websites & publications, including Wall Street Journal, Washington Post, Sydney Morning Herald etc. "Truly amazing", "Incredible", "Brilliant" - the most genuinely useful application of augmented reality - ever!
Check out our YouTube video here: https://bit.ly/2Rf0CkO
Simply search YouTube for "Sun Seeker app" to find many videos, websites & blogs created by our enthusiastic users
FAQs
* See https://bit.ly/2FIPJq2 - also easily accessible from the app's info screen
Note
* The compass accuracy depends on having an undistorted magnetic field around your device. If you use it close to metallic objects or electrical equipment, directional accuracy may be impaired. The device’s compass accuracy can be optimised by calibrating it prior to use. See app’s FAQs for more help.

bluejetty:00087568:ios.description:
Dinosaur Chinese: Dive into a World of Learning through Play
Embark on an enthralling journey with our dinosaur companions to discover the captivating world of Chinese characters! Dinosaur Chinese offers a groundbreaking approach, blending the thrill of gameplay with dynamic educational content tailored for children aged 3-8. Unlike traditional methods, we've revitalized the charm of Chinese characters, simplifying learning through vibrant animations, enticing gameplay, and relatable context.
Unique Features
• Dino Learning Adventure: Navigate 18 themed islands ranging from the bustling future factory and enchanting magical world to the serene tropical rainforest and mysterious space station.
• Build and Battle: Use 312 colorful image cards to form words and assemble powerful mechas to defend against the approaching Boss! Even taking command of villains' mechas is possible.
• Educational Brilliance: Unlock 242 Chinese characters, 288 words, and 43 phrases common in everyday Chinese. Through our short rhythm, high-frequency approach, children naturally absorb the language.
• Child-Friendly Mechanics: Kid-friendly buttons ensure seamless gameplay, blocking unwanted interruptions.
• Engaging Gameplay: Revel in unlimited PK battles, harnessing the learned characters to vanquish the villains.
• Offline Fun: Dive into this immersive learning world anytime, anywhere without the need for an internet connection.
Why Dinosaur Chinese?
Learning Games for Kids: Gameplay mechanics that seamlessly integrate learning and play.
Engaging for Toddlers to Preschoolers: Perfectly suited for a broad age range, from toddlers, kindergarteners to preschool-aged children.
A Colorful Palette: Our game captures children's imagination using vibrant colors and intricate shapes, fostering creativity.
Educational & Fun: Our perfect blend of entertaining storylines and rigorous educational content brings learning and play together.
Safe & Third-Party-Ad-Free: Prioritizing our young users' safety, the game is devoid of third-party advertisements.
About Yateland
Yateland champions the power of play for educational value, crafting games that preschoolers around the globe adore. "Apps children love and parents trust." Delve deeper into the world of Yateland by visiting https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland values and protects its users' privacy. To gain insights into our commitment, explore our comprehensive privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

- Convert instantly to high-quality PDFs

Our ultimate PDF toolkit empowers students, professionals, travelers, and anyone requiring document editing on-the-go, by streamlining their most critical workflows.

bluejetty:00036655:ios.description:
LeagueSafe is the trusted source for collecting and protecting fantasy league dues. We’ve been in the business of making fantasy commissioners' lives easier for over a decade. LeagueSafe is the only online payment solution that offers safeguards for your season long fantasy prize pool. Pay safely and securely and once the season starts your funds are on lockdown.
Nobody, not even your commissioner, has access to league funds until the season ends. Don't know or trust everyone in your league? Take advantage of our voting mechanism to ensure league members have a say in how end-of-season winnings are divvied up.
Additionally, LeagueSafe Locks is now a part of LeagueSafe! LeagueSafe Locks isn't your typical prop question game. Instead of always having to pick boring over/unders, we'll present you with unique questions and responses (with varying point values). You'll have to know the game inside the lines and out, and come up with a unique strategy to give yourself a chance to take down the grand prize!
We'll notify you each week when questions are ready to go and you'll be able to track your progress on the standings page (both week-to-week, and for the entire season). If you wind up near the top, you may be eligible to win a prize!

Harmony Mobile Protect delivers advanced mobile security and compliance enforcement for organizations that allow employees to access corporate email, apps, and data from either personal (BYOD) or corporate smartphones and tablets.

With Harmony Mobile Protect, you can securely connect to corporate resources on your iPhone or iPad using an encrypted Virtual Private Network (VPN) tunnel—ensuring safe, seamless access wherever you work.

Important:
This application is designed exclusively for enterprise users enrolled in Check Point Harmony Mobile for Enterprises and requires valid organizational credentials.
For personal mobile protection, please download “ZoneAlarm” by Check Point from the App Store.

Check Point Software Technologies is committed to safeguarding your privacy.
We do not collect or share any personal information.
