bluejetty:00115647:ios.description:
Dive into the ultimate mahjong solitaire experience with Koi Mahjong, a game that combines timeless gameplay with innovative features. Designed for players of all ages, especially seniors, Koi Mahjong offers large, eye-friendly tiles and a simple, intuitive interface for an enjoyable and relaxing puzzle adventure.
How to Play:
Match two identical tiles to remove them from the board. Only unblocked and visible tiles can be paired. Clear the board to complete each level and progress to the next challenge.
Features:
Senior-Friendly Design: Large, clear tiles and an intuitive interface tailored for ease of use and comfort.
Relax and Sharpen Your Mind: Boost memory, enhance focus, and unwind with mentally stimulating puzzles.
Classic Gameplay with Endless Challenges: Enjoy timeless mahjong solitaire fun with thousands of unique and challenging levels.
Offline Play: Play anywhere, anytime—no Wi-Fi or internet required.
Two-player Mode:
Experience mahjong solitaire like never before with our exclusive Two-player Mode. Partner with family or friends to solve puzzles together, adding a new layer of fun and connection to the classic game. Whether you’re bonding over challenges or working as a team, Two-player Mode brings people closer through shared gameplay.
Download Koi Mahjong today and embark on a unique tile-matching journey with your loved ones!

bluejetty:00027443:ios.summary:
Do you have tinnitus or “ringing in the ears”? Tinnitus Aid helps you understand and relieve your tinnitus symptoms. 
Recent research shows that tinnitus can be treated by listening to sounds that have been filtered to remove your specific
bluejetty:00027443:ios.description:
Do you have tinnitus or “ringing in the ears”? Tinnitus Aid helps you understand and relieve your tinnitus symptoms. 
Recent research shows that tinnitus can be treated by listening to sounds that have been filtered to remove your specific tinnitus frequencies.*
With Tinnitus Aid, you can apply advanced filters to over 250 high-quality sounds to find relief for your symptoms.
Simply apply a bandpass filter to any sound or mix to isolate frequencies in a narrow range. Move this filter up and down the frequency range until it closely matches the ringing frequency in your ears. 
Add a bandstop filter at these frequencies to any sound or mix to create your tinnitus mask.
The advanced tinnitus filters can be applied to both ears or just one ear, and different frequency ranges can be used for each ear.
You can set a wide range of filter widths from 0.1 to 4.0 octaves, down to 1Hz resolution. And you can adjust the volume level in each ear with a single balance control.
Tinnitus Aid includes for free: high-quality natural sounds, unlimited mixes, an auto-shutoff timer, and a sample of the advanced tinnitus filters and controls.
Subscribe to get unlimited use of the advanced tinnitus filters, 250+ high-quality sounds with all future sound additions, and no ads.
Download Tinnitus Aid now to help relieve your tinnitus symptoms.
Tinnitus Aid features:
• Catalog of natural sounds recorded on location around the world (over 250 with subscription)
• Long high-quality stereo recordings
• Precision bandpass and bandstop filters to identify and mask ringing frequencies (unlimited use with subscription)
• Wide frequency range: 128 Hz to 16 kHz
• Filter widths from 0.1 to 4.0 Octaves, settable to 1Hz resolution.
• Two-ear and single-ear filtering capability
• Independent Left-Right ear filter frequencies and widths
• Left-Right ear volume balance control
• Easy-to-create blended mixes of any 4 sounds
• Modern easy-to-use interface
• Beautiful high-definition images from around the globe
• Runs in background while using other apps or when the screen is locked
• Timer with slow audio fade-out 
Download Tinnitus Aid now.
* See http://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0138595, http://www.pnas.org/content/107/3/1207.full, http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC2918775/ for descriptions of notched sound therapy and its positive results.
Terms of Use: https://www.phase4mobile.com/tinnitusaid-terms-of-use/
Image credits: http://www.phase4mobile.com/image-credits-tinnitushq

bluejetty:00127882:ios.description:
Check off your weekly calendar to track your habits!
Packed with features like one-tap check-ins, memos, unlimited tabs, emojis, reports, notifications, backup/restore, widgets, dark mode, and more.
■ Check habits on a weekly calendar
Track your habits by checking them off on a weekly calendar.
■ Multiple habits on one screen
View several habits all on a single screen.
■ Daily memos
Jot down the day's insights and accomplishments as memos.
■ Unlimited tabs
Organize all your habits by category, like "Work," "Workouts," and "Study."
■ 1,000+ emojis
Check off habits with your favorite emoji instead of a checkmark.
■ Reports
Check your all-time, this month, last month, and longest check streaks, and visualize your progress with charts.
■ Notifications
Get reminded at a time you choose with any message you like, so you never accidentally forget a habit.
■ Backup / Restore
Back up automatically and restore anytime. You can back up and restore even across different devices or operating systems.
■ Dark mode
Choose your theme from Light, Dark, or automatic switching based on your device settings.
■ Color themes
Change the background to any color you like.
■ Archive
Hide calendars you don't want to display while keeping their data intact.
■ Biometrics
Supports Face ID and Touch ID, so only you can open the app.
■ CSV export
Export an individual calendar or all of your data in CSV format.
■ Check count
Freely set how many check-ins you want per day.
■ No login required
Start using the app right away—no login needed.
■ Offline ready
Works even without an internet connection.
■ Swipe to move between weeks
Quickly jump between weeks by swiping left or right.
■ How to use
1. Open the app
2. Create a habit
3. Tap the calendar
That's it! Recording your habits is just one tap away, so you'll never find it a hassle!
■ Security
Privacy is the top priority of this app.
Your data is stored only on your device and is never sent anywhere else.
■ Privacy Policy
https://naokiotsu.com/privacy-policy
■ Contact
If you have any requests or questions, please feel free to reach out via the in-app contact form or the email address below.
info@naokiotsu.com

The best app for control your LG TV!
LG TV Remote will control your big TV screen!
Broaden your Smart TV experience with the LG TV Remote app.

- 6 nice color themes (including 2 dark themes)
- Search in google and kino.pub services
- List apps and launch
- Turn tv off
- WOL(wake on lan)

Please contact me and I will try to add this functionality ;-)
This app supports only LG webOS Smart TV released on and after 2014 and LG Netcast Smart TV released on and after 2012.
You can use LG TV Remote after pairing your TV and mobile device on the same Wi-Fi network.

bluejetty:00144392:ios.description:
Kadın Giyim, Erkek Giyim, Çocuk Giyim ve Bebek Giyim modasına ulaşmak şimdi çok daha kolay. 28 ülkede, 500’den fazla mağazada, modayı sınırsız seçenek ve erişilebilir fiyatlarla sunan Koton, yenilenen mobil uygulamasıyla sezon trendlerini cebinize getiriyor. 
Koton’un mobil uygulaması her ihtiyaca hitap eden binlerce ürüne dilediğiniz mobil cihazdan kolay, hızlı erişmenizi ve güvenilir online alışveriş yapmanızı sağlıyor.
 Koton uygulamasıyla alışveriş artık çok kolay!
Yenilikler ve Geliştirmeler;
• Yenilenen Koton ile güvenli, hızlı alışveriş ve hızlı teslimat ilk önceliğimiz.
• Kredi Kartı, kapıda ödeme ve banka kartı ile yapılan ödemelerde iyileştirmeler yaptık, bu sayede hem güvenli ve farklı ödeme seçenekleri ile alışverişlerinizi güvenle yapabilirsiniz.
• Anlaşılır, sade ve net bir kategori yapısı ile aradığınız ürünlere kolayca ulaşabilirsiniz.
• Kullanıcı deneyimini geliştiren ve güçlendiren kadın, erkek, çocuk ve bebeklere özel ana sayfa tasarımları ile koton modası parmaklarınız ucunda, sayfalar arası geçiş yaparak koleksiyonları inceleyebilirsiniz.
• Koton trendlerinin yansıtıldığı koleksiyonlarda kombinli satınalma yapabileceğiniz özel kombin sayfası ile beğendiğiniz kombinleri satın alabileceksiniz.
• Üyelik zorunluluğu olmadan hızlı alış veriş yapabilirsiniz.
• Uygulama bildirimlerinizi açarak uygulamaya özel indirimler, koleksiyonlar ve özel fırsatlardan yararlanabilirsiniz.
• Sezonun en yeni trendlerini keşfedebilir ve kombin önerilerini özelleştirilmiş tasarımla görebilirsiniz.
• Aradığınız ürünün beden, renk, fiyat ve genişletilmiş filtreleme seçenekleri ile kolayca bulabilirsiniz.
• Sipariş ve ürün iade durumunuzu uygulama üzerinden kolayca takip edebilirsiniz.
• Favori ürünlerinizi kaydedebilir ve sonra uygulama üzerinden satın alabilirsiniz.
• Beğendiğiniz ürünün stoğu tükendiğinde üzülmeyin, stoğu biten beden için bedenin yanında bulunan bildirim ikonuna tıklayıp bildirim talebinde bulunduğunuzda, ürün stoğa geldiğinde sizi e-posta ile bilgilendiriyor olacağız, bu sayede beklediğiniz ürünü satın alabilirsiniz.
• Aradığınız ürünlerin size en yakın hangi mağazalarda olduğunu görebilirsiniz.
• Barkod okuma sistemi ile mağazadaki ürünleri uygulamadan da görüntüleyebilirsiniz.
Modanın öncü firmalarından olan Koton.com içerisinde, erkek giyim, kadın giyim, çocuk giyim, bebek giyim gibi ana kategorilerde binlerce ürün bulunmaktadır. Yeni bebek giyim koleksiyonları, erkek çocuk giyim, kız çocuk giyim gibi tüm yaş gruplarına özel ürünlerimiz vardır. Bayan giyim üzerine onlarca kategoride, binlerce ürüne ulaşabilirsiniz. 
Başlıca popüler kategorilerimiz
Elbise, gömlek, mont, kaban, ceket, bluz, ayakkabı, tişört, kazak, hırka, tunik, pantolon, jean pantolon
En uygun fiyatlı erkek giyim ve kadın giyim ürünleri kolay alış veriş deneyimi ile Koton'da.

bluejetty:00171367:ios.description:
K-Dating: Korean Dating, Chat & Global Matchmaking
Are you a fan of Korean culture? Do you want to meet Korean friends or find your Korean soulmate? Welcome to K-Dating, the premier community for K-culture lovers worldwide.
While Korea is famous for K-Pop and K-Dramas, its true charm lies in its people. K-Dating is the perfect place for Koreans and international fans to connect, build friendships, and start romantic relationships.
Break Language Barriers with Auto-Translation
Stop switching between chat and translation apps! Our powerful automatic translation feature allows you to chat in your native language while it translates instantly for your partner. Language exchange and global dating have never been this easy.
Find Your Ideal Match with AI Smart Search
Struggling to find the right person? Our AI Smart Search (Premium) lets you search with natural sentences. Just say, "Find someone with a kind smile who loves K-pop," and our AI will magically find your ideal match.
Play Mini Games & Have Fun Together
Chatting is just the beginning! Invite your match to a variety of mini games and get to know each other while having a blast. Discover unexpected things in common and fresh conversation starters — the sparks fly from here.
K-Dating Special Features:
• Shorts/Reels Style Feed: Explore profiles through engaging video content.
• AI Matchmaking: Find your ideal type using natural language search.
• 1:1 Video Calls: Connect deeply with real-time video chat.
• Perfect Translation: Seamless communication in every chat room.
• Video Profiles: Express your charm with your own self-introduction video.
• Mini Games: A whole new way to connect beyond chat — through play.
Start Your Korean Adventure Today:
• Meet Korean friends and international fans who share your interests.
• Start a romantic journey with international dating.
• Improve your Korean language skills through natural conversation.
• Create unforgettable memories with a global community.
Download K-Dating now and find your special connection in Korea!
Official: https://www.kdating.app
Privacy: https://www.kdating.app/privacy
Terms(EULA): https://www.kdating.app/terms

Easily catalog your comic collection. To add comics to your app, just scan the cover with your device camera. The app will recognize the comic and then automatically provides issue details, cover art, creator lists, key information and more.
CLZ Comics is a paid subscription app, costing US $1.99 per month or US $19.99 per year.
Use the free 7-day trial to try all of the app's features and online services!
OPTIONAL ADD-ON: : Get comic values from CovrPrice at US $90 extra per year.
== Catalog your comics by scanning their covers ==
To add a comic to the app, just take a picture of the cover with the built-in "Cover Scanner". The app will recognize which comic it is and then automatically provides issue details, cover art, creator & character lists, including key comic information, like first appearances.
Alternatively, add comics by scanning their barcodes or just find a series by title and checkbox the issues you own. 
== Edit all fields ==
Modify all automatically provided details from CLZ Core, like the series, issue number, variant description, release/cover dates, plot descriptions, creator and character listings etc.. you can even upload your own cover art (front and back!). Add personal details like storage box, grade, purchase date / price / store, notes, etc..
Create your own Custom Fields so that you can catalog information for which the app does not have a built-in data field.
== Create multiple collections ==
Collections will appear as Excel-like tabs at the bottom of your screen. E.g. for different people, to separate physical from digital comics, to keep track of comics you sold or have for sale, etc... 
== Optional add-on: get comic values from CovrPrice ==
Optional in-app purchase, at US $90 per year.
Get accurate and up-to-date comic values from CovrPrice, for both raw and slabbed comics.
== CLZ Cloud storage ==
Sync your data to the CLZ Cloud, to:
* always have an online backup of your comic tracker database.
* sync your comic library between multiple devices
* view and share your comic collection online
= 24/7 customer support ==
We are always ready to help or to answer your questions, 7 days a week.
Just use "Contact Support" or "CLZ Club forum" from the menu.
== About CLZ ==
CLZ has been developing collection database software since 1996. Located in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, the CLZ team now consists of 12 guys and one gal. We're always working to bring you regular updates for the apps and software, and to keep our Core online databases up-to-date with all weekly NCBD releases.
Our other CLZ apps:
* CLZ Movies, for cataloging your DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs
* CLZ Books, for organizing your book collection by ISBN
* CLZ Music, for creating a database of your CDs and vinyl records
* CLZ Games, for making a database of your video game collection
== What our users say ==
* "So far, I've scanned over 20,000 comics and still going."
* "The annual charge is completely worth it."
* "Not only can you track your current comic collection with specific versions (covers, reprints, ext.), but also what you are missing and/or want."
" It’s very easy to enter to your comics, either by series or by scanning the barcode."
* "Great comic book tracking app and an awesome customer service staff."
* "The barcode reader feature is fantastic!"
ABOUT AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTIONS
* The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
* The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
* You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00127962:ios.description:
Classic Euchre Card Game — play offline vs computer players.
No internet required. No sign-up. Just fast four-player partnership Euchre with trump, bowers, loners, custom rules, stats and replays.
Euchre is a quick, tactical trick-taking card game where two teams race to the target score. Call trump, use the Right and Left Bowers, work with your partner, and try to make the hand.
Why you’ll enjoy Classic Euchre
• Offline play — no internet or account required
• Four-player partnership Euchre
• Easy, Medium and Hard computer players
• Call trump, order up, or pass
• Right Bower and Left Bower card ranking
• Go Alone / Loner hands
• Stick the Dealer option
• Joker / Best Bower option
• 5-card or 7-card Euchre
• Flexible score targets: 5, 7, 10, 11, 15 or 21
• Must win by two option
• Fast or normal play speed
• Portrait and landscape support for tablets
• Stats tracking
• Trick review and hand replays
• AutoPlay and show starting hands
• Custom card faces, themes and suit colors
How Euchre works
Two teams of two compete to reach the target score. Each player is dealt five cards by default, and players then decide whether to order up the turned card as trump or pass.
If everyone passes, the turned card is rejected and players may call a different trump suit.
The team that calls trump becomes the makers. The makers must win enough tricks to score. If they fall short, they are euchred and the defenders score instead.
The Jack of the trump suit is the Right Bower, the strongest card in the hand. The Jack of the same color is the Left Bower, the second-strongest trump.
Scoring
• Makers win the hand: 1 point
• Makers win every trick: 2 points
• Go Alone and win every trick: 4 points
• Makers get euchred: defenders score 2 points
Classic Euchre Card Game is built for quick games, clear cards and smooth offline play — whether you’re learning Euchre or practicing your partnership strategy.

bluejetty:00087445:ios.description:
My Expenses — Simple Bill & Installment Tracker
Do you know exactly what you have to pay this month? With My Expenses, you always will.
My Expenses is the simplest way to track your monthly bills, fixed expenses, and installment payments — all in one place. No complicated setup. No learning curve. Just open the app, add your expenses, and stay in control.
WHY PEOPLE LOVE MY EXPENSES:
• Track fixed monthly bills — rent, utilities, subscriptions
• Manage installment payments — set the total number of installments and the app tracks every single one automatically (e.g. Car loan 1/36)
• Overdue alerts — the app highlights overdue payments so you never miss a due date
• Monthly overview — see your total expenses, what's already paid, and your remaining balance at a glance
• Simple and fast — add an expense in seconds
HOW IT WORKS:
Home Screen — your monthly expense list, organized and easy to read. Overdue payments are highlighted so they're impossible to miss.
Add Expense — enter the description, amount, and due date. Choose between a one-time expense, a recurring fixed bill, or an installment payment with a set number of months.
Expense Detail — view full details, mark as paid, edit, or delete — for just that month, all future months, or all installments at once.
Installment Edit — need to adjust a specific month? Edit individual installments without affecting the rest.
Download My Expenses for free today and finally know where your money is going.

Think you have what it takes to be a World War II general? Put your decision-making skills to the test in SIEGE: World War II.
FEATURES
-Battle against real players in epic PvP duels
-Build the perfect deck to crush your opponents
-Unlock, collect, and upgrade powerful troops and tactics cards
-Join or form clans to share cards and dominate the leaderboards
-Earn prestige tiers to gain early access to unreleased cards
-Experience stunning graphics and beautiful card art
-Compete with players around the world to top seasonal leaderboards
-Receive awesome rewards every single day
-Enjoy new content being released constantly
-Partake in new challenges released twice a week
INTENSE PLAYER VS PLAYER ACTION
Take control of massive armies and clash with real players from around the world in live PvP battles. Test your skills and tactics on the fly in epic head-to-head clashes. Your split-second decisions will turn the tide of battle!
Not ready to hop into multiplayer? No problem! Practice offline against bots to perfect your deck build before taking on challengers online. Test out different strategies and tactics to find the playstyle that is perfect for you.
STRATEGIC DECK BUILDING
Collect and upgrade cards and use them to craft your offensive and defensive military strategy and tactics. Tons of unique cards to collect!
Build your deck and design your perfect army with realistic World War II infantry including riflemen, snipers, paratroopers, bazooka soldiers, and of course, the titan’s of the battlefield, tanks. Then support them with tactics such as airstrikes, minefields, airdrops, artillery and more.
BEAUTIFUL GAMEPLAY AND STUNNING GRAPHICS
Many different maps based on legendary World War II battlefields to play on. Realistic graphics and animations will make you feel like you’re truly a part of the action.
CLAN WARFARE
Become a part of the SIEGE: World War II community by joining an existing clan, or take matters into our own hands and start your own clan and play with your friends!
DAILY REWARDS
Open chests every day to earn rare cards and upgrade your infantry. New surprises await every time you play!
CONSTANT UPDATES
Each season of SIEGE: World War II brings new cards and new challenges. Constantly changing in-game meta means you’ll always have new strategy decisions to make. New leaderboards each season lets you prove that you are the best time and time again.
New personal challenges are issued twice a week, tasking you with strategizing out of your comfort zone and putting your deck building skills to the test.
_______________________________________________
Need help?
Email: siegeww2-support@imperialsupport.org
SIEGE: World War II is a real-time multiplayer strategy game, which means a network connection is required to play online.
While SIEGE: World War II is completely free to play, some in-game items can be purchased with real money. If you don’t want to use this feature, you can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

bluejetty:00097921:ios.name: Phone Cleaner - Pure Cleanup
bluejetty:00097921:ios.summary:
See what your photo library can reveal and reduce it on this iPhone.
Pure Cleanup opens on Privacy. It checks screenshots and location information on this device, keeps photos and videos you choose in a protected Vault, and includes Librar
bluejetty:00097921:ios.description:
See what your photo library can reveal and reduce it on this iPhone.
Pure Cleanup opens on Privacy. It checks screenshots and location information on this device, keeps photos and videos you choose in a protected Vault, and includes Library Cleanup for duplicates, similar photos, and large videos. Nothing in your library is changed or deleted until you choose that action and confirm it.
SENSITIVE SCREENSHOTS
Checks screenshots on this device for content that may include a card number, an IBAN, a wallet recovery phrase, a one-time code, a password or PIN, or a QR code.
Results are shown as potential findings because automatic detection can miss something or flag something by mistake. Review a screenshot yourself before you share or delete it.
Recognized text is not saved. You can also try the feature with a built-in sample image containing fictional data. The sample is not saved to your photo library.
LOCATION EXPOSURE
Shows photos and videos that contain location information. You can select items and remove their location after confirmation.
Pure Cleanup cannot restore location information after it has been removed. If you use iCloud Photos, the change may also appear on your other devices.
REDACT & SHARE
Creates a new copy with detected sensitive text, codes, and faces hidden and with location and camera metadata removed.
You can save or share the new copy. Your original photo remains unchanged.
VAULT
Stores photos and videos you choose to add. The Vault opens with a PIN. After a PIN is set, you can also enable Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices.
Your PIN remains available as a fallback, and the Vault locks when you leave the app.
SECURITY CHECK
Checks whether an email address appears in known data breaches. The email address you enter is sent to a breach-lookup service for this purpose.
Security Check does not run on the device. Sensitive Screenshot, Location Exposure, and Library Cleanup analysis runs on this device.
LIBRARY CLEANUP
Available from the Privacy tab under Library Cleanup.
It can find duplicate photos, similar photos, screenshots, blurred photos, similar screenshots, similar videos, large videos, and screen recordings. It also includes video compression.
Items are changed or deleted only after you select the action and confirm it.
PHOTOS ACCESS
Before the system Photos permission prompt appears, Pure Cleanup explains Full Access, Limited Access, and what happens if you don't allow access.
Full Access lets the app check your accessible photo library. With Limited Access, the app can check only the photos you select. If you don't allow Photos access, library-based features remain unavailable until you enable access later in Settings.
SUBSCRIPTION
Pure Cleanup offers optional auto-renewable weekly and yearly subscriptions. Subscriptions can be managed or canceled through your Apple ID account settings.
Privacy Policy:
https://skovmekapps.com/policy.html
Terms of Use:
https://skovmekapps.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00122809:ios.description:
Green Belt Bank & Trust is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Green Belt Bank & Trust:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Green Belt Bank & Trust app, you must be enrolled as a Green Belt Bank & Trust Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00157191:ios.description:
The Valdosta On-Demand app makes it easier than ever to move around the city of Valdosta, GA — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. No detours, no delays.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE
Rides are priced comparable to public transport and you can add people to your bookings for even less. Head to valdostaondemand.com for more information.
How does Valdosta On-Demand work?
- Valdosta On-Demand is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the Valdosta On-Demand app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making public transportation easier than ever before! 
How long will I wait
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking.
- You can also track your bus in real time using the app.
Questions? Head to valdostaondemand.com or reach out at support-valdosta@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00084032:ios.summary:

"I, Slime" is an idle multiplayer online RPG game. You will play as a spirited Slime hero, enjoying exh
bluejetty:00084032:ios.description:
Open chests, engage in exciting battles, simulation management, cultivate on various fronts, and embark on a heroic journey of a Slime!
"I, Slime" is an idle multiplayer online RPG game. You will play as a spirited Slime hero, enjoying exhilarating battles in various forms and different classes, winning everyone's recognition, and creating a bright new future for the Slime clan!
Now, pick up your weapon, bravely step onto this continent, and create a legendary Slime tale that belongs only to you!
[Game Features]
● Open Chests in a Fantasy Adventure ●
Experience easy and exciting battles in an idle game. Log in to receive idle rewards, and instantly unlock legendary equipment. Enjoy a truly relaxing gaming experience.
● Harvest Resources From Unique Dungeons ●
Pursue sky islands, retrieve divine weapons, attack vehicles, tower defense. From sky islands to underground ruins, battle wits with unique bosses. Clear dungeons with different combat strategies, recreating the authentic adventure RPG dungeon experience!
● Create Stylish Outfits ●
Play with style, classic comic hairstyles, quirky masks, and cool weapons abound. Create your unique look with hundreds of styling items to choose from. Step onto the adventure stage, and you will be the most eye-catching Slime!
● Change Your Class With a Single Tap ●
3 main paths, 6 branches, 28 classes. Change classes with a single tap, reset anytime, and experience a rich variety of adventure classes. Pursue the light or delve into darkness, advocate nature, or illuminate technology, the choice is in your hands! Build a class skill system with a card build approach, giving you a more strategic and immersive battle experience!
● Develop Your Town ●
Experience a combination of simulation management gameplay, raise animals on the ranch, run a restaurant, conduct alchemy research, compete for treasures, and create your own world! 
Stay connected for the latest game updates and exclusive pre-registration rewards! Follow us on our official social media channels:
Discord: https://discord.gg/EPDzqxD8UU
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ISlimeEN
Join the Slime clan today!

bluejetty:00138936:ios.summary:
Meow Hunter is a pixel side-scrolling action RPG featuring adorable cat characters. It combines classic roguelike elements with the exhilarating combat experiences of platformer games.
In this meow-velous universe, you'll become a bounty hu
bluejetty:00138936:ios.description:
Meow Hunter is a pixel side-scrolling action RPG featuring adorable cat characters. It combines classic roguelike elements with the exhilarating combat experiences of platformer games.
In this meow-velous universe, you'll become a bounty hunter taking on missions across various planets in a space adventure to find energy and resources. Every hunt offers a fresh experience with a touch of retro arcade fun. Ready for it? The battle is set to unfold!
[Adorable Characters, Enjoyable Combat]
Cute cats are a must, but there's more! Meet the crafty Dragonbird, the hot-tempered Explorilla, the goofy Pitaya, the ninja Sparrow, and more... Each character boasts unique weapons, skills, and irresistibly charming personalities. From melee combat to shooting, magic to guns, or just simply being adorable, their competence extends across all fields.
[Melee & Ranged, Manifold Experiences]
Fighting isn't just about brawling! Seamlessly blending hand-to-hand melee combat with shooting allows you to engage in fierce close-quarters skirmishes while charging up ranged assaults. The refreshing combat model allows you to revel in an exciting 2D action experience that is as thrilling as it is dynamic.
[Rich Loots, Free Builds]
Whimsical items that overturn your imagination! Over 200 creative drops in the game help you grow within each run. With the ability to bounce bullets, enchant guns with elements, or even revive, you can freely mix and match to create diverse builds, customize heroes, raid rooms, and make every adventure uniquely yours.
[Exclusive Upgrades, Fun-filled Power-up]
Getting stronger is the ultimate goal! With nearly 100 upgrade items, you can fully enhance various characters' melee, ranged, and skill abilities to fight against the foes.
[Varied Landscapes, Purrfect Planets]
Discover distinctive styles with hidden surprises! Play as a fearless hunter journeying through the stars, exploring diverse scenes such as bustling food stalls, neon-lit cyberpunk cities, exotic deserts, and many more. 
The hunting season is approaching! Download Meow Hunter now and embark on a brand-new RPG pixel action shooting adventure!

Instagram: @chillyroominc
X: @ChillyRoom

Are you ready to discover the magic world of Bibi.Pet?
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
In this episode the Bibi.Pet are taken up with running a restaurant. You can help our friends to cook the dishes, mix the ingredients like a real chef, put the plates scattered around the kitchen in order and taste the restaurant’s specialties.
Will the little piggy manage to bake all the cakes? Or will the donkey manage to wash the dishes without breaking any? And what’s that crazy cat doing jumping on the tables? Your help is desperately needed in this magic restaurant. Come and play with us!
Features:
- Associate colors
- Learn shapes
- Use logic
- Complete puzzles
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- SHAPES AND COLORS ---
Our shape and color puzzles are made for infants and toddlers. Children from 0-3 years can start to learn and perceive colors and basic geometric shapes, interacting simply and intuitively.
--- ASSOCIATIONS AND LOGIC ---
Logical associations and puzzles are one of the best ways for small boys and girls to learn while having fun. Our association games enable kids to start identifying differences and group elements by shape, colors and type of object.
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy

--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colours and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

Biano Shopping Assistant shows the discount codes and deals of the online shop you are on, right when you need them.

fdroid:io.github.gccammelli.meowstache.name: Meowstache
fdroid:io.github.gccammelli.meowstache.summary: Litter-Robot 4 companion: full history and pet alerts, kept on your phone
fdroid:io.github.gccammelli.meowstache.description:
Meowstache is an independent companion app for the Litter-Robot 4 . Your cat, your robot, your data.
 Features 
 Full history : week, month, year and all-time charts for weight, visits and cleaning cycles, kept on your phone so it outlives the server's retention.
 Pet alerts : no litter box visit in N days, too many visits in 24 hours, target weight crossed, unusual patterns, and a daily recap.
 Insights : daily recap, visit duration, time of visit and pattern detection, computed on your phone.
 Robot status and controls : waste and litter levels, activity log, lights, cycle delay, panel lock and more.
 Robot notifications : drawer full, low litter, cycle finished or interrupted, errors, offline robot, firmware updates.
 Backup and restore of your full history to a file.
 Demo mode : try the app with a made-up robot and cats, no account needed.
 Privacy : you sign in with your Litter-Robot account. Your password goes straight to the official login server and is never stored; the login token is encrypted with the Android Keystore. No analytics, no ads, no third-party servers.
 Cloud note : cloud mode uses Whisker's unofficial, reverse-engineered cloud API, which may break at any time, and Whisker's terms of use do not permit third-party clients. Local mode (Home Assistant plus community firmware) avoids Whisker's servers entirely.
 Please note : Meowstache is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer, and it doesn't replace the official app (setup and some settings still need it). Only the Litter-Robot 4 is supported. The app depends on the manufacturer's proprietary cloud service. It is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind.
 Litter-Robot, SmartScale and LitterHopper are trademarks of Whisker (Automated Pet Care Products, LLC); other names are trademarks of their owners. Meowstache is not affiliated with or endorsed by Whisker.
